Overall, In This Corner of the World is a powerful and poignant portrayal of life in Japan during World War II, exploring themes that are both universally relatable and uniquely specific to this historical context.

original_title: La véritable histoire du Chat Botté
overview: A free adaptation of Charles Perrault's famous Puss'n Boots, "The True Story of Puss'n Boots" is a story for young and old for the first time on cinema screens.
title: The True Story of Puss 'n Boots
plot:
The True Story of Puss 'n Boots (French: La Véritable Histoire du chat botté), also released in English as The True History of Puss 'N Boots, is a 2009 French computer-animated comedy directed by Jérôme Deschamps, Pascal Hérold and Macha Makeïeff, who also wrote it. A free, comic adaptation of Charles Perrault's fairy tale, it was produced by Hérold and Family with partners including MK2, France 3 Cinéma, Nadeo and the Deschamps–Makeïeff company, and was released in France on 1 April 2009. The animation was rendered with technology from the video game studio Nadeo, best known for the TrackMania series.

When a miller dies, his two elder sons inherit the mill, while the youngest, Pierre, is left only his father's cat. Pierre is disappointed until he discovers that the animal is no ordinary cat: he talks nonstop, walks on his hind legs and, once Pierre makes him a pair of red leather boots, proves endlessly resourceful. In return the cat promises to help his young master win the heart of the princess he adores, a free-spirited girl who secretly sings and dances, and whose hand is also coveted by the king's scheming chamberlain, who has designs on the throne.

Posing as a baron, the cat brings gifts of game to the royal court on behalf of an imaginary Marquis of Carabas, then stages the famous trick in which Pierre bathes in a lake as the royal coach passes and claims that robbers stole his clothes. The queen dresses him in finery and invites him to dine and attend a ball. With the help of his friend Doc Marcel, a chimpanzee who plays music to calm a fearsome ogre in his mountain castle, the cat discovers that the chamberlain is allied with the ogre and makes magic sweets that turn people into animals. Using one of them, the cat turns the ogre into a duck, letting Pierre present the castle as his own. Pierre confesses the truth to the princess, who values his honesty and agrees to marry him; the chamberlain ends up transformed by his own sweets, and the cat declines the post offered to him and goes his own way.

The French voice cast features Jérôme Deschamps as the cat, Arthur Deschamps as Pierre, Louise Wallon as the princess, Yolande Moreau as the queen, Jean-Claude Bolle-Reddat as the chamberlain, Atmen Kelif as Doc Marcel and André Wilms as the ogre. The music, by the band Moriarty, mixes original songs with reworked classical pieces by composers including Beethoven, Mozart and Verdi. In the American English dub, the cat is voiced by William Shatner.

overview: A special-ops team is dispatched to fight supernatural beings that have taken over a European city.
title: Spectral
plot:
Spectral is a 2016 American supernatural action film directed by Luke Mitchell and written by Will Collins. The movie stars Max Irons, Hannah John-Kamen, and Sam Hazeldine.

The story begins with Lieutenant Brennan MacLaren (Max Irons), an FBI agent who has been investigating paranormal cases for years. He is haunted by a traumatic event from his past, which led to the death of his partner. Brennan's latest case involves a series of mysterious disappearances in rural areas across the United States.

Brennan teams up with Agent Rachel Keller (Hannah John-Kamen), an FBI agent who specializes in paranormal cases. Together, they are joined by Agent Sean Carter (Sam Hazeldine) and Agent Tom Morgan (Bruce Greenwood). The team is sent to investigate a series of bizarre occurrences in rural areas, where people have gone missing under mysterious circumstances.

As the investigation unfolds, Brennan and his team discover that the disappearances are linked to an ancient entity known as "The Specter." This entity is said to be a malevolent spirit that feeds on human fear. The team soon realizes that they are dealing with something much more sinister than they initially thought.

Throughout the movie, Brennan's character undergoes significant development as he confronts his past and faces his fears head-on. He also begins to form a bond with Rachel, who becomes a valuable ally in his investigation.

As the stakes escalate, Brennan and his team discover that The Specter is not just a simple entity but a manifestation of humanity's collective fear. They must work together to uncover the source of this fear and put an end to it before it's too late.

The climax of the movie features an intense showdown between Brennan and The Specter. In a thrilling sequence, Brennan confronts his own fears and doubts in order to defeat the entity. With the help of Rachel and his team, he is able to banish The Specter back to its realm, saving countless lives in the process.

The ending of the movie marks a turning point for Brennan's character. He has finally confronted his past and overcome his fears, emerging as a stronger and more confident individual. The movie concludes on a hopeful note, with Brennan and Rachel sharing a moment of connection and possibility.

Overall, Spectral is an action-packed supernatural thriller that explores themes of fear, trauma, and redemption. With its strong performances from the cast and impressive visual effects, the movie delivers a thrilling ride for fans of the genre.

overview: Two strangers believe in love but never seem to be able to find its true meaning. In a wild twist of events, fate puts each in the other's path on one stormy New Year's Eve.
tagline: Love appears where you least expect it.
title: About Fate
plot: Two strangers believe in love but never seem to be able to find its true meaning. In a wild twist of events, fate puts each in the other's path on one stormy New Year's Eve.

overview: An epic journey, faithfully adapted to modern-day. Christian faces distractions, challenges, and perils at every turn of the way. But ends victorious, with helpful guides, as he stays on the narrow path to the distant Celestial City.
title: The Pilgrim's Progress
plot:
The Pilgrim's Progress is a 2019 American computer-animated Christian fantasy adventure written and directed by Robert Fernandez. It is based on John Bunyan's 1678 allegory of the same name. David Thorpe voices Christian, John Rhys-Davies voices Evangelist and Kristyn Getty voices the Interpreter. Jonathan Keeble, Justin Butcher, Chris Pavlo and Andrew Wyncott voice Faithful, Hopeful, Worldly Wiseman and the villain Apollyon.

The story begins in Not-Cursed, a city of laborers watched over by Apollyon, master of corruption. When a worker named Faithful disappears, leaving strange drawings behind, his colleague Christian learns he has set out for the Celestial City beyond the borders. After a nightmare, Christian reads a book from Faithful's office and becomes convinced the city will be destroyed. His wife dismisses the book as fiction and refuses to leave, so he sets out alone.

On the way, Evangelist urges him to keep to the path. His eager companion Pliable gives up after they fall into the Swamp of Despondency, and a man named Help pulls Christian out. The smooth-talking Worldly Wiseman leads him off course to the village of Morality, where he despairs under the Law of Moses until Evangelist rescues him. A Gatekeeper saves him from bats, and the Interpreter teaches him that those who follow the light will be protected if they persevere. On the Path of Patience, his burden falls away. Heralds of the King give him new clothes, and the daughters of Vigilant give him armor and a sword, with which he defeats Apollyon. Reunited with Faithful, he goes on to Vanity Fair, where Faithful is executed and Christian is imprisoned. A sympathetic jailer, Hopeful, helps him escape. The two are captured by a giant but realize their hope makes them unbreakable. They escape and are guided by a Shepherd. Apollyon, disguised as an old man, captures them, but a herald rescues them. At the sea before the Celestial City, Christian enters the water, Apollyon is cast into the depths, and the Shepherd welcomes him into the city. In an epilogue, his wife finds a letter showing he is alive, as Apollyon circles her home as a dragon, setting up a continuation.

Fathom Events released the film in American cinemas on April 18, 2019, around Easter, and it grossed about $3.2 million worldwide. Reviews were mixed. The Guardian criticized its stiff animation and lack of humor, while WORLD Magazine and Variety were more positive, and Radio Times called the animation basic but effective.

overview: In 1970s Mexico City, two domestic workers help a mother of four while her husband is away for an extended period of time.
tagline: There are periods in history that scar societies and moments in life that transform us as individuals.
title: Roma
plot:
Roma is a poignant and introspective film that explores the complexities of class, identity, and the human experience through the eyes of a domestic worker, Cleo, in 1970s Mexico City. The movie delves into the intricate relationships between Cleo, her family, and their loyal housekeeper, who becomes a surrogate mother figure to the children.

At its core, Roma is a film about the fragility of human connection and the ways in which our lives are shaped by the people we love and care for. Through Cleo's story, the film sheds light on the often-overlooked experiences of domestic workers, highlighting their agency, resilience, and emotional depth.

The movie also explores themes of identity, particularly in relation to class and social status. Cleo's struggles to navigate her own desires and aspirations amidst the constraints of her working-class existence serve as a powerful commentary on the societal expectations placed upon women from marginalized communities.

Furthermore, Roma is a deeply personal and nostalgic film that captures the essence of childhood innocence and the passing of time. The movie's use of long takes, vibrant colors, and lush cinematography creates a dreamlike atmosphere that immerses the viewer in Cleo's world, evoking a sense of wonder and curiosity about the people and places she inhabits.

Ultimately, Roma is a film about the beauty and complexity of human relationships, the power of love and care to transcend social boundaries, and the resilience of the human spirit in the face of adversity.

overview: After trying to cover up a car accident that left a man dead, a crooked homicide detective is stalked by a mysterious man claiming to have witnessed the event.
tagline: The war for a dirty secret.
title: A Hard Day
plot:
A Hard Day is a 2014 South Korean crime thriller film directed by Lee Joon-myeong and produced by Showbox. The movie revolves around a police officer, Seo-woo, who is tasked with solving the murder of his partner's wife.

The main theme of A Hard Day is the blurred lines between right and wrong in the pursuit of justice. As Seo-woo delves deeper into the case, he becomes increasingly entangled in a web of corruption and moral ambiguity. The film explores how the desire for justice can sometimes lead individuals to compromise their own values and principles.

The movie also touches on the theme of loneliness and isolation. Seo-woo's personal life is marked by tragedy, and his professional life is characterized by a sense of disconnection from others. As he navigates the complex case, he begins to question whether justice can be truly served when it comes at the cost of one's own humanity.

Furthermore, A Hard Day critiques the systemic corruption that pervades the police force in South Korea. The film highlights how institutionalized corruption can lead to a breakdown in trust between law enforcement and the public, creating a toxic environment where justice is often compromised for personal gain.

Overall, A Hard Day is a gripping thriller that explores the complexities of human nature, morality, and the pursuit of justice in a corrupt system.

overview: The most prominent heads of state in the world begin gathering for a conference that could have a major impact on global politics. When MI-7 receives word that the Chinese premier has become the target of some high-powered killers, it falls on Johnny English to save the day. Armed with the latest high-tech weaponry and gadgets that would make even James Bond jealous, the once-disgraced agent uncovers evidence of a massive conspiracy involving some of the world's most powerful organisations, and vows to redeem his tarnished reputation by stopping the killers before they can strike.
tagline: A little intelligence goes a long way
title: Johnny English Reborn
plot:
Johnny English Reborn is a 2011 spy comedy film directed by Oliver Parker and starring Rowan Atkinson as the titular character, Johnny English.

The movie begins with Johnny English, a bumbling but lovable British spy, who has been retired from active duty due to his ineptitude. However, when a former KGB agent named Dominic (played by Ross Kemp) is released from prison after serving time for treason, Johnny is forced back into action to stop him.

As Johnny delves deeper into the world of espionage once again, he discovers that Dominic has stolen a deadly virus known as "The Phoenix," which can be used to create an army of mindless drones. The virus is being sold on the black market, and it's up to Johnny to track down the buyer and prevent a global catastrophe.

Along the way, Johnny teams up with his new partner, Nancy (played by Natalie Imbruglia), a tough and capable agent who is initially skeptical of Johnny's abilities. As they work together, they develop a romantic connection, which adds an extra layer of complexity to their mission.

As the plot thickens, Johnny and Nancy find themselves in a series of hilarious misadventures, from infiltrating a high-stakes poker game to escaping from a group of henchmen. Despite his best efforts, Johnny consistently manages to botch his missions, leading to plenty of comedic moments.

However, as the stakes grow higher, Johnny begins to prove himself to be more than just a bumbling spy. He uses his unique skills and resourcefulness to outwit his enemies and stay one step ahead of Dominic's henchmen.

In the end, Johnny and Nancy successfully stop Dominic from selling the Phoenix virus, but not before he escapes with it. In a thrilling finale, Johnny and Nancy track down Dominic to an abandoned warehouse, where they engage in a high-speed car chase through the streets of London.

As the dust settles, Johnny emerges victorious, having saved the world from certain destruction. The movie ends on a romantic note, with Johnny and Nancy sharing a kiss as the credits roll.

Throughout the film, Rowan Atkinson's signature physical comedy and wit shine through, making Johnny English Reborn a hilarious and entertaining ride. Despite its lighthearted tone, the movie also explores themes of redemption and self-discovery, as Johnny learns to come to terms with his own limitations and find success in his own unique way.

Overall, Johnny English Reborn is a fun and action-packed spy comedy that will keep you laughing from start to finish. With its witty dialogue, physical humor, and charming performances, it's a must-see for fans of the genre.

overview: All Eyez on Me chronicles the life and legacy of Tupac Shakur, including his rise to superstardom as a hip-hop artist, actor, poet and activist, as well as his imprisonment and prolific, controversial time at Death Row Records. Against insurmountable odds, Tupac rose to become a cultural icon whose career and persona both continue to grow long after his passing.
tagline: Legends never die
title: All Eyez on Me
plot:
All Eyez on Me is a 2017 American biographical drama film directed by Benny Boom, based on the life of rapper Tupac Shakur. The movie explores several themes that are central to Tupac's story and legacy.

One of the main themes of All Eyez on Me is the struggle for identity and self-discovery. Tupac's journey from a young boy growing up in poverty-stricken East Harlem to becoming one of the most influential figures in hip-hop culture is marked by his search for purpose and meaning. The film delves into his experiences as a teenager, his involvement with the Black Panther Party, and his rise to fame, highlighting the challenges he faced in navigating his identity as a black man in America.

Another significant theme is the impact of violence and trauma on individuals and communities. Tupac's life was marked by numerous violent incidents, including the shooting that left him paralyzed from the waist down. The film portrays the emotional toll these experiences took on him, as well as the devastating effects they had on his loved ones. This theme serves as a commentary on the cyclical nature of violence in urban communities and the need for healing and redemption.

The movie also explores Tupac's passion for social justice and activism. His music often addressed issues like police brutality, racism, and poverty, inspiring a generation of young people to take action. Through his lyrics and public statements, Tupac advocated for human rights and equality, leaving a lasting legacy that continues to inspire social change.

Furthermore, All Eyez on Me touches on the theme of fame and its consequences. As Tupac's star rises, he becomes increasingly consumed by the pressures of fame, including the scrutiny of the media and the expectations of his fans. The film shows how these pressures can both elevate and destroy an individual, highlighting the tension between artistic expression and commercial success.

Lastly, the movie explores Tupac's complex relationships with those around him, particularly his family and friends. His bond with his mother, Afeni Shakur, is a central theme, as she struggles to provide for her children while also advocating for their rights. The film also portrays Tupac's friendships with Snoop Dogg, Dr. Dre, and other influential figures in the hip-hop world.

Overall, All Eyez on Me offers a nuanced portrayal of Tupac Shakur's life, exploring themes that continue to resonate with audiences today.

overview: In a dusty post-war summer in rural Warwickshire, a doctor is called to a patient at lonely Hundreds Hall. Home to the Ayres family for over two centuries, the Georgian house is now in decline. But are the Ayreses haunted by something more sinister than a dying way of life?
tagline: These delusions are contagious
title: The Little Stranger
plot:
The Little Stranger is a gothic horror film that explores the decaying English countryside and the dark secrets that lie within its walls. The story revolves around Dr. Faraday, a country doctor who is drawn to the mysterious and isolated Bell Manor, where he becomes embroiled in the lives of the crumbling aristocratic family.

At its core, The Little Stranger is a film about the decay of the British class system and the decline of traditional values. The once-grand Bell Manor, with its opulent decor and lavish parties, serves as a symbol of the past's grandeur and the present's neglect. As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that the family's fortunes are dwindling, and their relationships are strained by secrets, lies, and unrequited love.

The film also delves into themes of isolation and loneliness, as Dr. Faraday finds himself increasingly drawn to the Bell family despite his initial reservations. His own troubled past and sense of disconnection from society make him an outsider among the aristocracy, yet he becomes obsessed with uncovering the truth behind the family's troubles.

Furthermore, The Little Stranger is a exploration of the supernatural and the power of the human psyche. As strange occurrences begin to plague the Bell family, Dr. Faraday becomes convinced that the house itself is alive and exerting a malevolent influence over its inhabitants. This blurs the lines between reality and fantasy, leaving the audience questioning what is real and what is just the product of the characters' fevered imaginations.

Ultimately, The Little Stranger is a haunting and atmospheric film that probes the darker aspects of human nature and the decay of traditional values in post-war England.

overview: Nearly 10 years have passed since Sarah Connor was targeted for termination by a cyborg from the future. Now her son, John, the future leader of the resistance, is the target for a newer, more deadly terminator. Once again, the resistance has managed to send a protector back to attempt to save John and his mother Sarah.
tagline: It's nothing personal.
title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
plot:
Ten years after the events of the first film, a new, more advanced Terminator—the T-1000, made of liquid metal—has been sent back from 2029 to 1995 to assassinate John Connor, the future leader of the human resistance. To protect John, the resistance sends back a reprogrammed T-800 Terminator (the same model that tried to kill Sarah Connor years earlier) to guard him.

John Connor, now a rebellious teenager, lives with foster parents but soon finds himself hunted by the T-1000. The T-800 locates John and saves him from the T-1000’s attacks. Together with John’s mother, Sarah Connor—who has become a fierce warrior preparing for the inevitable war against machines—they attempt to prevent Judgment Day.

Sarah, John, and the T-800 aim to destroy Cyberdyne Systems, the company responsible for creating Skynet’s technology, by targeting the research lab and a key scientist, Miles Dyson. After a series of intense confrontations and a high-speed chase, they succeed in destroying the lab, the research, and the Terminators that pursue them.

In a final battle at a steel mill, the T-1000 proves nearly unstoppable, shape-shifting and regenerating from damage. The T-800 and John manage to destroy it by plunging it into molten steel. Recognizing the threat that its own technology poses to humanity’s future, the T-800 sacrifices itself by lowering into the molten steel, ensuring no trace of Skynet’s creation remains.

The film ends on a cautiously hopeful note, with Sarah driving away with John, determined to change the future and prevent the catastrophic war between humans and machines.

"Terminator 2" explores themes of fate, free will, humanity, and sacrifice. It is celebrated for its groundbreaking special effects, intense action sequences, and deeper emotional storytelling compared to the original.

overview: Set in the 22nd century, The Matrix tells the story of a computer hacker who joins a group of underground insurgents fighting the vast and powerful computers who now rule the earth.
plot:
Thomas Anderson, a computer programmer living a double life as the hacker 'Neo', feels that something is fundamentally wrong with the world. He is contacted by a mysterious group led by Morpheus, who reveals a shocking truth: reality as Neo knows it is an illusion. The world is actually a simulated reality known as the Matrix, created by intelligent machines to subdue humanity while using their bodies as an energy source.

Morpheus believes Neo is 'The One'—a prophesied figure who will have the power to manipulate the Matrix and lead humanity to freedom. Neo is freed from the simulation and brought into the real world, where he begins intense training to unlock his abilities. This includes virtual combat programs, where Neo famously declares, 'I know kung fu', after downloading martial arts directly into his brain.

As Neo trains, he learns that the Matrix is governed by Agents—powerful AI enforcers led by the relentless Agent Smith. When Morpheus is captured while trying to help Neo escape, Neo and fellow freedom fighter Trinity launch a daring rescue mission. The film culminates in a bullet-dodging, high-octane battle that tests Neo's belief in himself.

Ultimately, Neo embraces his destiny, unlocking his full powers within the simulation. He sees the Matrix for what it is—lines of code—and begins to manipulate it at will. He defeats Agent Smith and promises to free humanity from its artificial prison.

"The Matrix" blends cyberpunk aesthetics, philosophical inquiry, and groundbreaking action—including wire-fu martial arts choreography inspired by classic kung fu cinema. It explores deep questions about reality, perception, free will, and what it means to be truly awake.
tagline: Welcome to the Real World.
title: The Matrix

overview: In the post-apocalyptic future, reigning tyrannical supercomputers teleport a cyborg assassin known as the 'Terminator' back to 1984 to kill Sarah Connor, whose unborn son is destined to lead insurgents against 21st century mechanical hegemony. Meanwhile, the human-resistance movement dispatches a lone warrior to safeguard Sarah. Can he stop the virtually indestructible killing machine?
tagline: Your future is in his hands.
title: The Terminator
plot:
In the year 2029, Earth is a post-apocalyptic wasteland ruled by intelligent machines led by an AI called Skynet. After launching a nuclear holocaust known as Judgment Day, Skynet wages war on the remnants of humanity. The human resistance, led by a man named John Connor, manages to turn the tide. In a last-ditch effort to defeat the resistance, Skynet sends a Terminator—a nearly indestructible cyborg assassin—back in time to 1984 Los Angeles. Its mission is to kill Sarah Connor, John’s mother, before he can be born.

The Terminator, disguised as a human (played by Arnold Schwarzenegger), arrives in 1984 and begins systematically killing every woman named Sarah Connor listed in the phone book. Meanwhile, the resistance sends back one of their own, Kyle Reese (Michael Biehn), to protect the correct Sarah Connor (Linda Hamilton).

Kyle finds Sarah and explains the situation: the Terminator is a cybernetic organism designed to infiltrate and exterminate; it will never stop hunting her. Sarah, understandably skeptical, becomes convinced after witnessing the Terminator’s relentless attack. The pair go on the run, with Kyle providing knowledge of the future and Sarah beginning to accept her crucial role in humanity’s survival.

During their escape, Kyle and Sarah grow close, and she learns that John Connor deliberately chose Kyle to be sent back because Kyle is, in fact, John’s father. They conceive John during their time together.

The Terminator relentlessly pursues them, leading to a climactic showdown in a factory. Kyle sacrifices himself to destroy the Terminator by blowing it up with a pipe bomb. Though badly injured, the Terminator’s torso continues to crawl after Sarah. She manages to crush it in a hydraulic press, finally ending the threat.

In the aftermath, Sarah, now pregnant, prepares for a future that only she knows is coming. She begins recording audio tapes for her unborn son, warning him about the coming war and the role he must play. She drives into the desert, determined to survive and protect her child.

overview: A father fights for decades to bring his daughter's killer to justice in France and Germany before taking extreme measures.
title: My Daughter's Killer
plot: A father fights for decades to bring his daughter's killer to justice in France and Germany before taking extreme measures.

overview: A young couple is pushed to the limits of sanity as they attempt to be reunited amid the chaos of a pandemic outbreak. The streets erupt into violence and depravity, as those infected are driven to enact the most cruel and ghastly things imaginable.
tagline: It feels...wonderful...
title: The Sadness
plot:
The Sadness (Chinese: 哭悲, Kū Bēi) is a 2021 Taiwanese body horror film written, directed and edited by the Canadian filmmaker Rob Jabbaz in his feature debut. Berant Zhu and Regina Lei, in her first film role, play Jim and Kat, a young couple trying to find each other as a viral outbreak turns people into homicidal sadists, with Tzu-Chiang Wang as a businessman, Lue-Keng Huang as Kevin, Ying-Ru Chen as Molly and Wei-Hua Lan as Dr. Alan Wong.

In Taipei, the government, focused on its re-election campaign, plays down the "Alvin virus", an infection resembling influenza, although the virologist Dr. Wong warns that it could mutate. After Jim drops Kat at the subway, an elderly woman covered in blood attacks a café, spreading the infection, and the city descends into chaos. Back at home, Jim is attacked by an infected neighbour, Mr. Lin, who cuts off two of his fingers. On the train, Kat moves away from a leering businessman, who becomes infected when a stabbing spree erupts in the carriage and drives his umbrella into the eye of a student, Molly. Kat drags Molly from the station, and the two escape with Kevin, a subway employee, to a crowded hospital, where Kat messages Jim. On television, a general addressing the nation turns out to be infected and sets off a grenade.

The businessman reaches the hospital, the infected overrun the waiting room, and Molly is assaulted and infected; she later kills Kevin as he tries to escape. Kat beats the businessman to death with a fire extinguisher and is let into the maternity ward by Dr. Wong, who explains that the mutated virus hijacks the brain's limbic system, unleashing people's most violent urges while leaving their intelligence and speech intact. Awaiting a military helicopter, he injects Kat with the virus to test her immunity, revealing that he killed infected newborns during his experiments. Jim, now fully infected, arrives and kills Wong when the doctor's 3D-printed pistol explodes. Kat locks herself behind a stairwell gate as the dying Jim describes his "love" as a craving to torture her, and she flees laughing hysterically toward the roof as gunfire and her screams are heard.

Filmed over 28 days in Keelung and Taipei with extensive practical effects, The Sadness opened in Taiwan on 22 January 2021 and premiered internationally at the Locarno Film Festival that August before screening at Fantasia and Fantastic Fest and streaming on Shudder. It received positive reviews, with 88% on Rotten Tomatoes.

overview: When Earth is taken over by the overly-confident Boov, an alien race in search of a new place to call home, all humans are promptly relocated, while all Boov get busy reorganizing the planet. But when one resourceful girl, Tip, manages to avoid capture, she finds herself the accidental accomplice of a banished Boov named Oh. The two fugitives realize there’s a lot more at stake than intergalactic relations as they embark on the road trip of a lifetime.
tagline: Worlds Collide
title: Home
plot:
Home is a computer-animated comedy-adventure film released in 2015 by DreamWorks Animation. The movie follows the story of Oh, an alien who lives on a distant planet called Boov.

The story begins with Oh's life on Boov, where he is part of a group of aliens known as the Boovians. However, Oh's life takes a drastic turn when his home planet is invaded by another alien species, the Gruzzit. The Gruzzit destroy Oh's home and force him to flee.

Oh boards a spaceship that crashes on Earth, where he finds himself in New York City. He soon discovers that he has been adopted by a human family, the Grills, who are unaware of his true identity as an alien. Oh struggles to adjust to human life, particularly with regards to language and customs.

As Oh navigates his new surroundings, he befriends a young girl named Tip, who is initially hesitant to trust him due to her difficult past. However, through their interactions, Oh helps Tip to confront her emotional baggage and find closure.

Meanwhile, the Boovians launch an invasion of Earth in search of Oh, believing that he has been kidnapped by humans. The Grills soon discover Oh's true identity and must work together with him to stop the Boovians' invasion.

Throughout the movie, Oh grapples with his dual identity as both a human and an alien. He struggles to reconcile his loyalty to his fellow Boovians with his newfound love for Tip and her family. The film explores themes of belonging, acceptance, and the importance of human connection.

As the story unfolds, Oh and Tip embark on a perilous journey to stop the Boovians' invasion and save Earth from destruction. Along the way, they encounter various obstacles and challenges that test their friendship and trust in each other.

In the end, Oh and the Grills successfully defeat the Boovians, and Oh is able to find a sense of belonging on Earth. The movie concludes with Oh and Tip sharing a heartwarming moment, as Oh finally finds a new home and a family among humans.

Overall, Home is a heartwarming and entertaining film that explores themes of identity, friendship, and acceptance. With its lovable characters and engaging storyline, the movie has become a beloved favorite among audiences worldwide.

overview: Utah and his girlfriend Opal, are drug addicts living on the streets in rural Ohio. After getting recruited by body broker Wood, and offered treatment in Los Angeles, Wood takes Utah under his wing and introduces him to treatment center mogul Vin. Wood and Vin bring Utah in on their lucrative and illegal dealings, where saving lives comes second to the bottom line.
tagline: Drugs. Rehab. Profit.
title: Body Brokers
plot:
Body Brokers is a 2021 American crime drama written and directed by John Swab. It stars Jack Kilmer, Michael Kenneth Williams, Jessica Rothe, Alice Englert, Peter Greene, Frank Grillo and Melissa Leo. The film exposes the world of addiction treatment fraud, in which rehab centers exploit insurance billing and pay addicts to recruit other addicts.

The film opens with an advertisement for New West Recovery, a Los Angeles rehab center founded by former addict Vin. In voice-over, Vin explains that the Affordable Care Act turned addiction treatment into a vast and profitable industry across Southern California. In Columbus, Ohio, homeless addicts Utah and Opal rob convenience stores to pay for drugs, and Opal also does sex work for truckers. While they are panhandling, they meet Wood, a recruiter for New West, who buys them a meal and offers them a chance to get clean. Opal assumes he is a preacher and refuses, but Utah flies with Wood to Los Angeles. A few weeks later, Utah is doing well, and he finally persuades Opal to enroll. He then learns that New West has paid him a fee for referring her.

Utah becomes one of Wood's recruiters, earning tens of thousands of dollars from referrals, unnecessary tests and pointless procedures billed to insurers, while Vin cheerfully explains the schemes. Utah struggles with his conscience. The fraud seems victimless until the corrupt Dr. Riner demands a bigger share of a lucrative surgical procedure and insults the two recruiters. Wood beats him to death and buries the body, and Vin tells them to lie low. Soon afterwards, Vin sends Utah to pick up a new recruit in a car at the Los Angeles airport. Utah lets the man shoot up one last time, gives in to temptation himself and dies of an overdose. The film suggests Vin arranged the meeting to get rid of a witness to Riner's murder. An epilogue presents statistics on addiction and overdose deaths, says many similar businesses still operate, and recommends free twelve-step programs as the most effective treatment.

Principal photography took place in Oklahoma in August 2019. Vertical Entertainment acquired the film in December 2020 and released it in limited theaters in the United States on February 19, 2021. Reviews were mixed to positive. Rotten Tomatoes' consensus said the film attempts an ambitious balance of genre thrills and a serious social message but fumbles too often to fully succeed. Metacritic reported generally favorable reviews.

overview: Susan, a single mother of two, works as a waitress in a small town. Her son, Henry, is an 11-year-old genius who not only manages the family finances but acts as emotional support for his mother and younger brother. When Henry discovers that the girl next door has a terrible secret, he implores Susan to take matters into her own hands.
tagline: Never leave things undone.
title: The Book of Henry
plot:
The Book of Henry is a poignant and emotional drama that delves into the complexities of family dynamics, grief, and redemption. At its core, the film explores the intricate web of relationships within a family, particularly between a father and his son, as they navigate the challenges of growing up and letting go.

The movie masterfully weaves together themes of love, loss, and forgiveness, creating a narrative that is both heart-wrenching and ultimately uplifting. The protagonist, Henry, is a brilliant and sensitive young boy who finds solace in his own unique world, where he can escape the pain and difficulties of his family's life.

As the story unfolds, the audience is taken on a journey of self-discovery, as Henry's father struggles to come to terms with his son's illness and the impending loss that threatens to tear their family apart. The film expertly conveys the emotional turmoil that can arise when faced with the impermanence of life, forcing the characters – and the audience – to confront the harsh realities of mortality.

Through its thoughtful portrayal of these themes, The Book of Henry offers a powerful exploration of what it means to be human, to love unconditionally, and to find hope in the darkest of times. Ultimately, the film is a testament to the enduring power of family bonds and the resilience of the human spirit.

original_title: Futurama: The Beast with a Billion Backs
overview: Fresh off ripping space-time a new one at the end of "Bender's Big Score," the Planet Express crew is back to mend the tear in reality, or (hopefully) at least not make it worse.  Beyond the tear, though, lurks a being of inconceivable...tentacularity.  What will become of Earth, and indeed, our universe, when faced with the Beast with a Billion Backs?
tagline: Puts the "ick" in science ficktion!
title: Futurama: The Beast with a Billion Backs
plot:
Futurama: The Beast with a Billion Backs is an animated science fiction film that explores complex and thought-provoking themes. At its core, the movie delves into the nature of free will versus determinism, as the main character Leela grapples with her own destiny and the consequences of her choices.

The film also examines the concept of identity and what it means to be oneself. Leela's journey is a metaphor for self-discovery, as she navigates the complexities of her own existence and confronts the idea that her path in life may not have been entirely her own choice.

Furthermore, The Beast with a Billion Backs touches on the theme of responsibility and accountability. As Leela faces the consequences of her actions, she must also come to terms with the impact she has had on those around her, including her friends and allies.

The movie's exploration of these themes is often humorous and satirical, but beneath its comedic surface lies a rich and thought-provoking commentary on the human condition. Through Leela's story, the film invites viewers to consider the complexities of existence and the choices that shape our lives.

overview: After the mysterious death of scientist, Dr. Devin Villiers, Det. Frank Turner and his partner are assigned to protect Villiers' colleague, who revealed that  a veteran soldier was subjected to an experiment with the objective of creating the ultimate national security weapon... an undetectable soldier. The experiment failed – with disastrous side effects.
tagline: There's More to Terror Than Meets The Eye
title: Hollow Man II
plot:
Hollow Man 2 (released as Hollow Man II) is a 2006 American science fiction thriller directed by Claudio Fäh. A stand-alone sequel to the 2000 film Hollow Man, it explores the consequences of invisibility through Michael Griffin, a soldier left permanently invisible by a government experiment that went wrong. Peter Facinelli stars as Detective Frank Turner, Laura Regan as the scientist Maggie Dalton and Christian Slater as Griffin, with David McIlwraith, Sarah Deakins and Jessica Harmon.

At a cocktail party held by a Washington think tank, the scientist Devin Villiers is dragged into a bathroom by an unseen attacker. Under threat, he reveals the name of a colleague, Maggie Dalton, who holds the "formula" his assailant wants. Spared on condition of silence, Devin tries to raise the alarm and is killed. Dr. Reisner, whose laboratory carried out the invisibility research, arranges for detectives Frank Turner and Lisa Martinez to guard Maggie, but the attacker gets into her home and kills Lisa, and soldiers fail to catch him.

Maggie is taken into protective custody, but when Turner learns that she is about to be handed over to the military, he helps her escape. She explains that scientists had earlier created an invisibility serum with severe and eventually fatal side effects. When the military secretly revived the project, Griffin volunteered as a test subject, and he was believed to have died after the antidote meant to reverse the process failed; Maggie later discovered that the antidote, known as the buffer, had never actually been given to him. The fugitives take refuge with a former soldier from the program, who tells them that the military has been using Griffin to carry out political assassinations, and who sacrifices his life to protect them when Griffin attacks.

Griffin then kidnaps Maggie's sister and demands that Maggie recreate the antidote in return for her sister's life. After a confrontation with Turner at a train station, Griffin forces Maggie to a laboratory and makes her inject herself with half of the buffer to prove it is safe. Turner tracks them down and fights Griffin, who begins to turn visible and horribly disfigured: Maggie had substituted rat poison for the antidote. Griffin is defeated, leaving Maggie and Turner alive but shaken.

The film went straight to video on May 23, 2006. As with the original, it was poorly received; only one of six reviews on Rotten Tomatoes was positive.

overview: Joe Moore has a job he loves. He's a thief. His job goes sour when he gets caught on security camera tape. His fence, Bergman, reneges on the money he's owed, and his wife may be betraying him with the fence's young lieutenant. Moore and his partner, Bobby Blane, and their utility man, Pinky Pincus, find themselves broke, betrayed, and blackmailed. Moore is forced to commit his crew to do one last big job.
tagline: It isn't love that makes the world go round.
title: Heist
plot:
Heist is a 2001 American crime thriller written and directed by David Mamet. Gene Hackman, Danny DeVito and Delroy Lindo star, reuniting after Get Shorty (1995), with Rebecca Pidgeon, Ricky Jay, Patti LuPone and Sam Rockwell in supporting roles.

Professional thief Joe Moore works with Bobby Blane, Donnie "Pinky" Pincus and his wife Fran. During the robbery of a New York jewelry store, Joe deliberately takes off his mask to distract an employee, and a security camera records his face. Now exposed, he decides to retire and sail away with Fran. His fence, Mickey Bergman, who runs a garment business as a front, has already spent heavily preparing the next job. He refuses to pay the crew for the jewelry robbery unless they agree to rob a Swiss flight carrying gold. Bergman also forces his volatile young nephew, Jimmy Silk, onto the team. Jimmy soon takes an interest in Fran and doubts that Joe is still sharp. After a tense run-in with a police officer, Joe tries to call off the job by making Jimmy think the crew's fingerprints were left on the getaway car, but the trick is uncovered and Bergman makes them go ahead.

The robbery unfolds as a chain of misdirections. Disguised as airport staff, the crew stops the plane on the runway, loads a van and hides it in a rented garage. Jimmy knocks Joe out and leaves with Fran and the van, only to find its hidden compartments full of washers. Joe and Bobby then retrieve a shipment they had booked on the same flight and arrange for it to be driven away, with the real gold inside, which they melt down into long rods. Bergman's men seize Pinky and threaten his niece. Pinky reveals the plan but warns Joe with a code word before he is killed. At Joe's boat, Bergman mistakes the boat's golden railings for the loot, and Bobby opens fire from hiding. Joe kills Bergman. Fran, apparently siding with Jimmy, takes a truck loaded with black-painted rods. Joe drives off in a second truck that carries the real gold.

Franchise Pictures financed the film on the condition that Hackman and DeVito star. Set mainly around Boston, it was shot in Montreal, with Mirabel airport standing in for Logan. After a premiere at the Toronto International Film Festival, Warner Bros. released it on November 9, 2001. It grossed $28.5 million worldwide, and its $23.5 million in North America made it Mamet's highest-grossing film there. Critics praised the cast and witty dialogue; Roger Ebert called it a caper made from fresh ingredients, not cake mix.

overview: When her best friend's father is falsely accused of stealing the town's prized jingle bells, a young amateur sleuth and her friends must find the real thief before Christmas.
tagline: Solve the crime. Save the season.
title: A Christmas Mystery
plot:
A Christmas Mystery is a 2022 American family Christmas mystery film directed by Alex Ranarivelo and produced by ESX Entertainment and Lila Lane Pictures for HBO Max. It stars Violet McGraw as the eleven-year-old amateur sleuth Violet Pierce, with Eddie Cibrian as her father, the local sheriff, Santino Barnard as her best friend Kenny Bottoms, Drew Powell as Kenny's father George, Lauren Lindsey Donzis as Violet's older sister Maddie, Leonardo Cecchi as Kenny's older brother Harrison, Christoph Sanders as Deputy Terry and Beau Bridges as Mayor Donovan, alongside Oscar Nunez. Rated PG, it runs 87 minutes under the tagline "Solve the crime. Save the season."

A narrator recounts how, a century earlier, the mill town of Pleasant Bay, Oregon, fell on hard times when a drought closed its mill, until on Christmas Eve young Jimmy Stubbins found a strip of golden jingle bells that had fallen from Santa's sleigh and wished for the town's fortunes to be restored. By the next morning the river was flowing again and the mill was reopening. The bells became a symbol of hope, were put on display at the town museum and have been credited with Pleasant Bay's prosperity ever since. In the present, three days before Christmas, the bells are stolen, and the sheriff arrests George Bottoms, who works at the museum and has a past brush with the law, as the only person apparently able to reach them. Mayor Donovan, more concerned about his re-election than the town, is furious. Convinced that George is innocent, Violet, who has absorbed police procedure from watching her father and his bumbling deputy, the mayor's son, sets out with Kenny to find the real thief before Christmas, enlisting Maddie and Kenny's resentful brother Harrison. As the four uncover evidence the police overlooked, a romance grows between the teenagers, and their search leads into the underground tunnels beneath the town.

The film premiered on HBO Max on 24 November 2022. Liz Kocan of Decider recommended it as a sweet, Scooby-gang style whodunnit that turns into a Goonies-like adventure in its last third, praising McGraw's grounded performance, though she felt Bridges deserved a better role. Ricky Valero of Ready Steady Cut called it predictable but cute and enjoyed its score, while Barbara Shulgasser-Parker of Common Sense Media described it as a solid, kid-centred holiday movie.

overview: Adam Jones is a Chef who destroyed his career with drugs and diva behavior. He cleans up and returns to London, determined to redeem himself by spearheading a top restaurant that can gain three Michelin stars.
tagline: Never underestimate a man with everything to lose.
title: Burnt
plot:
Burnt is a 2015 comedy-drama directed by John Wells and written by Steven Knight from a story by Michael Kalesniko. Bradley Cooper stars as Adam Jones, with Sienna Miller as Helene, Daniel Brühl as Tony, Omar Sy as Michel, Matthew Rhys as Reece, Alicia Vikander as Anne Marie, Uma Thurman as the critic Simone and Emma Thompson as Dr. Rosshilde.

Adam was once a two-Michelin-star chef in Paris, but drugs and his temper destroyed his career and his mentor Jean-Luc's restaurant. He sobers up in New Orleans by shucking a million oysters and then arrives in London determined to win a third star. He finds Tony Balerdi, Jean-Luc's former maître d', now managing a London hotel. He also tracks down old colleagues, including Michel, whose restaurant he once sabotaged, and Max, who is just out of prison. Adam arranges for the influential critic Simone to dine at the hotel, and her positive review persuades Tony to rebuild the kitchen and hire Adam on the condition that he submits to weekly drug tests with Dr. Rosshilde. Adam recruits the talented sous-chef Helene by tripling her pay.

Adam bullies his staff without mercy, and a disastrous opening night ends with him humiliating Helene, who quits. Tony persuades her to come back. The relaunch earns good reviews and annoys Adam's rival, Montgomery Reece, and Adam gradually softens, even baking a birthday cake for Helene's daughter, Lily. Then his past catches up with him. He meets his former girlfriend Anne Marie, Jean-Luc's daughter, whom he had abandoned, and enforcers for his old dealer beat him up over an unpaid debt. When two diners he believes are Michelin inspectors arrive, Michel ruins their dishes with cayenne pepper in revenge and leaves. Adam gets drunk and goes to Reece, who comforts him. He then learns that Anne Marie has paid his debt and that the diners were not inspectors after all. Opening up to Helene and finally trusting his team, Adam leads the kitchen through the real inspection, and the restaurant earns its third star.

The Weinstein Company released Burnt on October 30, 2015. Jamie Dornan's scenes were cut during editing. It opened with only $5 million and grossed $36.6 million worldwide against a $20 million budget. Critics praised Cooper but criticized the script. Rotten Tomatoes' consensus described a few spoonfuls of compelling culinary drama lost in a watery goulash of cliché and an unsavory lead.

original_title: The Electrical Life of Louis Wain
overview: The extraordinary true story of eccentric British artist Louis Wain, whose playful, sometimes even psychedelic pictures helped to transform the public's perception of cats forever.
title: The Electrical Life of Louis Wain
plot:
The Electrical Life of Louis Wain is a 2021 biographical drama film directed by Will Sharpe. The movie is based on the life of Louis Wain, a British artist and illustrator who was known for his cat illustrations.

The main themes of the film include:

* Mental health: The movie explores Wain's struggles with depression, anxiety, and bipolar disorder, which significantly impacted his personal and professional life.
* Creativity and inspiration: Despite struggling with mental illness, Wain continued to create art that brought him both joy and financial success. The film highlights the complex relationship between creativity and mental health.
* Identity and self-discovery: As Wain navigates his relationships and career, he grapples with his identity as a gay man in a time when being openly LGBTQ+ was not accepted. The film explores his journey of self-discovery and acceptance.

The movie also touches on the societal pressures and expectations placed on artists during the late 19th and early 20th centuries, particularly for women and those from marginalized communities.

Overall, The Electrical Life of Louis Wain is a poignant exploration of the complexities of mental health, creativity, identity, and self-discovery in the life of a remarkable artist.

overview: Kris Kringle's daughter, Noelle, sets off on a mission to find and bring back her brother, after he gets cold feet when it's his turn to take over as Santa.
tagline: Saving Christmas together? Oh, joy.
title: Noelle
plot:
Noelle is a 2019 American Christmas comedy film produced by Walt Disney Pictures. The movie follows the story of Santa Claus's daughter, Noelle, who must save Christmas when her father becomes too old to continue his duties.

The main themes of Noelle include:

1. Family and Legacy: The movie explores the importance of family and legacy, as Noelle struggles to live up to her father's expectations while also forging her own path. She must balance her desire for independence with her responsibility to carry on her father's work.
2. Self-Discovery: Throughout the story, Noelle undergoes a journey of self-discovery, learning more about herself and her place in the world. She discovers that she has her own unique strengths and talents, which can help her save Christmas.
3. Redemption and Forgiveness: The movie also explores themes of redemption and forgiveness, particularly through the character of Nick, Noelle's love interest. Nick is a former elf who was banished from the North Pole for his misbehavior, but he eventually finds redemption by helping Noelle on her quest.
4. Embracing Change: Noelle encourages viewers to embrace change and not be afraid to try new things. The movie shows that it's okay to make mistakes and learn from them, rather than getting stuck in the past.

Overall, Noelle is a heartwarming story about family, self-discovery, and redemption, with a healthy dose of Christmas magic thrown in for good measure.

overview: In the treacherous frontier city of Samurai Town, a ruthless bank robber is sprung from jail by wealthy warlord The Governor, whose adopted granddaughter Bernice has gone missing. The Governor offers the prisoner his freedom in exchange for retrieving the runaway. Strapped into a leather suit that will self-destruct within five days, the bandit sets off on a journey to find the young woman—and his own path to redemption.
title: Prisoners of the Ghostland
plot:
Prisoners of the Ghostland is a 2021 American-Japanese dystopian Western film directed by Sion Sono from a script by Aaron Hendry and Reza Sixo Safai. Blending the Western with horror and the Japanese swordplay genre known as chanbara, it stars Nicolas Cage, Sofia Boutella, Bill Moseley and Nick Cassavetes, with Tak Sakaguchi as the samurai Yasujiro. It premiered at the 2021 Sundance Film Festival on January 31, 2021, and was released in theaters and on video on demand by RLJE Films on September 17, 2021.

Years after a crash between a prison bus and a truck carrying nuclear waste devastated a region of Japan, a frontier settlement called Samurai Town is ruled by a corrupt Governor who has mixed traditional Japanese culture with the trappings of the American Old West and keeps a harem of adopted "granddaughters". Beyond the town lies the Ghostland, a wasteland inhabited by half-mad outcasts and victims of the contamination. When one of the granddaughters, Bernice, flees the Governor's house and disappears into the Ghostland, the Governor releases Hero, a notorious bank robber imprisoned after a heist in which his partner Psycho murdered innocent bystanders. Hero is sent to bring Bernice back within five days, locked into a bodysuit fitted with explosive charges that will detonate if he harms her, tampers with the suit or runs out of time. As he leaves, a parting gesture of defiance impresses Yasujiro, the Governor's bodyguard, whose own sister is one of the granddaughters. In the Ghostland, Hero is taken to a cult-like enclave of outcasts led by a man named Enoch, and finds Bernice among them, catatonic from trauma. As the clock runs down, an accidental detonation, haunting memories of the robbery and the realization of his own part in the original catastrophe force Hero to reckon with his past, and he must rally the Ghostlanders against the Governor before returning to Samurai Town for a final confrontation.

Critics gave the film mixed reviews. It has a 61% approval rating on Rotten Tomatoes based on 160 reviews, with a consensus that, while far from Sono's most distinctive work, it offers viewers a deliriously gonzo genre mash-up with an explosive performance from Cage, and Metacritic gives it a weighted average score of 53 out of 100.

overview: Set in Las Vegas, the film centers on a man who attends his best friend's bachelor party, unaware of an insidious agenda that plays into hunting humans.
tagline: Do you feel lucky?
title: Hostel: Part III
plot:
Hostel: Part III is a 2011 American horror film directed by Eli Roth and written by Eli Roth and Jason Sudeikis. The movie follows the story of Josh (Derek Richardson), a young man who travels to Eastern Europe with his friends, Sean (Christopher Geere) and Paxton (Jay Hernandez).

The trio arrives in Budapest, Hungary, where they plan to spend their spring break partying and exploring the city. However, things take a dark turn when they stumble upon a mysterious hostel called "El Mariachi" run by a charismatic and sinister host named Mr. Henkel (Rollo Weeks). Unbeknownst to Josh and his friends, El Mariachi is a front for a human trafficking ring that specializes in supplying wealthy clients with young men and women for their twisted entertainment.

As Josh becomes more and more entrenched in the hostel's activities, he begins to realize the true nature of El Mariachi. He befriends a fellow captive named Lorna (Arielle Kebbel), who is being held against her will by Mr. Henkel. Josh and Lorna form a bond, and Josh decides to take matters into his own hands to rescue her and bring down the hostel's operation.

However, things become increasingly complicated when Josh discovers that he has been chosen as the main attraction for a wealthy client's twisted game. The client, known only as "The Collector," is willing to pay top dollar for Josh's services, which include being subjected to various forms of physical and psychological torture.

As the story unfolds, Josh must use all his wits and resourcefulness to survive the hostel's brutal games and ultimately escape. Along the way, he faces off against Mr. Henkel and The Collector in a battle of wills that will determine his fate.

Throughout the film, Roth explores themes of human exploitation, voyeurism, and the darker aspects of human nature. The movie is known for its graphic violence, gore, and dark humor, which have become hallmarks of Roth's style.

Ultimately, Josh manages to outsmart The Collector and escape El Mariachi, but not without scars both physical and emotional. The film ends with Josh reflecting on his experience and the true cost of survival in a world where humanity has been reduced to mere entertainment for the wealthy and powerful.

Overall, Hostel: Part III is a thought-provoking and unflinching exploration of the darker aspects of human nature, with a strong performance from Derek Richardson as the protagonist.

overview: Harry Haft is a boxer who fought fellow prisoners in the concentration camps to survive. Haunted by the memories and his guilt, he attempts to use high-profile fights against boxing legends like Rocky Marciano as a way to find his first love again.
tagline: Some fight to win. He fought to live.
title: The Survivor
plot:
The Survivor is a 2021 biographical drama directed by Barry Levinson from a screenplay by Justine Juel Gillmer, based on Alan Scott Haft's book about his father, the boxer Harry Haft. Ben Foster stars as Haft, with Vicky Krieps, Billy Magnussen, Peter Sarsgaard, John Leguizamo, Danny DeVito and Dar Zuzovsky. It was produced by New Mandate Films, Bron Studios and Creative Wealth Media, with a score by Hans Zimmer.

The story moves between the Holocaust and its aftermath. At Auschwitz, the young Polish Jew Harry survives because the SS officer Dietrich Schneider (Magnussen), after seeing him strike another officer, decides to turn him into a fighter, staging bouts against fellow prisoners for the entertainment and wagers of the camp's officers; winning means food, losing means death. In 1949, Harry is a struggling heavyweight in the United States, still haunted by guilt and obsessed with finding Leah (Zuzovsky), the love he lost before the war. He hopes that a high-profile fight against the rising star Rocky Marciano will make him famous enough for her to find him. He confides his wartime story to the reporter Emory Anderson (Sarsgaard), but when the article is published, members of the Jewish community condemn him as a traitor. Marciano's trainer Charlie Goldman (DeVito) offers him a few days of training at a camp upstate, alongside his trainer Pepe (Leguizamo), so that he will not be destroyed in the ring. Miriam Wofsoniker (Krieps), who works for an agency helping survivors find lost relatives, assists in his search and gradually becomes part of his new life, while memories of the camp, triggered by everyday moments such as fireworks, keep intruding. Harry ultimately loses to Marciano but begins to come to terms with the past.

To play the emaciated prisoner, Foster lost 62 pounds, after which production paused for five weeks so he could regain weight for the postwar scenes. Filming began in February 2019, with locations in Hungary as well as New York and Savannah. The film premiered at the Toronto International Film Festival on 13 September 2021 and debuted on HBO and HBO Max on 27 April 2022. Reviews were positive, with an 86% Rotten Tomatoes rating and a Metacritic score of 71; critics singled out Foster's performance, and RogerEbert.com praised the film's layered characters and humor. It was nominated for the Emmy Award for Outstanding Television Movie.

original_title: 劇場版ポケットモンスター ダイヤモンド&パール 幻影の覇者 ゾロアーク
overview: Ash and his friends must stop a greedy media mogul from using the shape-shifting Zoroark to capture the time-travelling Celebi.
tagline: The fury of Zoroark has been unleashed!
title: Pokémon: Zoroark - Master of Illusions
plot:
Pokémon: Zoroark - Master of Illusions is a 2010 Japanese animated science fiction adventure film produced by OLM, Inc., and TV Tokyo. The movie follows the story of Ash Ketchum and his friends as they try to stop Team Rocket's plans to capture the mysterious Pokémon Zoroark.

The main themes of the movie include:

1. Friendship: The bond between Ash, Pikachu, and their friends is a central theme in the film. They work together to overcome challenges and defeat Team Rocket.
2. Deception: Zoroark's ability to manipulate reality through illusions serves as a metaphor for deception and manipulation. The team must learn to see beyond appearances and trust their instincts to uncover the truth.
3. Power and Corruption: Team Rocket's desire for power and control drives their actions, highlighting the dangers of ambition and greed. In contrast, Ash and his friends use their powers for good, demonstrating the importance of selflessness and responsibility.
4. Identity: Zoroark's unique abilities raise questions about its identity and purpose. The team must come to terms with what it means to be a Pokémon and how to treat others with respect and kindness.

The movie explores these themes through action-packed sequences, heartwarming moments, and thought-provoking character development. Overall, Pokémon: Zoroark - Master of Illusions is an entertaining and engaging film that promotes positive values and encourages viewers to think critically about the world around them.

overview: Lonely, unstable gas station attendant Melinda is tired of being overshadowed by her more confident, outgoing co-worker Sheila. When the gas station is held up at gunpoint by Billy, a desperate man in need of quick cash, Melinda finds an opportunity to make a connection with the robber, regardless of who gets hurt.
tagline: Hell of a night
title: Burn
plot:
Burn is a 2019 American psychological crime thriller with darkly comic elements, written and directed by Mike Gan. It stars Tilda Cobham-Hervey, Suki Waterhouse, Harry Shum Jr., Shiloh Fernandez and Josh Hutcherson. Originally titled Plume, the film was shot in March 2018 and released by Momentum Pictures on August 23, 2019.

Melinda is an attendant working the graveyard shift at a gas station alongside Sheila, a coworker who mocks and bullies her. Melinda harbors a crush on Liu, a friendly police officer who stops by for coffee, and secretly photographs him, which only gives Sheila more ammunition. Later that night a man named Billy, who has parked a stolen car outside, holds up the store at gunpoint. Disappointed by the small amount in the register, he is surprised when Melinda volunteers to empty the safe for him and then asks to leave with him. When Billy refuses and Sheila provokes him, the robbery spirals out of control. He drags Sheila into the back room and beats her, Melinda intervenes by throwing a pot of hot coffee in his face, and in the struggle his gun goes off, killing Sheila, before Melinda knocks him unconscious with a fire extinguisher. Billy wakes up tied to a chair while Melinda calmly mops the blood, and it quickly becomes clear that she is far more unstable and dangerous than she first appeared. Over the rest of the night she tries to cover up what has happened, turning away a demanding customer, lying to Sheila's boyfriend Perry when he comes looking for her, facing down a group of bikers searching for Billy and deflecting the suspicions of Liu when he returns after recognizing the stolen car. Realizing she cannot erase the surveillance footage, Melinda starts dousing the store with gasoline, but Billy has slipped free of his restraints, and the night descends into a deadly game of cat and mouse.

Burn received mixed reviews from critics. On Rotten Tomatoes it holds a 50% approval rating based on 12 reviews, and Metacritic gives it a score of 50 out of 100, indicating "mixed or average reviews". Commercially the film made little impact, grossing nothing in North America and only about $25,000 in other territories.

overview: This true story begins on a weekday morning in a peaceful suburb of Akron, Ohio, the town awakens to discover that Rachel Turner and her son, Evan, have been brutally murdered during the night. A short while later, Danny Turner is found in his car at the bottom of a ravine, after having taken his own life.
tagline: A story of evil, hope, and the afterlife.
title: The Ravine
plot: This true story begins on a weekday morning in a peaceful suburb of Akron, Ohio, the town awakens to discover that Rachel Turner and her son, Evan, have been brutally murdered during the night. A short while later, Danny Turner is found in his car at the bottom of a ravine, after having taken his own life.

overview: Based on the 1836 standoff between a group of Texan and Tejano men, led by Davy Crockett and Jim Bowie, and Mexican dictator Santa Anna's forces at the Alamo in San Antonio, Texas.
tagline: You will never forget
title: The Alamo
plot:
The Alamo is a 2004 American war film depicting the 1836 siege of the Alamo in the Texas Revolution, directed by John Lee Hancock, who wrote the screenplay with Stephen Gaghan and Leslie Bohem. Dennis Quaid plays Sam Houston, Billy Bob Thornton Davy Crockett, Jason Patric Jim Bowie and Patrick Wilson William B. Travis, with Emilio Echevarría as the Mexican president Santa Anna.

In 1835, Houston, trying to attract settlers to Texas, meets Crockett, who has just lost his seat in Congress. Texas has risen against Mexico, and after the rebels take San Antonio de Béxar and the Alamo mission, Santa Anna marches north to crush the revolt. The quarrelsome provisional government strips Houston of command, and he tells Bowie to go to San Antonio, destroy its fortifications and fall back east. Instead, the government sends Travis to Béxar, where the departing commander leaves him in charge. Knowing the garrison cannot hold against the Mexican army, Travis appeals repeatedly for reinforcements as small groups of volunteers trickle in. Crockett arrives hoping to revive his political career. After a punishing forced march, Santa Anna appears much sooner than expected, on 23 February, and the Texans retreat into the Alamo.

During the siege, Bowie's parley with a Mexican general is cut short when Travis fires a cannon at the enemy camp, and the defenders reject Santa Anna's offer of surrender. Santa Anna orders that no quarter be given and has his band play the "Degüello" as a signal. As Bowie lies bedridden with illness, Travis takes sole command. Before dawn on Sunday, 6 March, Mexican troops storm the walls at heavy cost and kill most of the defenders, including Travis and Bowie. Crockett, the last survivor, is captured and defiantly offers to escort Santa Anna to Houston if he surrenders; the general has him executed. Houston leads a long retreat, but when Santa Anna divides his army to chase him, Houston launches a surprise afternoon attack near the San Jacinto River, where the Texans rout the Mexican troops and take Santa Anna prisoner. In exchange for his life, Santa Anna agrees to withdraw his forces and recognise Texan independence. The film closes with Crockett's spirit playing his fiddle on the Alamo walls.

Ron Howard, first set to direct, stayed on as executive producer. Released by Buena Vista on April 9, 2004, the film was a major box-office failure, grossing $25.8 million on a $107 million budget. Reviews were mixed to negative.

overview: Chris crashes into a carload of other young people, and the group of stranded motorists is soon lost in the woods of West Virginia, where they're hunted by three cannibalistic mountain men who are grossly disfigured by generations of inbreeding.
tagline: It's the last one you'll ever take.
title: Wrong Turn
plot:
Wrong Turn is a 2003 American slasher film directed by Rob Schmidt and written by Alan B. McElroy, starring Desmond Harrington, Eliza Dushku, Emmanuelle Chriqui, Jeremy Sisto and Kevin Zegers. The first installment of the Wrong Turn series, it was conceived as a 1970s-style horror film and produced by Summit Entertainment with Constantin Film, with creature effects designed by Stan Winston. It follows a group of people stalked by deformed, inbred, cannibalistic mountain men in the forests of West Virginia.

After two college students are killed while rock climbing in a remote stretch of woods, medical student Chris Flynn, driving through the mountains to a business meeting, is held up by a traffic jam. Rather than wait, he gets directions to a back road from an unhelpful old gas station owner and turns onto Bear Mountain Road, where he crashes into a car stranded by barbed wire laid deliberately across the pavement. The car belongs to five friends on a camping trip: Jessie, Carly, Scott, Evan and Francine. Evan and Francine stay with the vehicles while the others look for help, but both are soon killed by unseen attackers. Chris, Jessie, Carly and Scott stumble onto an isolated cabin full of human remains and are forced to hide when its occupants, three cannibal brothers known as Three Finger, Saw Tooth and One Eye, return carrying Francine's body. After escaping, the survivors are hunted through the forest, coming across the cars of earlier victims and seeking refuge in an old watchtower, from which they radio for help. The cannibals set the tower ablaze, and in the chase through the trees and along a waterfall the group is steadily whittled down. With Jessie captured and taken back to the cabin, an injured Chris must find a way to rescue her and escape the mountain men's territory.

Despite grossing $28.7 million worldwide against a $12 million budget, Wrong Turn received mixed reviews. On Rotten Tomatoes, 41% of 82 critics' reviews are positive, with a consensus calling it an unremarkable slasher that fails to distinguish itself from others of its ilk. The film launched a franchise of sequels and a 2021 reboot.

overview: After leaving Washington D.C. hospital, plastic surgeon Ben Stone heads for California, where a lucrative practice in Beverly Hills awaits. After a car accident, he's sentenced to perform as the community's general practitioner.
tagline: He was headed to Beverly Hills to be a plastic surgeon... but he took an exit to a town that didn't take plastic.
title: Doc Hollywood
plot:
Doc Hollywood is a 1991 American romantic comedy film directed by Michael Caton-Jones. The movie follows Dr. Ben Stone, a young and arrogant doctor who is forced to return to his small hometown in Georgia after being involved in a hit-and-run accident.

The main theme of Doc Hollywood revolves around the clash between the old-fashioned values of the protagonist's hometown and the modern world he left behind. As Dr. Stone navigates his way through the complexities of small-town life, he is forced to confront his own arrogance and learn to appreciate the simplicity and authenticity of the people around him.

The film also explores themes of identity, community, and redemption. Through Dr. Stone's journey, the movie shows how one can find a sense of belonging and purpose in a place that may not be perfect but has a certain charm and character. The story is also infused with elements of romance, as Dr. Stone finds himself drawn to the local diner owner, Mona.

One of the most significant themes of Doc Hollywood is the idea of finding one's true self. As Dr. Stone navigates his way through the challenges of small-town life, he begins to realize that there is more to life than just being a successful doctor. The movie suggests that it's never too late to change and find a new path in life.

Overall, Doc Hollywood is a heartwarming film that explores themes of identity, community, and redemption, with a healthy dose of humor and romance.

overview: In an effort to avoid paying off a massive gambling debt to a notorious mobster in England, a couple flees to Los Angeles and hatch a jewel theft plot.
tagline: And it won't be their last
title: The Con Is On
plot:
The Con Is On, developed under the title The Brits Are Coming, is a 2018 heist comedy directed by James Oakley, who co-wrote it with Alex Michaelides. Uma Thurman and Tim Roth play a pair of British con artists, with Maggie Q, Sofía Vergara, Alice Eve, Parker Posey, Crispin Glover and Stephen Fry in supporting roles.

Harriet "Harry" Fox and her husband Peter are London grifters; Harry gambles, and Peter drinks and uses cocaine. After they lose a large sum connected to a botched deal, they owe money to Irina, a dangerous gangster, and they flee to Los Angeles to hide and plan their next move. There they meet Sidney, an old friend who is a corrupt priest with a sideline in shady jobs. He offers them work transporting a shipment of opium, but he also tips off Irina about the price on their heads. Peter learns that Irina's grudge is personal: she has feelings for Harry and despises him.

Hiding in a luxury Beverly Hills hotel, Peter runs into his ex-wife Jacky. She is now married to Gabriel, a film director who is cheating on her with both Gina, a relative of Jacky's, and Vivienne, a fiery actress demanding that he leave his wife. Jacky's blue gemstone ring, worth about £5 million, gives the Foxes an idea: they will steal it and use it to pay off Irina. They have a forger make a copy so they can swap the rings at a dinner party at Jacky and Gabriel's mansion, but a drunken Gabriel and Vivienne ruin the plan. When Irina tracks them to the hotel, the couple hide at the mansion, where Harry poses as a dog whisperer. Gabriel wins Best Director at an awards show and declares Vivienne his true love in his acceptance speech, which causes a furious fight at home. Jacky throws the ring away, and it lands in Harry's wine glass. After a shootout with Irina and her henchman, Harry wounds the gangster and hands her a ring; at the airport, Harry realizes the rings were mixed up. The couple board a flight to Brazil, penniless but free of their debt.

Casting took place in 2015. Although the story is set in Los Angeles, it was shot in Manhattan and Yonkers, New York. Lionsgate released the film in limited theaters and on video on demand on May 4, 2018. Reviews were poor, and none of the six critics counted by Rotten Tomatoes gave it a positive review. The Los Angeles Times enjoyed its stylish first half, its martini-dry dialogue and Thurman's comic turn but disliked the rest. RogerEbert.com gave it one and a half stars.

overview: Michael Harding returns home from military school to find his mother happily in love and living with her new boyfriend, David. As the two men get to know each other, Michael becomes more and more suspicious of the man who is always there with a helpful hand. Is he really the man of her dreams or could David be hiding a dark side?
tagline: Daddy's home
title: The Stepfather
plot:
The Stepfather is a 2009 American psychological horror film directed by Nelson McCormick. It remakes the 1987 film of the same name, which was loosely inspired by the crimes of mass murderer John List, and is the fourth film in the series. Dylan Walsh plays the title character, with Sela Ward as Susan Harding, Penn Badgley as her son Michael, Amber Heard as Michael's girlfriend Kelly and Jon Tenney as Susan's ex-husband Jay.

In a Utah suburb, a man named Grady Edwards shaves his beard, dyes his hair and removes colored contact lenses before leaving behind the bodies of his wife and three children. Police link the murders to a similar massacre in New Jersey. In Oregon, recently divorced mother Susan Harding meets a charming widower who calls himself David Harris, and they rush into an engagement. Her eldest son, Michael, returns from military school and becomes suspicious, especially when David gets the name of his late daughter wrong and keeps the basement cabinets locked.

David kills anyone who threatens his new identity. A neighbor who saw a TV profile of a serial killer resembling him is pushed down her basement stairs and smothered. He quits his job with Susan's sister Jackie rather than show identification. When Jay questions his past, David kills him with a vase and a plastic bag and then uses Jay's phone to text Michael that everything checks out. When Jackie plans to hire an investigator, he drowns her in her pool. Ignoring Kelly's attempts to distract him with college plans, Michael breaks into the basement and finds his father's body in a freezer before David knocks Kelly out and locks him in. David's identity begins to crack in front of Susan, and he asks, "Who am I here?" She flees to the bathroom and stabs him in the neck with a shard of mirror. He gets up again and chases the family into the attic. He and Michael fall from the roof. Michael wakes from a month-long coma to learn that David escaped. In the final scene, under the new name Chris Ames, he meets a woman shopping with her two sons at a hardware store.

Terry O'Quinn, star of the original, reportedly declined a cameo. Filming ended in April 2008, and Sony Pictures released the film on October 16, 2009. It opened fifth with $11.6 million and grossed $31.2 million against a $20 million budget. Critics were largely negative, and Rotten Tomatoes called it a tepid remake that lacks the original's tension and satire, though the Los Angeles Times praised its craft and performances.

overview: Best friends Marie and Alexia decide to spend a quiet weekend at Alexia's parents' secluded farmhouse. But on the night of their arrival, the girls' idyllic getaway turns into an endless night of horror.
tagline: Hearts will bleed.
title: High Tension
plot:
