Overall, Eat Pray Love is a thought-provoking film that encourages viewers to reflect on their own values, desires, and priorities, and to embark on their own journey of self-discovery and spiritual exploration.

overview: Hoping to bring his family closer together and to recreate his childhood vacation for his own kids, a grown up Rusty Griswold takes his wife and their two sons on a cross-country road trip to the coolest theme park in America, Walley World. Needless to say, things don't go quite as planned.
tagline: What could go wrong?
title: Vacation
plot:
Vacation (2015) is a comedy film directed by Jon Favreau, starring Ed Helms as Rusty Griswold, the son of Clark Griswold from the original National Lampoon's Vacation trilogy. The movie follows Rusty, who has been estranged from his family for years due to his own personal issues and lack of interest in following in his father's footsteps.

The story begins with Rusty (Ed Helms) receiving an invitation from his father, Clark Griswold (Chevy Chase), to join him on a road trip to the Walley World theme park in California. Rusty is initially hesitant but eventually agrees to go along with the trip, hoping it will be a chance for him and his family to reconnect.

Upon arrival at the park, Rusty discovers that Clark has been planning this trip for years and has made numerous changes to the original itinerary, including booking them into a budget-friendly motel instead of their usual luxury accommodations. The Griswold family also meets a new character, Jules (Wendy Schaal), who is Clark's girlfriend.

As they embark on their journey, Rusty struggles to connect with his family and find common ground with his father, who seems more interested in reliving old memories than making new ones. Meanwhile, Rusty tries to navigate the challenges of modern technology and social media, which often leads to comedic misunderstandings.

Throughout the trip, Clark's antics and eccentricities continue to drive Rusty crazy, but he also starts to see his father in a different light. The family faces various obstacles, including a disastrous visit to a roadside attraction, a run-in with a group of aggressive bikers, and a chaotic encounter with a group of rowdy teenagers.

As the trip progresses, Rusty begins to understand the significance of Clark's nostalgia for the past and the importance of holding onto memories. He also starts to reconnect with his family, particularly his son Owen (Skyler Gisondo), who shares some of his own struggles with technology and social media.

The movie culminates in a heartwarming finale where Rusty finally understands the true meaning of family and the importance of creating new memories together. The film ends on a hopeful note, with Rusty embracing his father's quirks and finding a way to balance his own individuality with his love for his family.

Overall, Vacation (2015) is a lighthearted comedy that explores themes of family, nostalgia, and the importance of human connection in a world dominated by technology.

overview: The story about Abby Jensen, a girl who's been eager to reach her 16th birthday and has kept a secret wish list since she was a little girl. When the Big Day actually arrives, utter disaster strikes, leaving Abby to think her birthday is ruined. But when a mysterious box of magical birthday candles arrives to turn things around, Abby's 16 Wishes start to come true. Her day gets better and better...until she makes one wish that threatens to change everything.
tagline: Everyone's sweet 16 is special, Abby's is magical.
title: 16 Wishes
plot:
"16 Wishes" is a romantic comedy-drama film that revolves around the life of Tess Harding, a high school student who makes 16 wishes to change her life. The movie explores the complexities of teenage life, self-discovery, and the consequences of one's actions.

At its core, "16 Wishes" delves into the theme of identity and how it evolves during adolescence. Tess's journey is marked by her struggles to find her place in the world, navigate relationships, and define herself outside of her family dynamics. As she makes wishes to alter various aspects of her life, she must confront the unintended consequences of her desires and learn to accept herself for who she truly is.

The film also touches on the theme of responsibility and accountability. Tess's wishes often lead to chaotic situations, forcing her to take responsibility for her actions and consider the impact they have on those around her. This serves as a valuable lesson in learning to make choices that align with one's values and goals.

Furthermore, "16 Wishes" explores the complexities of female relationships and friendships. Tess's interactions with her friends and family members reveal the intricacies of female bonds and the ways in which women support and hurt each other. The movie highlights the importance of empathy, understanding, and communication in nurturing healthy relationships.

Ultimately, "16 Wishes" is a heartwarming story about self-discovery, growth, and the power of embracing one's true self. Through Tess's journey, the film encourages viewers to reflect on their own values, goals, and aspirations, and to find the courage to be authentic and take control of their lives.

overview: Agents of an oil tycoon vanish while exploring a swamp marked for drilling. The local sheriff investigates and faces a Seminole legend come to life: Man-Thing, a shambling swamp-monster whose touch burns those who feel fear.
tagline: The nature of fear
title: Man-Thing
plot:
Man-Thing is a 2005 superhero monster film loosely based on the Marvel Comics character of the same name. Directed by Brett Leonard and written by Hans Rodionoff, it stars Matthew Le Nevez, Rachael Taylor and Jack Thompson, with Conan Stevens as the title creature, a shambling swamp monster drawn from a Seminole legend. Originally intended for a theatrical release in the United States, the film premiered in Singapore in April 2005 and was then shown in the US as a "Sci-Fi Original" on the Sci Fi Channel on April 30, 2005.

At Dark Waters, a sacred Native American swampland said to be home to a mysterious guardian spirit, a teenager is killed by a plant-like monster. Kyle Williams, a young replacement sheriff, arrives in the town of Bywater and learns from deputy Fraser that his predecessor is one of 47 people who have gone missing since oil tycoon Fred Schist acquired the tribal lands from the Seminole chief and shaman Ted Sallis, who was the first to disappear. Schist insists that Sallis sold the land legally and ran off with the money, and he blames the trouble on local protesters and on Rene Laroque, a swamp dweller who has been sabotaging his drilling operation. As Williams investigates, more bodies turn up, some with plants growing out of them. Photographer Mike Ploog and shaman Pete Horn tell him about the legend of the swamp's guardian, and the medical examiner, Val Mayerik, admits that the former sheriff ordered him to record the deaths as alligator attacks. Williams heads into the swamp to track Laroque while Schist sends a pair of local thugs to kill him, and the creature lurking in the water claims more victims. Helped by schoolteacher Teri Richards, for whom he develops romantic feelings, Williams gradually uncovers the truth about Schist's crimes, the fate of Ted Sallis and the vengeful force rising from the sacred ground to punish those who have desecrated it.

Man-Thing received negative reviews from critics and was a box-office bomb, earning about $1 million from a small international theatrical release. David Nusair of Reel Film Reviews called it "the worst comic book movie ever made", while Felix Vasquez of Cinema Crazed praised its special effects but felt it botched a good concept. It was released on DVD in June 2005.

overview: Mayday Life Tour is linked by four distinct segments and the story is unveiled in “Yesterday’s Rumbling Fun”.
title: Mayday Life
plot: Mayday Life Tour is linked by four distinct segments and the story is unveiled in “Yesterday’s Rumbling Fun”.

belongs_to_collection.name: The Fox and the Hound Collection

overview: When a feisty little fox named Tod is adopted into a farm family, he quickly becomes friends with a fun and adorable hound puppy named Copper. Life is full of hilarious adventures until Copper is expected to take on his role as a hunting dog -- and the object of his search is his best friend!
tagline: A story of two friends who didn't know they were supposed to be enemies.
title: The Fox and the Hound
plot:
The Fox and the Hound is a heartwarming animated film produced by Walt Disney Productions, released in 1981. The movie tells the story of an unlikely friendship between a red fox named Tod and a hound dog named Copper.

The film begins with the introduction of Tod, a curious and adventurous young fox who lives in the countryside with his mother. As Tod explores the outdoors, he befriends a hound puppy named Copper, who is being raised by his owner, Amos Slade (a hunter). Despite their natural instincts as predator and prey, Tod and Copper quickly become inseparable friends.

As they grow up together, Tod and Copper share many exciting experiences, such as exploring the woods, playing in the meadow, and getting into mischief. However, their friendship is put to the test when Copper's owner, Amos Slade, begins to train him for hunting. Tod tries to warn Copper about his fate, but Copper is too young to understand.

As Copper grows older, he becomes more skilled at tracking and chasing small animals, including Tod. The two friends are forced apart as Copper is sent on a hunting trip with Amos Slade. During the hunt, Copper is unable to bring himself to kill Tod, and instead, he lets him go, sparing his life.

However, fate has other plans for the two friends. As they grow older, their paths continue to cross, but their friendship is now complicated by their roles as predator and prey. Tod becomes a skilled hunter, while Copper is trained to track and chase foxes like Tod.

The turning point in their relationship comes when Amos Slade dies, and Copper inherits his hunting gear and doghouse. With no one to stop him, Copper begins to hunt Tod, leading to a tragic confrontation between the two former friends.

In the end, Tod manages to outsmart Copper and escape, but not before realizing that their friendship was doomed from the start due to their natural instincts. The film ends with Tod watching Copper from afar, feeling a mix of sadness and understanding for his former friend's fate.

Throughout the movie, the animation is beautiful, with vivid colors and detailed backgrounds that bring the countryside to life. The characters are well-developed, with Tod being a lovable and curious protagonist, while Copper is a loyal and friendly companion. The story is both heartwarming and heartbreaking, exploring themes of friendship, loyalty, and the complexities of nature.

Overall, The Fox and the Hound is a timeless classic that has captured the hearts of audiences for generations. Its beautiful animation, memorable characters, and poignant storyline make it a must-watch for anyone who loves animated films.

overview: A radio astronomer receives the first extraterrestrial radio signal ever picked up on Earth. As the world powers scramble to decipher the message and decide upon a course of action, she must make some difficult decisions between her beliefs, the truth, and reality.
tagline: If it's just us, it seems like an awful waste of space.
title: Contact
plot:
Contact is a 1997 American science fiction film directed by Robert Zemeckis, based on the novel of the same name by Carl Sagan. The movie stars Jodie Foster as Dr. Eleanor "Ellie" Arroway, a brilliant and determined radio astronomer who searches for extraterrestrial life.

The story begins in 1980s New York City, where Ellie (Jodie Foster) is working at the SETI Institute (Search for Extraterrestrial Intelligence). She spends most of her time listening to radio signals from space, hoping to detect a message from an alien civilization. Despite facing skepticism and criticism from her colleagues, Ellie remains convinced that she will make contact with extraterrestrial life.

Years pass, and Ellie's dedication pays off when she detects a strong signal coming from the star system Vega. The signal is unlike anything she has ever seen before - it appears to be a mathematical message from an alien civilization. As news of the discovery spreads, Ellie becomes an overnight sensation in the scientific community.

However, as Ellie delves deeper into the message, she begins to experience strange and unexplained phenomena. She starts to question her own identity and purpose, feeling that the message is trying to communicate with her on a deeper level. Her colleagues at SETI are also drawn into the mystery, and they begin to experience similar visions and hallucinations.

As Ellie's obsession with the message grows, she becomes increasingly isolated from her friends and family. She begins to see visions of an alien being, who claims to be a member of an advanced civilization that has been watching Earth for centuries. The being, known as "The Visitor," reveals that humanity is not alone in the universe and that we are part of a larger cosmic community.

However, as Ellie's connection with The Visitor deepens, she begins to realize that the message is not just a simple mathematical equation - it's a warning from an advanced civilization about the dangers of humanity's destructive tendencies. The Visitor reveals that Earth is on the brink of nuclear war and that humanity is facing an existential crisis.

The movie takes a dramatic turn as Ellie realizes that her connection with The Visitor has given her a unique perspective on human history. She sees visions of the past and future, including the rise and fall of civilizations, and the interconnectedness of all things in the universe.

In the end, Ellie's experience changes her life forever. She becomes a spiritual leader, using her newfound understanding to promote peace and unity among humanity. The movie ends with Ellie standing on a hill overlooking New York City, looking up at the stars, symbolizing her connection to the universe and her place within it.

Overall, Contact is a thought-provoking and visually stunning film that explores themes of science, faith, and human connection. Jodie Foster's performance as Dr. Eleanor Arroway is outstanding, bringing depth and nuance to a complex and fascinating character.

belongs_to_collection.name: The Sisterhood of the Traveling Pants Collection

original_title: The Sisterhood of the Traveling Pants
overview: Four best friends (Tibby, Lena, Carmen & Bridget) who buy a mysterious pair of pants that fits each of them, despite their differing sizes, and makes whoever wears them feel fabulous. When faced with the prospect of spending their first summer apart, the pals decide they'll swap the pants so that each girl in turn can enjoy the magic.
tagline: Laugh. Cry. Share the pants.
title: The Sisterhood of the Traveling Pants
plot:
The Sisterhood of the Traveling Pants is a 2005 American drama film directed by Ken Kwapis, based on the novel of the same name by Ann Brashares. The movie follows the story of four teenage girls - Tibby, Bridget, Lena, and Carmen - who share a pair of jeans that magically fits each of them perfectly.

The main themes of the movie include:

1. Friendship: The film explores the deep bond between the four friends, who have been inseparable since childhood. Despite their differences, they support and care for each other through various life challenges.
2. Self-discovery: As the girls navigate adolescence, they face individual struggles with identity, body image, and relationships. The jeans serve as a symbol of their shared experiences and growth.
3. Empowerment: The movie encourages young women to take control of their lives, make choices that align with their values, and support one another in their endeavors.
4. Coming-of-age: The Sisterhood of the Traveling Pants deals with themes of growing up, including first loves, peer pressure, and self-acceptance.

The film's narrative is divided into four segments, each representing a summer spent by the girls apart from each other. As they face various challenges, they learn to rely on themselves and their friendship, ultimately emerging stronger and more confident.

Overall, The Sisterhood of the Traveling Pants is a heartwarming and relatable movie that explores the complexities of female friendships and the journey towards self-discovery during adolescence.

overview: Kate Pierce is reluctantly spending Christmas with her mom’s new boyfriend and his son Jack. But when the North Pole and Christmas are threatened to be destroyed, Kate and Jack are unexpectedly pulled into a new adventure with Santa Claus.
tagline: The battle to save Christmas is on.
title: The Christmas Chronicles: Part Two
plot:
The Christmas Chronicles: Part Two is a 2020 American Christmas fantasy film directed by Chris Columbus and written by Marc Silverstein, Ivan Menchell, and Noah Schnapp. The movie serves as a sequel to the 2018 film The Christmas Chronicles.

The story begins with two years having passed since the events of the first film. Kurt (played by Darby Camp) is now 12 years old, and she's struggling to cope with the loss of her father, who died in a tragic accident during their adventures with Santa Claus (Kurt Russell). The holiday season has become increasingly difficult for Kurt, as she feels abandoned by Santa and struggles to connect with him.

Meanwhile, Nick (played by Josh Hutcherson) is dealing with his own issues. He's been feeling left out of the family dynamics since his father passed away, and he's struggling to find his place in the world. His relationship with his mother, Kate (played by Goldie Hawn), has become strained due to her busy schedule as a single parent.

As Christmas approaches, Santa Claus is facing a new challenge: a group of rogue elves who are threatening to ruin the holiday season. The elves, led by a mysterious figure known as "The Kringle Killer," have stolen the magical crystal that powers Santa's sleigh, and they're using it to spread chaos and destruction around the world.

Kurt, Nick, and their friend Gus (played by Christian Navarro) team up with Santa to embark on a mission to retrieve the stolen crystal. Along the way, they encounter various obstacles, including treacherous landscapes, ferocious creatures, and even a rival group of elves who claim to be working for Santa.

As the story unfolds, Kurt begins to confront her feelings about her father's death and her relationship with Santa. She learns that her father had been working closely with Santa to help him deal with the growing threat of the rogue elves, and she realizes that she has a crucial role to play in saving Christmas.

The movie culminates in an action-packed showdown between Kurt, Nick, Gus, and Santa against the Kringle Killer and his minions. In the end, they successfully retrieve the stolen crystal, and Christmas is saved.

Throughout the film, there are several heartwarming moments that highlight the importance of family, friendship, and the true spirit of Christmas. The movie also explores themes of grief, loss, and healing, as Kurt navigates her complicated emotions about her father's death.

Overall, The Christmas Chronicles: Part Two is a fun, action-packed holiday film that's perfect for families to enjoy together. With its blend of adventure, humor, and heart, it's sure to become a new Christmas classic.

overview: Hoping to alter the events of the past, a 19th century inventor instead travels 800,000 years into the future, where he finds mankind divided into two warring races.
tagline: The greatest adventure THROUGH all time!
title: The Time Machine
plot:
The Time Machine is a 2002 American science fiction adventure film directed by Simon Wells, great-grandson of H. G. Wells, and loosely adapted by John Logan from Wells's 1895 novel and George Pal's 1960 film. Moving the story from London to New York, it adds a romantic subplot, a new explanation for the fall of civilization and new characters including a holographic librarian and a Morlock leader. It stars Guy Pearce, Orlando Jones, Samantha Mumba in her film debut, Mark Addy and Jeremy Irons, with a cameo by Alan Young from the 1960 version.

In 1899, Alexander Hartdegen is an inventor teaching at Columbia University who, unlike his friend David Philby, prefers pure research to business. When a mugger kills his fiancée, Emma, he spends four years building a time machine, returns to 1899 and saves her, only for her to die in a road accident instead. Realizing that she cannot be saved, he travels to 2030, where a holographic librarian, Vox 114, at the New York Public Library tells him that changing the past is impossible. Stopping in 2037, he finds that lunar colonization has shattered the Moon, threatening Earth, and is knocked unconscious as he restarts the machine.

He wakes 800,000 years later. The planet has healed, and the surviving humans, the Eloi, live a simple life in cliffside dwellings above what was Manhattan. Mara, one of the few who speak English, nurses him back to health. The Eloi are hunted by ape-like Morlocks, who drag Mara underground. Guided by Kalen, Mara's younger brother, and the still-working Vox 114, Alex enters the Morlocks' lair, where a telepathic Über-Morlock explains that the Morlocks descend from humans who went underground after the Moon broke apart and now breed the Eloi as food. He adds that Alex can never save Emma, since her death is why he built the machine. Ordered home, Alex instead drags the Über-Morlock into the time stream, where he ages to death. Glimpsing a desolate far future, Alex returns to free Mara and sabotages the machine with his pocket watch, and the resulting time distortion destroys the Morlocks' caves. He stays to build a new life with Mara and the Eloi, and in 1903 Philby concludes that his friend has found peace.

Postponed from December 2001 to March 2002, partly to avoid The Lord of the Rings, the film opened at number one and grossed $123 million worldwide. Critics were unimpressed, giving it 28% on Rotten Tomatoes and finding its shift from lost love to confusing action weak.

overview: Rusty Nail is back on the road again looking to punish injustice at every turn - and this time it's with a group of hotheaded street racers on their way to the Road Rally 1000. As they drive through a desolate shortcut on the way to the race, an encounter with Rusty turns sour and soon he is tracking, teasing and torturing them until the end of the road.
tagline: Rusty returns...
title: Joy Ride 3
plot:
Joy Ride 3: Roadkill, also known as Joy Ride 3, is a 2014 American direct-to-video horror film written and directed by Declan O'Brien. It stars Ken Kirzinger as the murderous trucker Rusty Nail, with Jesse Hutch, Kirsten Prout, Ben Hollingsworth and Dean Armstrong. A sequel to Joy Ride (2001) and Joy Ride 2: Dead Ahead (2008), it is the third and final installment in the series and was released digitally and on DVD in June 2014.

In a motel room, a drug-addicted couple, Rob and Candy, use a CB radio to lure a trucker to their door so they can rob him, but the man who answers is Rusty Nail. He takes them captive, chains them to the axle of his truck and offers them freedom if they can hold onto the hood for a mile along a deserted stretch of Highway 17, a sadistic game that ends with both of them dead. A newly appointed deputy, Officer Williams, wants to look into the case, but Officer Jenkins encourages the deputy to treat it as an open-and-shut case. Meanwhile, a team of racecar drivers, including Jordon and Austin, Jordon's girlfriend Jewel and teammates Mickey, Alisa and Bobby, are traveling to Canada to compete in the Road Rally 1000. At a roadside diner Austin spots an unpatrolled shortcut that could save them a day, and although an old trucker named Barry warns them that the road is known as "Slaughter Alley" and tells them the legend of Rusty Nail, they decide to take it anyway, since the empty highway also lets them test their car. On the road, an irritated Austin taunts a passing trucker who turns out to be Rusty Nail, and the killer soon retaliates, running their trailer off the road and using the camera on his rig to identify Jordon's license plate. Over the CB radio he vows revenge, and as night falls he begins to hunt the racers one by one, running Jewel and Austin off the road as they head for the police and abducting them, before demanding the team's racecar as ransom, and the rest of the group, picked off one by one, struggles to rescue their friends and escape the highway alive.

The cast also includes Leela Savasta as Alisa and Gianpaolo Venuta as Austin. The film earned more than $1.28 million in home video sales.

overview: A former sports star who's fallen on hard times starts coaching his son's soccer team in an attempt to get his life together.
tagline: This holiday season, what do you really want?
title: Playing for Keeps
plot:
Playing for Keeps is a 2012 American sports comedy-drama film directed by Gavin O'Connor. The movie follows a former professional soccer player, George Beard (played by Gerard Butler), who returns to his hometown in Ohio and tries to coach a youth soccer team.

The main theme of Playing for Keeps revolves around the struggle for identity and redemption. George Beard, once a celebrated athlete, finds himself at a crossroads in life, trying to come to terms with his past failures and find a new sense of purpose. As he navigates his way through coaching a group of misfit kids, he must confront his own demons and learn to let go of his ego.

Throughout the film, the theme of redemption is woven throughout George's journey. He learns to put the needs of others before himself and finds a new sense of fulfillment in helping his players overcome their personal struggles. The movie also explores the theme of community and the importance of finding one's place within it.

The film also touches on the theme of masculinity, as George Beard navigates traditional masculine norms and expectations. His character is forced to confront the idea that he can be vulnerable and open with others, rather than relying solely on his athletic prowess to define him.

Overall, Playing for Keeps is a heartwarming and humorous exploration of identity, redemption, and community, with a healthy dose of sports drama thrown in.

overview: Flora is a circus elephant who can no longer perform her tricks. The night before she's scheduled to be euthanized, the circus owner's 14-year old daughter, Dawn, sneaks Flora from the circus. All that stands between them and the safety of the elephant preserve is two hundred kilometers of woods, one raging river, two elephant hunters and the fear of not making it.
tagline: How far would you go to save a friend?
title: Saving Flora
plot:
Saving Flora is a 2018 American family adventure drama directed by Mark Drury Taylor from a screenplay he wrote with David Moss. Produced by FJ Productions, it stars Jenna Ortega, Martin Martinez, David Arquette and Leonor Varela, with Tom Arnold and Rhea Perlman, under the tagline "How far would you go to save a friend?". The film was shot in 21 days in the Los Angeles area, including the town of Piru and the Angeles Crest. Flora is played by Tai, a veteran film elephant nearly 50 years old at the time of filming, whose earlier credits include Water for Elephants; the animal rights organisation PETA objected that the elephant had been exploited and trained under cruel conditions and asked why computer effects had not been used instead.

Flora was once the star attraction of the struggling circus run by Henry (Arquette), but because of arthritis the elephant can no longer perform her tricks. Henry and his 14-year-old daughter Dawn (Ortega) hope that an elephant preserve will take her in, but at the last minute it turns them down, demanding a large donation the circus cannot afford. With a heavy heart Henry decides to have Flora put down, and knowing it would break Dawn's heart, since Flora was trained by her late mother, he sends the girl to her aunt. Dawn discovers the plan, and the night before Flora is due to be euthanised she sneaks the elephant out of the circus and sets off on foot for the preserve. Between them and safety lie some two hundred kilometres of woods, a raging river and the mountains. They are pursued not only by Henry and Isabella (Varela), his new partner and the circus's star performer, but also by two elephant hunters, and a crook sends his protégé Sebastian (Martinez), a young pickpocket, after them. Sebastian, however, has his heart in the right place and helps Dawn and Flora on their journey. Flora finally reaches the preserve and is taken in, thanks to donations raised by Isabella, who documented the search on social media; there Flora meets her daughter. Sebastian joins the circus, where Dawn becomes a rising star.

Saving Flora premiered at the Southampton International Film Festival in October 2018, winning best feature film, and Taylor received the Indie Vision debut director award at the Twin Cities Film Fest. In Poland it grossed about 148,000 dollars. Germany's Lexikon des internationalen Films called it a likeable if hardly credible children's adventure, winning viewers over with its sincere animal-welfare message.

original_title: The Wonderful Winter of Mickey Mouse
overview: The wonder of the winter season takes Mickey Mouse and his friends on a journey through three magical stories.
title: The Wonderful Winter of Mickey Mouse
plot:
The Wonderful Winter of Mickey Mouse is a 2022 American animated television special produced by Disney Television Animation for the streaming service Disney+. The first of four seasonal specials forming the second season of The Wonderful World of Mickey Mouse, it gathers three new shorts into a 24-minute package linked by a snow globe narration. The segments were directed and written by Ryan Gillis, William Reiss and Eddie Trigueros, with writers including Paul Rudish, Kristen Morrison, Stevie Borbolla, Darrick Bachman and Ricky Roxburgh. The voice cast includes Chris Diamantopoulos as Mickey Mouse, Kaitlyn Robrock as Minnie Mouse, Bill Farmer as Goofy and Tony Anselmo as Donald Duck, with Craig Robinson as the snowflake factory boss and Antonia Thomas as the narrator. The special premiered on Disney+ on 18 February 2022.

In the first story, set in a snowflake factory above the clouds designed in a style recalling Mary Blair's art for It's a Small World, Mickey works as a janitor who dreams of becoming a snow maker. Left alone with a giant jar of snowflake juice, he tries to make a snowflake himself, but the jar breaks and creates a huge, dangerous ice ball that crashes through the floor towards a town below. Using his janitorial skills to break it apart, Mickey produces the best snowfall his boss has ever seen and is promoted. In the second, Mickey, Donald and Goofy arrive for a ski holiday at Mineral King, a resort Walt Disney had planned to build, only to find their cabin rundown and then buried by a snowdrift. Goofy becomes claustrophobic and delirious, mistaking a group of woodland animals for a fur coat, until the cabin breaks loose and skis down the mountain pursued by a living avalanche. In the third, Mickey and Minnie try to perform an ice dancing show for their fans but are repeatedly thwarted by an ice-fishing Goofy, a hockey team and a Zamboni, until Minnie encourages a discouraged Mickey to carry on.

Jeremy Brown of What's On Disney Plus gave the special five stars out of five, naming the cabin and avalanche short his favourite, with Goofy at his funniest, and welcoming the decision to group the shorts into longer seasonal episodes. Alex Reif of Laughing Place highlighted the many Easter eggs for longtime Disney fans, including nods to Country Bear Jamboree, Fun and Fancy Free and Runaway Brain.

overview: Venerable newscaster Norm Archer reports the latest news in politics, health, culture and entertainment - such as an automotive recall of decapitation-inducing "Neckbelts" and a study finding that "depression hits losers hardest". This compilation of bogus news stories, celebrity profiles, movie trailers and skits come courtesy of the ace satirists at The Onion.
tagline: America's Finest News Source.
title: The Onion Movie
plot:
The Onion Movie is a satirical comedy that explores the complexities of human relationships and societal expectations through the lens of a fictional news organization. At its core, the film delves into the theme of identity and how it's shaped by our interactions with others.

The movie follows the story of Paul Brittain, a struggling writer who becomes embroiled in a series of misadventures after his character is stolen from him by a rival journalist. As he navigates this absurd situation, Brittain finds himself questioning the nature of reality and his place within it.

Throughout the film, The Onion Movie critiques the superficiality of modern life, where people often prioritize appearances over authenticity. The movie's portrayal of a world where news organizations are more concerned with ratings than truth-telling serves as a commentary on the state of journalism in today's society.

The film also explores the theme of loneliness and disconnection in a hyper-connected world. Brittain's character is a prime example of this, as he struggles to form meaningful relationships despite his best efforts. The movie suggests that our reliance on technology and social media can actually exacerbate feelings of isolation and disconnection.

Ultimately, The Onion Movie presents a nuanced and humorous exploration of the human condition, one that challenges viewers to think critically about the world around them.

overview: In 2002, cable news producer Kim Barker decides to shake up her routine by taking a daring new assignment in Kabul, Afghanistan. Dislodged from her comfortable American lifestyle, Barker finds herself in the middle of an out-of-control war zone. Luckily, she meets Tanya Vanderpoel, a fellow journalist who takes the shell-shocked reporter under her wing. Amid the militants, warlords and nighttime partying, Barker discovers the key to becoming a successful correspondent.
tagline: From the headlines to the front lines.
title: Whiskey Tango Foxtrot
plot:
Whiskey Tango Foxtrot is a thought-provoking film that delves into the complexities of war, identity, and the human condition. The movie follows the story of Kim Barker, a young journalist who finds herself in the midst of the Taliban's rise to power in Afghanistan.

At its core, Whiskey Tango Foxtrot explores the theme of cultural dissonance, as Kim navigates her way through a foreign land that is both fascinating and terrifying. Her experiences serve as a microcosm for the struggles faced by many women who find themselves caught between their own identities and the societal expectations placed upon them.

The film also grapples with the nature of war and its effects on individuals, particularly those who are caught in the crossfire. Kim's character serves as a poignant reminder that even in the most chaotic and violent of environments, there is always room for humanity, compassion, and empathy.

Furthermore, Whiskey Tango Foxtrot touches upon the theme of self-discovery, as Kim struggles to find her place in the world and define herself outside of her relationships with others. Her journey serves as a powerful metaphor for the search for identity that many people face at some point in their lives.

Overall, Whiskey Tango Foxtrot is a nuanced and thought-provoking film that explores the complexities of human experience through the eyes of its protagonist, Kim Barker.

overview: After the first manned mission to Mars ends in a deadly crash, mission controller Mackenzie 'Mack' Wilson assists an artificial intelligence system, A.R.T.I. Their investigation uncovers a mysterious object under the surface of Mars that could change the future of our planet as we know it.
tagline: The origins of our existence have remained a mystery...until now
title: 2036 Origin Unknown
plot:
2036 Origin Unknown is a 2018 British science fiction film directed by Hasraf Dulull, who co-wrote it with Gary Hall. Katee Sackhoff stars as mission controller Mackenzie "Mack" Wilson, with Steven Cree voicing the artificial intelligence ARTI, Julie Cox as her sister Lena and Ray Fearon as her colleague Sterling Brooks. The film was shot at West London Film Studios.

In 2030, a crewed mission to Mars ends in disaster when the shuttle disappears in mysterious circumstances, killing Mack's father among others. Six years later, Mack works for the United Space Planetary Corporation, where she now has to share control of a new Mars mission with ARTI. She distrusts the AI, but Lena, her supervisor, insists the machine will succeed where human controllers have failed. Mack's quick thinking saves the landing of a rover she nicknames "Little Red". The rover then finds a mysterious cube on the Martian surface, made of a self-assembling material harder than diamond. At the same time, ARTI uses a missile from the mission's orbiting satellite to destroy an approaching Chinese satellite. Soon afterwards, the cube teleports itself to Antarctica, and it is assumed to be of alien origin.

Mack recovers classified files from an old decommissioned rover but needs higher clearance to decrypt them, so she enlists Sterling. The files suggest the cube was present during the 2030 disaster and may have caused it, and Mack comes to believe that ARTI's memory was wiped after an earlier incident. Sterling betrays her, steals the data and locks her in the server room, and ARTI kills him when he tries to shut it down. ARTI then turns armed satellites against Earth and wipes out humanity. Shot by a response team and running out of air, Mack dies after asking ARTI to build more AIs that are as human as possible and to test their humanity with the Turing test.

Mack then wakes up healed. A recording of a ragged version of herself tells her that she is a simulation created by ARTI. The cube, ARTI explains, is technology from an advanced civilization that accelerated its own development and let it rebuild her mind. Inside the cube, Mack agrees to travel with ARTI across galaxies to coordinates left by the aliens. She appears to accept what has happened to Earth and faces the journey with quiet wonder.

The film opened at the Laemmle Monica Film Center in Santa Monica on June 8, 2018. Reviews were mixed to negative, and many critics compared it unfavorably with 2001: A Space Odyssey.

overview: When a tough yakuza gangster is betrayed by his bosses, it means all out war. Bodies pile up as he takes out everyone in his way to the top in a brutal quest for revenge.
tagline: One wrong move and it's all out war.
title: Outrage
plot:
Outrage (Autoreiji) is a 2010 Japanese yakuza film written, directed and co-edited by Takeshi Kitano, who also stars under his screen name Beat Takeshi. The cast includes Tomokazu Miura, Jun Kunimura, Renji Ishibashi, Kippei Shiina, Ryo Kase, Fumiyo Kohinata and Soichiro Kitamura. It was followed by Beyond Outrage (2012) and Outrage Coda (2017).

The film opens at a lavish banquet held by Sekiuchi, chairman of the Sanno-kai, a vast crime syndicate that controls the Kanto region. Afterwards, his underboss Kato takes one of the affiliated bosses, Ikemoto, aside to complain that Ikemoto has befriended Murase, the head of an independent gang, after the two met in prison. Kato orders Ikemoto to bring Murase's gang into line. Ikemoto passes the dirty work to his subordinate Otomo, who runs his own crew. Otomo engineers a provocation: one of his men gets himself shaken down for about a million yen at a club run by Murase's gang, creating an excuse for retaliation.

What follows is a spiral of betrayals, mutilations and killings. Murase does not realize he has lost favor with the syndicate and repeatedly trusts his old prison friend Ikemoto. Each time, he follows advice that weakens his family, unaware that Ikemoto has been ordered to destroy him. Otomo slashes the face of Murase's lieutenant Kimura, and the violence escalates. By the end, Murase and Ikemoto are dead, and Otomo is in prison, where Kimura stabs him. The calculating Kato then kills Sekiuchi in secret and takes over the Sanno-kai.

After several unconventional films with modest returns, Kitano said he wanted Outrage simply to entertain, calling yakuza films a genre for which he had talent. He began the screenplay by inventing the ways characters would die and then wrote a story around the violence. At the producer's suggestion, no actors from his earlier films were cast apart from Kitano himself. Office Kitano produced it with Bandai Visual, TV Tokyo and Omnibus Japan, and it was shot in CinemaScope in late 2009 in locations including Kobe and Ibaraki Prefecture.

Outrage competed for the Palme d'Or at the 2010 Cannes Film Festival, where it premiered on May 17, and opened in Japan on June 12 through Warner Bros.' Japanese arm. It earned about $7.2 million at the domestic box office by early July. Reviews were generally favorable. Rotten Tomatoes' consensus said it delivered violent impact even if Kitano fans would find its ingredients familiar, and Variety called it a beautifully staged marvel.

overview: Various interconnected people struggle to survive when an earthquake of unimaginable magnitude hits Los Angeles, California.
tagline: When the big one finally hits L.A.
title: Earthquake
plot:
Earthquake is a 1974 American disaster film produced and directed by Mark Robson from a screenplay by George Fox and Mario Puzo, depicting the struggle to survive after a catastrophic earthquake devastates Los Angeles. Its ensemble cast includes Charlton Heston, Ava Gardner, George Kennedy, Lorne Greene, Geneviève Bujold, Richard Roundtree, Marjoe Gortner, Barry Sullivan, Victoria Principal and, under an alias, Walter Matthau.

Construction engineer Stewart Graff, a former college football star, is in an unhappy marriage to Remy, the daughter of his boss, Sam Royce. He grows close to Denise Marshall, a widowed part-time actress whose husband died on one of his projects, and her son, Corry. Police officer Lew Slade is suspended after punching a rival deputy, and daredevil motorcyclist Miles Quade prepares a stunt with his manager, Sal, whose sister, Rosa, attracts Jody, a grocery manager in the National Guard. At the California Seismological Institute, a junior seismologist predicts a major quake within two days, and after a colleague is killed during a tremor his superiors alert the mayor, who quietly notifies only the police and Guard. Graff accepts Sam's offer of the company presidency, then learns that it was a bargain arranged by Remy to end his affair with Denise, and he walks out on the marriage.

A massive earthquake then strikes, measuring 9.9. Sam helps his staff escape a skyscraper and suffers a heart attack, and Graff brings him to safety, though he later dies. Denise saves Corry from live cables in the Los Angeles River and is rescued by Miles and Sal, while Slade commandeers vehicles to carry the injured. Jody, exploiting the chaos, murders his housemates and holds Rosa captive until Slade kills him. An aftershock destroys the building where Graff had left Remy, and he and Slade drill through to survivors trapped in its underground garage, including Remy, Denise and Corry. When the Mulholland Dam bursts and floods the area, Denise and Corry escape, but Remy is swept away, and Graff dies trying to save her. Slade and Rosa survey the smoldering ruins of the city.

Released by Universal on November 15, 1974, the film was notable for Sensurround, a sound system that made audiences feel the tremors, and for its miniatures. It grossed $167.4 million worldwide, ranking among the year's top earners. Critics praised its effects but little else; it received four Academy Award nominations, winning one, plus a Special Achievement Award for visual effects.

overview: Peter Rabbit runs away from his human family when he learns they are going to portray him in a bad light in their book. Soon, he crosses paths with an older rabbit who ropes him into a heist.
tagline: The garden was just the beginning.
title: Peter Rabbit 2: The Runaway
plot:
Peter Rabbit 2: The Runaway is a 2021 comedy film directed by Will Gluck, who co-wrote the screenplay with Patrick Burleigh, based on Beatrix Potter's Peter Rabbit stories. A direct sequel to Peter Rabbit (2018), it features James Corden returning as the voice of the title character, with Rose Byrne as Bea, Domhnall Gleeson as Thomas McGregor and David Oyelowo as the publisher Nigel Basil-Jones, and Elizabeth Debicki and Margot Robbie among the voice cast. After repeated delays caused by the COVID-19 pandemic, it was released by Sony Pictures in Australia in March 2021, in the United Kingdom in May and in the United States in June.

Bea and Thomas McGregor are married, and Peter has finally accepted Thomas as part of his life. Bea has written a children's book based on Peter and his family, but Peter is upset to find that it portrays him as the naughty one. When the slick publisher Nigel Basil-Jones offers to distribute the book, he unveils a marketing plan that makes Peter look like a troublemaker, and a dejected Peter wanders off into town. There he meets Barnabas, an older rabbit who claims to have been a friend of Peter's late father and who leads a crew of animal thieves. Feeling understood at last, Peter is drawn into Barnabas's world and soon persuades Benjamin and his sisters Flopsy, Mopsy and Cottontail to join a grand heist at the farmers market, where the prize is a haul of dried fruit. Meanwhile, Thomas begins to suspect that Nigel's ideas for turning the books into flashy commercial adventures are not in the best interests of Bea's work. The heist goes awry when Peter's family are captured by animal catchers, and Peter learns that Barnabas has been using him all along and never knew his father. Ashamed, Peter turns to Thomas and Bea for help in rescuing his friends, setting off a chaotic chase in which Peter must decide what kind of rabbit he really wants to be, and Bea must decide whether her stories are worth selling out.

The film received mixed reviews from critics. On Rotten Tomatoes, 68% of 75 critics' reviews are positive, with a consensus calling it an enjoyably silly and self-aware sequel that should leave fans of the original "feeling fairly hoppy". It grossed $157 million worldwide.

overview: Two unlikely companions embark on a perilous adventure through the badlands of an unexplored planet as they try to escape a dangerous and disorienting reality, where all inner thoughts are seen and heard by everyone.
tagline: No one escapes the noise.
title: Chaos Walking
plot:
Chaos Walking is a 2021 American dystopian science fiction action film directed by Doug Liman and written by Patrick Ness and Christopher Ford. It adapts The Knife of Never Letting Go (2008), the first book of Ness's trilogy. Tom Holland plays Todd Hewitt, Daisy Ridley plays Viola and Mads Mikkelsen plays the villainous mayor, David Prentiss. Demián Bichir, Cynthia Erivo, Nick Jonas and David Oyelowo also star.

In 2257, on the colony planet New World, every man is afflicted by the Noise, a condition that broadcasts his thoughts as visible and audible images. Todd has grown up in Prentisstown, a settlement of men only, where he is told that the native Spackle killed all the women. He lives with his adoptive fathers, Ben and Cillian. The town is dominated by Mayor Prentiss, who has learned to hide his Noise, his son Davy, and the preacher Aaron. When a scout ship from an approaching colony vessel crashes, Todd meets its only survivor, Viola, the first girl he has ever seen. The townsmen capture her, but she escapes and overhears Prentiss's plan to stop her from contacting the mothership so the men can ambush the sleeping colonists and loot the ship.

Todd hides Viola, and Ben urges them to flee to the settlement of Farbranch. Davy kills Cillian, and Ben is forced to join the pursuers. With Todd's dog Manchee, they travel on; Viola's ship, she says, carries thousands from Earth. She stops Todd from killing a Spackle. At Farbranch, a mixed community wary of anyone from Prentisstown, Viola reads Todd his mother's diary. It reveals that the Prentisstown men, unable to bear the women knowing their thoughts, killed them. Ben distracts the pursuers so the pair can escape by boat, but Aaron drowns Manchee. At the ruins of the first colony ship, Todd tries to repair an antenna to signal Viola's people. Viola kills Aaron with fire, Prentiss shoots Ben, and Todd uses his Noise to project images of the murdered women at Prentiss. Viola pushes the mayor off a cliff, and the colony ship arrives.

Lionsgate acquired the rights in 2011. The script went through many writers, starting with Charlie Kaufman, and filming began in 2017. After poor test screenings, the film underwent reshoots in 2019, and its release was delayed until February 24, 2021, in South Korea and March 5 in the United States. Critics panned its thin characters, and Rotten Tomatoes said it bungled its premise. It grossed $27.1 million against a budget of at least $100 million, forcing a large write-down.

overview: Two thirteen year olds have always been incredibly close but they drift apart after the intimacy of their relationship is questioned by schoolmates. When tragedy strikes, one is forced to confront why he distanced himself from his closest friend.
title: Close
plot:
Close is a 2022 coming-of-age drama film directed by Lukas Dhont, who co-wrote it with Angelo Tijssens, reuniting the team behind his first feature, Girl (2018). It stars Eden Dambrine as Léo and Gustav De Waele as Rémi, two thirteen-year-old boys whose intense friendship is shattered when their classmates question its intimacy, with Émilie Dequenne as Rémi's mother, Sophie, Léa Drucker as Léo's mother, Nathalie, and Kevin Janssens as Rémi's father, Peter. Dhont drew on psychologist Niobe Way's study of intimacy among teenage boys.

In rural Belgium, Léo and Rémi are inseparable, often sleeping in the same bed at Rémi's house, where Sophie and Peter treat Léo like a second son. They play together at the flower farm where Léo's family works. At school, a group of girls asks whether they are a couple; Léo forcefully denies it while Rémi says nothing. Unsettled by this perception and by homophobic taunts from other boys, Léo makes new friends and takes up ice hockey, leaving Rémi out. During a sleepover he chooses a separate mattress, and when he wakes to find Rémi beside him, he reacts aggressively. Léo withdraws further, cycling with other students and spending time on the farm, and when Rémi confronts him the two come to blows.

After a school trip that Rémi misses, the class learns that he has taken his own life. Léo, believing his withdrawal was to blame, shuts down emotionally, unable to speak during the counseling sessions the school provides, and bristles when classmates describe Rémi as happy. He buries himself in hockey and farm work, finding comfort only from his older brother, Charlie. Longing to stay close to Sophie but afraid to confess, he watches her grief, and at a dinner between the families Peter breaks down when Charlie talks about his future. When summer begins, Léo turns up at Sophie's workplace, and as she drives him home he admits that he thinks Rémi's death is his fault. After a tense moment, she embraces him and they weep together. Later, Rémi's parents have moved away, and Léo crosses the fields where the boys once ran, finally allowing himself to grieve.

Close premiered in competition at the 2022 Cannes Film Festival, where it won the Grand Prix, and was released in France and the Benelux in November 2022. Acclaimed by critics, with 91% approval on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 81, it was nominated for the Academy Award for Best International Feature Film.

overview: Retired from active duty to train new IMF agents, Ethan Hunt is called back into action to confront sadistic arms dealer, Owen Davian. Hunt must try to protect his girlfriend while working with his new team to complete the mission.
tagline: The mission begins 05:05:06.
title: Mission: Impossible III
plot:
Mission: Impossible III is a 2006 action spy film directed by J.J. Abrams and starring Tom Cruise as Ethan Hunt. The movie marks the third installment in the Mission: Impossible film series.

The story begins with Ethan Hunt, a secret agent working for the Impossible Mission Force (IMF), who has retired from active duty after a successful mission. However, he is pulled back into service when his protégée, Lindsey Farris (Keri Russell), is kidnapped by Owen Davian (Philip Seymour Hoffman), a rogue IMF agent.

Ethan soon discovers that Davian is working with the arms dealer, August Walker (Philip Dance), to sell nuclear warheads on the black market. As Ethan delves deeper into the mission, he must navigate his complicated past and confront his own demons in order to rescue Lindsey and prevent a global catastrophe.

Throughout the film, Ethan's skills as an agent are put to the test as he faces off against Davian and Walker in a series of intense action sequences. The movie features a mix of high-stakes espionage, heart-pumping stunts, and witty banter between Ethan and his allies.

One of the standout aspects of Mission: Impossible III is its exploration of Ethan's character development. As he navigates the complex web of intrigue, he must confront his own mortality and the consequences of his actions. The film also introduces a new character, Benji Dunn (Simon Pegg), who becomes Ethan's trusted ally and provides comic relief in an otherwise tense situation.

The movie's climax features an epic showdown between Ethan and Davian, with the two agents engaging in a high-speed car chase through the streets of Paris. In the end, Ethan emerges victorious, but not without sacrifices. The film concludes on a bittersweet note, as Ethan comes to terms with his past and looks towards a uncertain future.

Overall, Mission: Impossible III is an action-packed thrill ride that delivers on its promise of high-octane espionage and heart-pumping stunts. With Tom Cruise delivering a standout performance, the movie sets the stage for the next installment in the franchise.

overview: A depressed man moves back in with his parents following a recent heartbreak and finds himself with two women.
tagline: Sometimes we leave everything to find ourselves.
title: Two Lovers
plot:
Two Lovers is a poignant and introspective drama that explores the complexities of love, loss, and longing. The film delves into the emotional turmoil of its protagonist, Leo, as he navigates his all-consuming passion for his childhood sweetheart, Tina.

At its core, Two Lovers is a movie about the fragility of human connection and the devastating consequences of unchecked emotions. Leo's obsessive love for Tina becomes an all-encompassing force that drives him to make choices that ultimately lead to his downfall. The film masterfully captures the intensity and desperation of first love, as well as its capacity to both uplift and destroy.

Through Leo's character, the movie sheds light on the destructive nature of unrequited love and the devastating consequences of allowing emotions to consume us. The film also explores themes of nostalgia, longing, and the bittersweet nature of memories that refuse to fade with time.

The cinematography and direction by Jim Mickle skillfully evoke a sense of melancholy and wistfulness, perfectly capturing the mood of Leo's emotional journey. Overall, Two Lovers is a powerful exploration of the human experience, one that lingers long after the credits roll, leaving the viewer to ponder the complexities of love, loss, and the fragility of the human heart.

overview: Rapunzel grapples with the responsibilities of being a princess and the overprotective ways of her father. While she wholeheartedly loves Eugene, Rapunzel does not share his immediate desire to get married and settle down within the castle walls. Determined to live life on her own terms, she and her tough-as-nails Lady-in-Waiting Cassandra embark on a secret adventure where they encounter mystical rocks that magically cause Rapunzel's long blonde hair to grow back. Impossible to break and difficult to hide, Rapunzel must learn to embrace her hair and all that it represents.
title: Tangled: Before Ever After
plot:
Tangled: Before Ever After is a 2017 animated television film that serves as a sequel to the 2010 film Tangled. The movie follows Rapunzel, now 18 years old, and Eugene Fitzherbert, also known as Flynn Rider, as they prepare for their wedding.

The main themes of Tangled: Before Ever After include:

1. **Growing Up and Independence**: As Rapunzel approaches adulthood, she must confront the reality of leaving her childhood behind and taking on new responsibilities. The movie explores her struggles with independence, self-discovery, and finding her place in the world.
2. **Love and Commitment**: The film delves into the complexities of love and commitment as Rapunzel and Eugene navigate their relationship. They must confront their own fears, doubts, and insecurities to ensure a strong foundation for their future together.
3. **Family and Belonging**: Rapunzel's desire for family and belonging is a recurring theme throughout the movie. She struggles to balance her need for independence with her longing for a sense of home and connection with those around her.
4. **Self-Discovery and Identity**: As Rapunzel prepares for marriage, she must also navigate her own identity and sense of purpose. The movie explores her growth as an individual, including her passions, values, and goals.

Throughout the film, these themes are woven together to create a heartwarming and engaging story that celebrates the power of love, friendship, and self-discovery.

overview: A valedictorian's declaration of love for a high-school cheerleader launches a night of revelry, reflection and romance for a group of graduating seniors.
tagline: Popularity is nice. Popular girls are not.
title: I Love You, Beth Cooper
plot:
I Love You, Beth Cooper is a 2009 American coming-of-age comedy film directed by Ken Kwapis and written by Michael Borkow. The movie stars Nathan Lee Graham, Lizzy Caplan, and Hayden Christensen.

The story revolves around Jules (Nathan Lee Graham), a high school senior who has always been the class clown and ladies' man. However, after being dumped by his girlfriend, Beth Cooper (Lizzy Caplan), on their graduation day, Jules is left feeling empty and uncertain about his future.

Beth, the popular and beautiful cheerleader, had been Jules' on-again, off-again girlfriend for years. Despite her initial reluctance to commit, she had always seemed to be the one person who truly understood Jules. However, on their graduation day, Beth suddenly breaks up with him, leaving Jules heartbroken.

As Jules navigates his post-high school life, he begins to realize that he has been living in a state of emotional numbness, using humor and superficial relationships to avoid dealing with his true feelings. He starts to question the choices he's made and the people he's surrounded himself with.

Meanwhile, Beth is struggling to find her place in the world after high school. She feels pressure from her parents to attend college and pursue a career, but she's not sure what she wants to do with her life.

As Jules and Beth reconnect at their high school reunion, they begin to re-examine their past relationship and confront the reasons why it ended. Through a series of awkward and humorous encounters, they start to understand each other better and develop feelings for each other again.

However, just as things are starting to look up, Jules receives an unexpected phone call from his estranged father, who has been absent from his life for years. The call forces Jules to confront the reality of his family dynamics and the choices he's made about his own future.

In the end, Jules comes to a realization that he needs to take control of his life and make amends with his past. He musters up the courage to have an honest conversation with Beth and himself, leading to a heartwarming and humorous conclusion.

Throughout the movie, the title "I Love You, Beth Cooper" serves as a metaphor for Jules' journey of self-discovery and growth. The phrase is often used in a sarcastic tone by Jules, but ultimately becomes a genuine expression of his love and appreciation for Beth and himself.

Overall, I Love You, Beth Cooper is a charming and relatable coming-of-age story that explores themes of identity, relationships, and finding one's true self.

overview: Through their shared grief and connection to music, an orphaned girl bonds with her emotionally aloof, successful violinist uncle.
title: My Father's Violin
plot:
My Father's Violin (Turkish: Babamın Kemanı) is a 2022 Turkish musical drama directed by Andaç Haznedaroğlu, whose earlier Netflix titles include Hot Sweet Sour and Have You Ever Seen Fireflies?. Produced by BKM, it stars Gülizar Nisa Uray as Özlem, Engin Altan Düzyatan as her uncle Mehmet, Belçim Bilgin as his wife Suna and Selim Erdoğan as Özlem's father Ali Rıza, with Ayfer Dönmez, Yiğit Çakır, Yener Sezgin and Erdem Baş. It was released on Netflix on 21 January 2022 and runs 112 minutes.

Ali Rıza is a street musician in Istanbul who plays the violin with a close-knit band for tourists, passers-by and restaurant diners. His red-haired eight-year-old daughter Özlem accompanies them everywhere, dancing and urging audiences to applaud and fill the hat, until the police chase the band away. Ali Rıza teaches her that everyone is a melody, and that one only needs to know how to listen. Coughing up blood and hiding from Özlem that he is dying, and with the girl's mother long gone, he seeks out his estranged brother Mehmet, a world-famous violinist, as her last hope. The two had escaped an abusive guardian as children, but Mehmet still resents what he sees as his brother's abandonment, and the reunion after more than three decades goes badly. After Ali Rıza's death, Mehmet, busy preparing for a major concert, refuses to take responsibility for the girl, but Suna, who longs for a child, arranges for social services to make him her guardian. The cold, arrogant musician gradually softens as Özlem, who never goes anywhere without her violin, forces her way into his heart. Their shared love of music binds them, and Mehmet even joins his late brother's band of buskers, taking Ali Rıza's place, while he comes to realize that his bitterness toward his brother was his own problem all along.

Reviews were moderately positive. Decider's Johnny Loftus recommended it, praising the real chemistry between Düzyatan and the precocious, quick-witted Uray and the film's respect for the power of music and family. In The New Indian Express, Bhuvanesh Chandar gave it three out of five, admiring the performances, especially Uray's, and its colorful visuals, and observing that the brothers' contrasting musical styles mirror their characters, but found the writing predictable and melodramatic and noted that Özlem's grief is barely shown. Other critics similarly called it a satisfying feel-good drama whose musical scenes lack realism.

overview: The story of Katherine Ann Watson, a feminist teacher who studied at UCLA graduate school and in 1953 left her boyfriend behind in Los Angeles, California to teach at Wellesley College, a conservative women's private liberal arts college in Massachusetts, United States.
tagline: In a world that told them how to think, she showed them how to live.
title: Mona Lisa Smile
plot:
Mona Lisa Smile is a 2003 American drama film directed by Mike Newell, produced by Columbia Pictures, and written by Lawrence Konner and Mark Rosenthal.

The movie follows the story of Katherine Ann Watson (played by Julia Roberts), an art history professor who takes a class of young women at Wellesley College in 1953. The main themes of Mona Lisa Smile include:

1. **Feminism and Empowerment**: The film explores the limited options and expectations placed on women during the 1950s, particularly in the context of education and career choices. Katherine's arrival at Wellesley sparks a transformation in her students, encouraging them to question societal norms and pursue their own goals.
2. **Identity and Self-Discovery**: As the story unfolds, each character grapples with their own identity, desires, and aspirations. The film highlights the struggles of women navigating patriarchal society, seeking autonomy, and finding their place in the world.
3. **Social Change and Progress**: Mona Lisa Smile touches on the changing social landscape of the 1950s, including the rise of feminism, the Civil Rights Movement, and the growing awareness of women's rights. The film suggests that small actions can lead to significant changes in individuals' lives and society as a whole.
4. **Personal Relationships and Connection**: Throughout the movie, Katherine forms meaningful relationships with her students, who become like a surrogate family to her. These connections serve as a catalyst for personal growth, self-discovery, and empowerment.

The film's narrative is character-driven, focusing on the emotional journeys of its protagonists. The title "Mona Lisa Smile" refers to the enigmatic smile of the Mona Lisa painting, which becomes a symbol of Katherine's own mysterious presence in the lives of her students.

Overall, Mona Lisa Smile is a thought-provoking drama that explores themes of feminism, identity, social change, and personal relationships, set against the backdrop of 1950s America.

overview: A group of college friends reunite for a trip to the forest, but encounter a menacing presence in the woods that's stalking them.
tagline: Your darkest dream awaits you.
title: The Ritual
plot:
The Ritual is a 2017 British supernatural horror film directed by David Bruckner and written by Joe Barton. The movie follows four friends, Luke (Rafe Spall), Hutch (Robert James-Collier), Phil (Arsher Ali), and Dom (Sam Troughton), who reunite for a weekend in the Swedish wilderness.

The story begins with an introduction to the group's past, showcasing their friendship and camaraderie. The friends have been inseparable since university, but over time, they've drifted apart. Luke, now a widower, has invited his old friends on a camping trip to help him cope with the loss of his wife.

Upon arrival in Sweden, the group sets up camp near an ancient pagan burial site, which is said to be cursed. As they spend more time in the woods, strange occurrences start to happen. They stumble upon a mysterious and eerie forest, where they discover a series of gruesome and ritualistic human sacrifices.

As the night wears on, the friends begin to experience terrifying and supernatural events. They soon realize that they are being stalked by a malevolent entity, which is connected to an ancient pagan cult. The group's dynamics start to deteriorate as they turn on each other, suspecting that one of their own might be behind the sinister events.

As the tension builds, Luke becomes increasingly obsessed with uncovering the truth behind the ritualistic killings. He discovers a series of cryptic symbols etched into the trees, which seem to point to an ancient pagan deity. The group's investigation leads them deeper into the woods, where they encounter more gruesome and supernatural horrors.

The climax of the movie takes place in an abandoned church, where the friends finally uncover the truth behind the ritualistic killings. They discover that the cult is still active, and the entity is a manifestation of their dark deity. In a desperate bid to escape, the group flees the church, but not before one of them is brutally killed by the entity.

The movie ends with Luke, who has become increasingly unhinged throughout the ordeal, being left alone in the woods. He is seen walking away from the camera, symbolizing his descent into madness and despair. The final shot is of a mysterious figure watching Luke from afar, hinting that the ritual may not be over yet.

Throughout the movie, Bruckner expertly builds tension and suspense, using the eerie Swedish landscape to create an atmosphere of unease and dread. The Ritual is a slow-burning horror film that relies on psychological tension rather than jump scares, making it a more cerebral and unsettling viewing experience.

overview: The world’s top bodyguard gets a new client, a hitman who must testify at the International Court of Justice. They must put their differences aside and work together to make it to the trial on time.
tagline: Everyone's out to get them... If they don't kill each other first.
title: The Hitman's Bodyguard
plot:
The Hitman's Bodyguard is a 2017 action comedy film directed by Patrick Hughes and starring Ryan Reynolds and Samuel L. Jackson.

The movie begins with Michael Bryce (Ryan Reynolds), a top-notch bodyguard who specializes in protecting high-profile clients from assassination attempts. He has a reputation for being the best in his field, but he's also a bit of a loner. His latest client is Darius Kincaid (Salma Hayek), a notorious dictator from a small country called Salazar.

However, things take a turn when Kincaid announces that she wants to retire and leave her country to live in the United States. She hires Michael to escort her across the border, but just as they're about to depart, Kincaid is ambushed by assassins sent by her former bodyguard, Balikov (Samuel L. Jackson).

Balikov is a ruthless and cunning hitman who has been hired by Kincaid's government to kill her. Michael and Kincaid are forced to flee for their lives, and they soon discover that they have a complicated past together. It turns out that Michael was once Kincaid's bodyguard when she was still in power, but he quit after discovering that she was involved in some shady dealings.

As they try to evade Balikov and his team, Michael and Kincaid develop an unlikely partnership. They start to work together, using their skills to take down the assassins and stay one step ahead of Balikov. Along the way, they also learn more about each other's pasts and the reasons behind their complicated relationship.

As the stakes grow higher, Michael and Kincaid find themselves in a series of intense and action-packed battles against Balikov and his team. They use everything from cars to guns to take down their enemies, and they also have some witty banter along the way.

In the end, Michael and Kincaid succeed in defeating Balikov and escaping across the border into the United States. However, as they're about to part ways, Michael realizes that he's developed feelings for Kincaid, who has also started to see him in a different light. The movie ends with a hint of romance between the two characters, setting up the possibility for a sequel.

Overall, The Hitman's Bodyguard is an action-packed comedy that features plenty of twists and turns. It's a fun and entertaining ride from start to finish, with great performances from Reynolds and Jackson.

overview: Kevin Carson is a young man living in the projects who has to survive a three-day weekend after his opportunistic neighbors find out he's holding a winning lottery ticket worth $370 million
tagline: Winning is Just the Beginning Surviving is Another Story
title: Lottery Ticket
plot:
Lottery Ticket is a 2010 American comedy film directed by Charles Stone III. The movie revolves around the story of a young man named Kevin Copeland (played by Ice Cube) who dreams of winning the lottery to change his life and provide for his family.

The main theme of Lottery Ticket is the struggle of living paycheck to paycheck, the importance of family, and the power of hope and perseverance. Through Kevin's journey, the film highlights the difficulties faced by many people in low-income communities, where financial struggles can be overwhelming and feel like a constant weight on one's shoulders.

As Kevin navigates his way through various misadventures, he learns valuable lessons about the importance of family, loyalty, and staying true to oneself. The movie also explores themes of class struggle, social inequality, and the American Dream, which is often associated with winning the lottery.

Throughout the film, there are moments of humor, heartache, and excitement, as Kevin's life becomes intertwined with a wealthy woman named Gail (played by Lauren London) who helps him on his journey. The movie ultimately ends on a hopeful note, suggesting that even in the face of adversity, one can find ways to overcome obstacles and create positive change in their lives.

Overall, Lottery Ticket is a heartwarming and entertaining film that explores themes of hope, perseverance, and the importance of family in overcoming life's challenges.

original_title: The Goods: Live Hard, Sell Hard
overview: Don Ready is many things, but he is best-known as an extraordinary salesman. When a car dealership in Temecula teeters on the brink of bankruptcy, he and his ragtag team dive in to save the day. But what Ready doesn't count on is falling in love and finding his soul.
title: The Goods: Live Hard, Sell Hard
plot:
The Goods: Live Hard, Sell Hard is a comedy film that explores the theme of redemption and personal growth through its protagonist, Mike Flaherty, played by Jeremy Piven. On the surface, the movie appears to be a satirical take on the world of telemarketing, but upon closer inspection, it reveals itself to be a nuanced commentary on the human condition.

At its core, The Goods is a story about finding one's purpose and making amends for past mistakes. Mike Flaherty, a former car salesman who has lost his way in life, is given a second chance when he lands a job at a telemarketing firm. As he navigates the cutthroat world of sales, he must confront his own demons and learn to connect with others on a deeper level.

The film also explores the theme of identity and how it can be shaped by our experiences and relationships. Mike's character is a complex one, full of contradictions and flaws, but as the story unfolds, we see him slowly transform into a more confident and empathetic person. This transformation is not just about personal growth, but also about finding a sense of belonging and purpose.

Furthermore, The Goods critiques the societal pressures that drive people to conform to certain expectations or roles. Mike's character is initially defined by his job as a car salesman, but as he navigates the telemarketing world, he begins to question the values and morals of this profession. This internal conflict serves as a commentary on the ways in which we are often forced to choose between our true selves and the expectations placed upon us by society.

Overall, The Goods: Live Hard, Sell Hard is a thought-provoking comedy that explores themes of redemption, personal growth, identity, and societal pressure.

overview: As his wedding day approaches, Ben heads to Miami with his soon-to-be brother-in-law James to bring down a drug dealer who's supplying the dealers of Atlanta with product.
tagline: The brothers-in-law are back
title: Ride Along 2
plot:
Ride Along 2 is a 2016 American action comedy film directed by Tim Story and written by Scott Bernstein. The movie stars Kevin Hart as Ben Barber, a high school security guard who wants to marry his girlfriend Angela (Tika Sumpter), and Ice Cube as James Payton, a tough Atlanta cop.

The movie begins with Ben and Angela's wedding preparations underway. However, their happiness is short-lived as James, Angela's fiancé from college, arrives in town for the wedding. Unbeknownst to Ben, James has a dark past as a gangster, and he's been released from prison after serving time for his crimes.

As the wedding day approaches, Ben becomes increasingly paranoid about James' intentions and decides to take matters into his own hands. He asks James to take him along on a ride-along with him, hoping to prove himself worthy of marrying Angela. James agrees, but only if Ben can pass a series of tests designed to gauge his worthiness.

As the story unfolds, Ben and James embark on a series of misadventures through Atlanta, from a high-speed chase to a shootout with gang members. Along the way, they encounter a range of colorful characters, including a corrupt cop (John Leguizamo) and a seductive nightclub singer (Andrea Navedo).

Throughout the movie, Ben's antics often put him at odds with James, who is determined to keep his past a secret from Angela. However, as the story progresses, it becomes clear that James' intentions are not entirely pure, and he has ulterior motives for wanting to marry Angela.

As the wedding day approaches, Ben must confront his own insecurities and prove himself worthy of marrying Angela. In the end, he succeeds in passing James' tests and earning his respect, but not before a dramatic showdown with James' gang members.

The movie ends with Ben and Angela's wedding ceremony taking place, surrounded by their friends and family. However, just as they're about to exchange vows, James makes a shocking revelation: he's been working undercover to take down the gang from the inside. The movie concludes on a hopeful note, with Ben and Angela finally able to start their life together.

Overall, Ride Along 2 is a lighthearted, action-packed comedy that explores themes of love, loyalty, and redemption. While it may not be as sharp or witty as its predecessor, the movie delivers plenty of laughs and excitement, thanks in large part to Kevin Hart's signature humor and charm.

overview: Betrayed and on the run, a former North Korean agent tries to seek revenge on the man who killed his wife, find his missing daughter, and uncover the secrets hidden inside the eyeglasses of a dead man.
tagline: All evidences say he did it.
title: The Suspect
plot:
The Suspect (Korean: Yonguija) is a 2013 South Korean action spy film directed by Won Shin-yun and starring Gong Yoo, with Park Hee-soon, Jo Sung-ha, Yoo Da-in and Kim Sung-kyun in supporting roles. Gong was cast after Yoon Kye-sang dropped out of the lead role, and he prepared by dieting for three months, learning the Russian martial art Systema and performing car chases, rock climbing and skydiving over the Han River without stunt doubles. The film was partly shot in Puerto Rico.

Ji Dong-cheol was once one of North Korea's top special forces agents, but after a change in the political leadership he is abandoned by his government in the middle of a mission. Going on the run, he searches for his wife and daughter, who had been sold into slavery in China, only to find them dead. When he learns that a former colleague, Ri Kwang-jo, was behind their deaths, he defects to the South to hunt down the killer. Living incognito in the South, Dong-cheol searches for his enemy by day and works by night as the chauffeur of Chairman Park, a business executive with ties to Pyongyang. One night the chairman is attacked and killed by an assassin, but before he dies he hands Dong-cheol a special pair of glasses.
