There they find Zed, a hacker who knows about the secret United Nations agency behind their capture and who helps them locate the elderly Carl. Learning that the aliens are due to return to British Columbia within days, the group travels to Carl's remote cabin to meet them, with Graves and his agents closing in and Isaac beginning to discover that his encounter has changed him in ways he never expected.

Proximity received poor reviews. On Rotten Tomatoes it has a 38% approval rating based on 24 reviews. Sheri Linden of The Hollywood Reporter found the film good-looking and technically well crafted but felt it struggled to get past pastiche and create an involving world of its own, while Ed Fortune of Starburst argued that the problem was the story itself, which he found too long.

overview: A week in the life of Paterson, a poet bus driver, and his wife Laura, a very creative artist, who live in Paterson, New Jersey, hometown of many famous poets and artists.
title: Paterson
plot:
Paterson is a poignant and contemplative film that explores the quiet beauty of everyday life through the eyes of its titular character, Paterson, a bus driver and poet living in Paterson, New Jersey. The movie delves into the themes of routine, creativity, and the human desire for connection.

At its core, Paterson is a meditation on the monotony of daily life, where the protagonist finds solace in his mundane routine as a bus driver. However, this routine is also what allows him to observe the world around him with a sense of wonder and curiosity. The film highlights the beauty in the ordinary, finding meaning in the small moments and interactions that often go unnoticed.

The movie also explores Paterson's passion for poetry, which serves as an outlet for his emotions and thoughts. His love for words and language is a source of comfort and inspiration, allowing him to express himself in ways that feel authentic and true. Through Paterson's poetry, the film conveys the importance of creative expression in our lives, highlighting its ability to capture the complexities of human experience.

Furthermore, Paterson grapples with the theme of loneliness and isolation, as his character navigates the challenges of modern life. Despite being surrounded by people, Paterson often feels disconnected from others, leading him to seek solace in his own thoughts and creative pursuits. This sense of disconnection serves as a catalyst for his introspection and self-discovery.

Ultimately, Paterson is a film about finding meaning and purpose in our lives, even in the most mundane of circumstances. It celebrates the beauty of routine, creativity, and human connection, offering a nuanced and thought-provoking exploration of what it means to be alive.

overview: Four young men who belong to a supernatural legacy are forced to battle a fifth power long thought to have died out. Another great force they must contend with is the jealousy and suspicion that threatens to tear them apart.
tagline: Only the power of Hell can help them.
title: The Covenant
plot:
The Covenant is a 2006 American supernatural horror film directed by Renny Harlin and written by Michael Robert Johnson. The movie follows two brothers, Sam (played by Hill Harper) and Jake (played by Morris Chestnut), who discover that they are the chosen ones destined to save humanity from an ancient evil.

The main themes of The Covenant include:

1. **Destiny vs. Free Will**: The film explores the idea of destiny versus free will, as the two brothers struggle with their predetermined roles in saving humanity. This theme is central to the plot and raises questions about the nature of fate and personal choice.
2. **Brotherly Love and Sacrifice**: The bond between Sam and Jake is a key aspect of the story, as they work together to fulfill their destiny. Their relationship is tested by the demands of their mission, leading to a poignant exploration of brotherly love and sacrifice.
3. **Good vs. Evil**: The Covenant features an epic battle between good and evil, with the two brothers facing off against an ancient, powerful entity known as the "Archon." This theme serves as a backdrop for the story, highlighting the importance of courage, loyalty, and selflessness in the face of overwhelming odds.
4. **Self-Discovery**: As Sam and Jake navigate their destinies, they are forced to confront their own identities and purposes. This theme is particularly relevant to Sam, who struggles with his role as a chosen one and grapples with feelings of inadequacy and doubt.

Overall, The Covenant is a thought-provoking film that explores complex themes and ideas through its narrative. While it received mixed reviews from critics at the time of its release, it has developed a loyal fan base over the years, particularly among fans of supernatural horror and fantasy.

overview: When Anna Parisi, an unemployed fine arts painter, is unable to make ends meet, she is hired to become a personal Christmas shopper for Marc, an uptight corporate exec.  As they begin working together, Marc learns that Christmas giving has less to do with the amount of money spent and more to do with the importance of the gift, while Anna discovers she might find success as an artist in a way she never expected.  The best gift of all of course is the love they discover with one another.
title: 12 Gifts of Christmas
plot:
12 Gifts of Christmas is a 2015 American Christmas romantic comedy television film directed by Peter Sullivan, who wrote the screenplay with Lynn Grant Beck and Jennifer Notas Shapiro. Produced by Hybrid and Mayor Entertainment and shot in Salt Lake City and Provo, Utah, it stars Katrina Law and Aaron O'Connell, with Donna Mills as O'Connell's mother. After a premiere in Los Angeles in October 2015, it debuted on the Hallmark Channel on 26 November 2015, drawing 3.14 million viewers, more than any other scripted programme that day, and became a regular part of the channel's Countdown to Christmas season.

Law plays Anna Parisi, a talented painter in New York who is barely making ends meet two weeks before Christmas and considers work as a gift consultant. In a bakery she overhears Marc Rehnquist (O'Connell), a busy, uptight marketing executive, searching for a birthday present for his assistant, and suggests the shop's secret cupcakes. Impressed, Marc hires her as his personal Christmas shopper and hands her a list of twelve names, people in his life to whom he has usually sent impersonal gifts with apologetic cards for his absence. Her first choice, for his friend Graham, seems all wrong to Marc, but when it is delivered by mistake, Graham calls it the best gift Marc has ever given him.

Marc then asks Anna to help with presents for nearly a hundred employees. At the office party she suggests an extra week off between Christmas and New Year, which delights the staff. As they shop together, Marc learns that giving depends less on money than on thought, and Anna helps him reconnect with his family, especially his mother Joyce. Ice skating and a family dinner, to which Anna brings her nieces, draw them closer. The relationship falters when Marc, with her sister's help but without Anna's knowledge, uses one of her paintings, a Santa Claus by the fireplace, in a major advertising campaign, and she accuses him of betraying her trust. Persuaded by her sister that he meant well, Anna hurries to his family on Christmas Eve with a painted family portrait, and Marc tells her she is the best gift of his life.

Reviews ranged widely. Eclectic Pop gave it nine out of ten, praising Law's lively performance and her chemistry with O'Connell, and The Movie Scene's Andy Webb awarded four stars out of five. Film Critics United found the romance unconvincing, while Assholes Watching Movies called it a by-the-numbers Hallmark formula with no surprises.

overview: Phillip is a wealthy quadriplegic who needs a caretaker to help him with his day-to-day routine in his New York penthouse. He decides to hire Dell, a struggling parolee who's trying to reconnect with his ex and his young son. Despite coming from two different worlds, an unlikely friendship starts to blossom.
tagline: Based on a true story.
title: The Upside
plot:
The Upside is a 2017 American comedy-drama directed by Neil Burger and written by Jon Hartmere. It remakes the French film The Intouchables (2011), which was inspired by the friendship between Abdel Sellou and Philippe Pozzo di Borgo. Bryan Cranston plays Phillip Lacasse, a wealthy quadriplegic, and Kevin Hart plays Dell Scott, the paroled ex-convict he hires. Nicole Kidman plays Phillip's assistant Yvonne, with Golshifteh Farahani, Aja Naomi King and Julianna Margulies in supporting roles.

It opens with Dell speeding Phillip through New York in a Ferrari and talking police into a hospital escort. Six months earlier, Dell needs signatures proving he is looking for work to satisfy his parole officer. He walks into Phillip's penthouse during interviews for a live-in caregiver. Phillip, who has lost the will to live and has a strict do-not-resuscitate order, hires the unqualified Dell over Yvonne's objections, partly hoping his carelessness will let him die. Dell is trying to reconnect with his ex-wife Latrice and their son Anthony, to whom he gave a book stolen from Phillip's library. He makes mistakes and quickly collects two of Yvonne's "three strikes", but Phillip protects him. When Phillip struggles to breathe, Dell refuses to let him die.

The two men gradually become friends. Dell takes Phillip out into the city and shares marijuana to ease his nerve pain. Phillip explains that he was paralyzed in a paragliding accident and still grieves for his late wife. He introduces Dell to opera and art, and a neighbor buys Dell's first painting for $50,000. Dell encourages Phillip to meet Lily, a woman he has been writing letters to. When the date goes badly, Phillip lashes out and fires Dell. Some time later, Dell has bought a new home for his family and is building motorized wheelchairs. When the physical therapist Maggie tells him Phillip has sunk into depression, Dell takes him on the speeding drive from the opening scene and then on a paragliding trip, and he reunites Phillip with Yvonne.

The film premiered at the 2017 Toronto International Film Festival but was shelved after the Harvey Weinstein scandal. STX Entertainment and Lantern Entertainment released it on January 11, 2019, and it opened at number one, ending Aquaman's run at the top of the box office. It grossed about $122 million worldwide. Reviews were mixed. Critics praised the chemistry between Cranston and Hart, but Rotten Tomatoes called it preachy and clichéd.

overview: The continuing adventures of Lilo, a little Hawaiian girl, and Stitch, the galaxy's most-wanted extraterrestrial. Stitch, Pleakley, and Dr. Jumba are all part of the household now, but what Lilo and Stitch don't know is that Dr. Jumba brought his other alien "experiments" to Hawaiʻi as well.
tagline: Stitch was Experiment 626...meet the other 625!
title: Stitch! The Movie
plot:
Stitch! The Movie is a 2003 animated science fiction comedy film produced by Walt Disney Television Animation. The movie revolves around the adventures of Lilo, a young Hawaiian girl who adopts a mischievous alien named Stitch.

The main themes of Stitch! The Movie include:

1. **Family and Belonging**: The movie explores the idea of family and belonging through Lilo's journey to find her place in the world. Despite being an outcast, Lilo finds acceptance and love with her eccentric family, including Stitch.
2. **Identity and Self-Acceptance**: Stitch, as a genetically engineered alien, struggles to understand his own identity and purpose. The movie helps him (and Lilo) come to terms with their unique qualities and find self-acceptance.
3. **Loyalty and Friendship**: The film highlights the importance of loyalty and friendship in overcoming adversity. Lilo and Stitch's bond grows stronger as they face challenges together, demonstrating that true friends can accept each other for who they are.
4. **Cultural Heritage and Tradition**: The movie celebrates Hawaiian culture and tradition, showcasing the rich history and values of the islands. Lilo's love for her heritage is a central theme, emphasizing the importance of preserving cultural identity.
5. **Embracing Differences**: Stitch! The Movie promotes acceptance and inclusivity by featuring a misfit character who finds his place in the world despite being different from others. This message encourages viewers to appreciate individuality and diversity.

Overall, Stitch! The Movie is a heartwarming tale that explores themes of family, identity, loyalty, cultural heritage, and self-acceptance, making it a beloved classic among Disney fans.

overview: Giulia and Carlo have been happy together for three years, but Giulia's announcement that she is pregnant sends him into a secret panic. Terrified at his imminent entry into the adult world of irreversible responsibilities, Carlo finds himself tempted by a bewitching 18-year-old girl, Francesca, whom he meets by chance at a wedding. The possibility of one last youthful crazy fling before the impending prison of parenthood proves to be too attractive to resist.
tagline: Love. Sex. Surrender.
title: The Last Kiss
plot:
The Last Kiss (L'ultimo bacio) is a 2001 Italian comedy-drama written and directed by Gabriele Muccino. It stars Stefano Accorsi as Carlo and Giovanna Mezzogiorno as Giulia, with Stefania Sandrelli as Giulia's mother Anna and Martina Stella, in her film debut, as Francesca. Pierfrancesco Favino, Claudio Santamaria and Sergio Castellitto co-star.

In Rome, 29-year-old Carlo has been happily with Giulia for three years. When she tells him she is pregnant, he panics in secret at the prospect of adult responsibilities that can never be undone. At the wedding of his friend Marco, he meets Francesca, a captivating 18-year-old, and is drawn into an intense flirtation with her, tempted by the idea of one last youthful fling while Giulia prepares for the birth of their daughter. Carlo's friends are also facing turning points. Adriano, unhappy in his marriage to Livia, with whom he has a young son, thinks about leaving home. Paolo is grieving his sick father and the end of his relationship with his girlfriend Arianna. Womanizer Alberto drifts from one affair to the next, unable to commit. Meanwhile, Giulia's mother Anna is in crisis with her husband Emilio, a psychologist. She seeks out an old flame, Professor Eugenio Bonetti, only to find that he is in a relationship and has just become a father.

When Giulia sees their friends at a condolence visit after Paolo's father dies, she realizes Carlo lied about where he spent the evening. She forces him to confess, and he admits to meeting Francesca, insisting it was only a kiss. Furious, Giulia throws him out, and he goes to Francesca's house, where they spend the night together. The next morning, he realizes the enormity of what he has done and rushes back to Giulia. She moves in with her parents, who have reconciled. With Anna's help, Carlo slowly wins back her forgiveness, though the closing scene suggests that Giulia may also be open to new encounters.

Muccino originally planned to title the film Non sono pensieri carini but took its final title from a Carmen Consoli song that composer Paolo Buonvino played for him. Consoli also makes a cameo. It stayed in Italian cinemas for six months, earned about €13 million domestically and grossed about $17.8 million worldwide. It won five David di Donatello Awards, including Best Director and Best Supporting Actress for Sandrelli, as well as the World Cinema Audience Award at Sundance in 2002. A US remake followed in 2006 and a sequel, Baciami ancora, in 2010.

original_title: ヱヴァンゲリヲン新劇場版：序
overview: After the Second Impact, Tokyo-3 is being attacked by giant monsters called Angels that seek to eradicate humankind. The child Shinji's objective is to fight the Angels by piloting one of the mysterious Evangelion mecha units. A remake of the first six episodes of GAINAX's famous 1996 anime series. The film was retitled "Evangelion: 1.01" for its home video version and "Evangelion: 1.11" for a release with additional scenes.
title: Evangelion: 1.0 You Are (Not) Alone
plot:
Evangelion: 1.0 You Are (Not) Alone is a 2007 Japanese animated science fiction film directed by Hideaki Anno and produced by Khara, a studio founded by Anno. The film is the first installment of the Neon Genesis Evangelion franchise's re-imagining, also known as "Rebuild of Evangelion."

The story takes place in 2015, three years after the events of the original Neon Genesis Evangelion series. Shinji Ikari, now a teenager, lives with his mother Yui and stepfather Gendo Ikari in Tokyo-3. Shinji's life is marked by loneliness and self-doubt, as he struggles to cope with the trauma of his past.

Shinji's existence changes when he receives a message from NERV, an organization that develops giant humanoid robots called Evangelions, to pilot the Evangelion Unit-01. Gendo Ikari, Shinji's stepfather, is the director of NERV and has been searching for Shinji, who possesses a unique connection to the Evangelion project.

Upon arrival at NERV headquarters, Shinji meets Rei Ayanami, a mysterious and stoic young woman who pilots the Evangelion Unit-00. As Shinji begins his training as an Evangelion pilot, he is forced to confront his emotional baggage and the harsh realities of his new role.

The story takes a dark turn when Shinji's mother, Yui, appears in a vision, revealing that she had been working on the Evangelion project before her death and that Shinji has a crucial role to play in its success. This revelation sets off a chain of events that leads to a catastrophic confrontation with the Angel, Sachiel.

Throughout the film, Anno explores themes of existentialism, psychological trauma, and the human condition. Shinji's struggles to come to terms with his past and find his place in the world are mirrored by the Evangelion Unit-01's own struggle to cope with its programming and purpose.

The climax of the film features a dramatic showdown between Shinji and Sachiel, which ultimately leads to the destruction of Tokyo-3. The ending is intentionally ambiguous, leaving the audience questioning the fate of the characters and the future of humanity.

Evangelion: 1.0 You Are (Not) Alone sets the stage for the Rebuild of Evangelion series, which continues to explore the complexities of Shinji's character and the world of Evangelion. The film's dark and introspective tone has become a hallmark of Anno's style, and its influence can be seen in many other anime productions.

Overall, Evangelion: 1.0 You Are (Not) Alone is a thought-provoking and emotionally charged film that delves into the depths of human psychology and existential crisis. Its exploration of complex themes and characters has made it a cult classic among anime fans worldwide.

overview: After he’s grounded by an injury, a high-flying bachelor is saddled with two wide-eyed orphans as they come face-to-face with the dangers and beauty of the outside world.
tagline: Family can be a wild ride
title: Duck Duck Goose
plot:
Duck Duck Goose (Chinese: 妈妈咪鸭) is a 2018 animated adventure comedy film directed by Chris Jenkins, who wrote the original story and co-wrote the screenplay with Rob Muir, Scott Atkinson and Tegan West. An international co-production between the United States, China and the United Kingdom, it features the voices of Jim Gaffigan as Peng, a self-absorbed swan goose, Zendaya and Lance Lim as the Mandarin duckling siblings Chi and Chao, Greg Proops as the villainous Pallas's cat Banzou, Reggie Watts as the flying squirrel Carl, and Carl Reiner as Larry, a softshell turtle, with Natasha Leggero, Stephen Fry, Craig Ferguson and Diedrich Bader.

Peng is a carefree goose whose reckless attitude irritates Bing, the leader of his flock, which departs on its migration across China while he sleeps. One of his careless stunts separates two ducklings, Chi and Chao, from their own flock as it travels to a fabled place called Pleasant Valley. Seeing Peng drive off the predatory Banzou, the ducklings shelter beside him for the night. Startled to find them, Peng flies off carelessly, crashes into a gong and breaks his wing. Unable to fly and afraid of predators, he decides to use the ducklings as cover while he makes his way back to his flock, and they reluctantly join him.

Through a string of misadventures Peng grows fond of the ducklings, but when they encounter his flock, Chi and Chao discover his selfish motives and the two parties go their separate ways. Peng is knocked out of the sky by Carl, who fits him with a makeshift wing, and he sets off to find the ducklings. They meanwhile reunite with their flock and learn that Pleasant Valley is really a restaurant that cooks ducklings. Peng rescues them, but they are separated again in the escape, and Banzou takes the ducklings hostage. Peng is badly hurt fighting him, and Chi and Chao finish off the cat by launching him into the sky on a rocket. Carrying the weakened Peng through a snowstorm toward the geese's spring, the ducklings use a honk he taught them to summon Jingjing, Peng's love interest, who rescues him. Bing welcomes the ducklings into the flock, along with a newly responsible Peng.

The film opened in China on March 9, 2018. A North American theatrical release planned by Open Road Films for April 2018 was canceled when the company closed, and Netflix released it in North America on July 20, 2018. It grossed about $15.3 million worldwide in its initial run and received negative reviews from critics.

overview: Now a detective-for-hire like her infamous brother, Enola Holmes takes on her first official case to find a missing girl, as the sparks of a dangerous conspiracy ignite a mystery that requires the help of friends — and Sherlock himself — to unravel.
tagline: Go Big. Go Holmes.
title: Enola Holmes 2
plot:
Enola Holmes 2 is a 2022 mystery film directed by Harry Bradbeer from an original screenplay by Jack Thorne, and the sequel to Enola Holmes (2020). Millie Bobby Brown returns as Enola, the teenage sister of Sherlock Holmes, played by Henry Cavill. Louis Partridge, Susie Wokoma, Adeel Akhtar and Helena Bonham Carter reprise their roles, and David Thewlis and Sharon Duncan-Brewster join the cast. Rather than adapting one of Nancy Springer's novels, the story draws on the real matchgirls' strike of 1888 and the labor activist Sarah Chapman.

Enola has opened a detective agency but is not taken seriously in her brother's shadow. A young match factory worker, Bessie, hires her to find her missing sister, Sarah Chapman. The trail leads from the factory, supposedly struck by typhus, to the Paragon Theatre, where Sarah and her friend Mae also worked as dancers. Enola finds a coded love poem that leads her to Mae, who has been stabbed and is dying. Superintendent Grail then accuses Enola of the murder. Sherlock, meanwhile, is stuck on a case of blackmailed officials. Enola goes to a society ball, where her old friend Tewkesbury teaches her to dance, to reach William Lyon, the factory owner's son and Sarah's secret lover. Grail arrests her first. Her mother Eudoria and the suffragette Edith break her out of jail.

Enola realizes that Cicely, a friendly young woman she met at the ball, is in fact Sarah. Sarah, Mae and William had discovered that the workers were dying from white phosphorus poisoning, not typhus, and were planning to expose it. William is murdered before he can act. The Holmes siblings conclude that Treasury Minister Lord McIntyre made a deal with the factory owner to use the cheap, deadly phosphorus. At the Paragon, Enola defeats Grail, who falls to his death. When McIntyre burns the evidence, Enola and Sherlock reveal that his secretary Mira Troy is the mastermind Moriarty, behind both the blackmail and the killings. The matchgirls go on strike, McIntyre is arrested and Moriarty escapes custody. Enola sets up a new office, and Tewkesbury begins courting her.

Filming took place from autumn 2021 to January 2022, including scenes in Hull. Netflix released the film on November 4, 2022, and it topped the service's charts in 93 countries. Reviews were positive, with Rotten Tomatoes' consensus calling it a satisfying sequel that made the job look positively elementary. Brown won Favorite Movie Actress at the 2023 Kids' Choice Awards.

overview: When the crew of the Enterprise is called back home, they find an unstoppable force of terror from within their own organization has detonated the fleet and everything it stands for, leaving our world in a state of crisis.  With a personal score to settle, Captain Kirk leads a manhunt to a war-zone world to capture a one man weapon of mass destruction. As our heroes are propelled into an epic chess game of life and death, love will be challenged, friendships will be torn apart, and sacrifices must be made for the only family Kirk has left: his crew.
tagline: Earth Will Fall
title: Star Trek Into Darkness
plot:
Star Trek Into Darkness is a 2013 science fiction action film directed by J.J. Abrams and written by Roberto Orci and Alex Kurtzman. The movie serves as a sequel to the 2009 film Star Trek, ignoring the events of the original Star Trek series.

The film begins with Captain James T. Kirk (Chris Pine) being court-martialed for his actions in the previous film, which resulted in the destruction of the Klingon ship Khitomer. The Federation is divided over whether to allow Kirk to continue as captain of the USS Enterprise, and he faces a vote of no confidence.

Meanwhile, a terrorist known as Khan (Benedict Cumberbatch) escapes from prison on the planet Sarpeidon, where he was being held for his role in the destruction of the planet. Khan is revealed to be a genetically engineered superhuman who seeks revenge against Kirk, whom he blames for his imprisonment and subsequent death.

As Khan begins to wreak havoc on the galaxy, the Enterprise is sent to investigate. However, they soon discover that Khan has a personal vendetta against Kirk, and that he plans to destroy the Federation unless Kirk agrees to meet with him.

Kirk's first officer, Mr. Spock (Zachary Quinto), is killed by Khan during a confrontation on the planet Sarpeidon. This event sets off a chain reaction of events as Kirk becomes increasingly obsessed with stopping Khan and finding out what happened to his friend.

As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that Khan's true intention is not just to destroy the Federation, but also to prove himself as a superior being. He believes that he can do better than humanity and that he has the right to rule over the galaxy.

Kirk teams up with his old nemesis, Admiral Marcus (Peter Weller), who reveals that Khan was once a human scientist named Dr. Leonard McCoy's friend. However, when Khan discovered that he had the potential to be a superhuman, he became obsessed with the idea of becoming one himself and began experimenting on himself.

Kirk eventually discovers that Khan has created an army of genetically engineered superhumans known as the "Nobunaga" who are loyal only to him. He also learns that Khan's ultimate goal is to destroy the Federation and take its resources for himself.

In a final confrontation, Kirk faces off against Khan on the planet Sarpeidon. However, just as it seems like Kirk has the upper hand, Spock returns from the dead, having sacrificed himself to save his friend. With Spock's help, Kirk is able to defeat Khan and destroy his ship.

The film ends with Kirk reflecting on the events that have transpired and realizing that being a leader means making difficult choices and putting the needs of others before one's own desires. The movie concludes with a sense of closure for the characters, as they move forward into a new era of exploration and discovery.

Overall, Star Trek Into Darkness is an action-packed adventure that explores themes of leadership, loyalty, and the consequences of playing god. While it received mixed reviews from critics, fans of the franchise generally enjoyed the film's thrilling plot and memorable performances from the cast.

overview: When an evil spirit known as Pitch lays down the gauntlet to take over the world, the immortal Guardians must join forces for the first time to protect the hopes, beliefs and imagination of children all over the world.
tagline: You better believe.
title: Rise of the Guardians
plot:
Rise of the Guardians is a 2012 animated fantasy adventure film produced by DreamWorks Animation. The movie takes place in a world where mythical creatures like Santa Claus, the Easter Bunny, the Tooth Fairy, and Jack Frost are real, but they live separate lives, each with their own domain.

The story begins with a young boy named Jack Frost (voiced by Chris Pine), who is struggling to find his place in the world. He's an outcast among humans and mythical creatures alike, as he doesn't quite fit into either category. Meanwhile, the other Guardians are busy preparing for the annual holiday season.

However, a dark force known as Pitch (voiced by Jude Law) threatens to ruin Christmas and the other holidays. Pitch is a malevolent spirit who feeds on children's fears and nightmares, and he seeks to destroy the world of humans and mythical creatures alike.

As Jack Frost navigates his way through this treacherous landscape, he meets Santa Claus (voiced by Alec Baldwin), the Easter Bunny (voiced by Hugh Laurie), the Tooth Fairy (voiced by Isla Fisher), and other Guardians. Together, they form an unlikely alliance to stop Pitch and save Christmas.

Throughout the movie, Jack Frost learns valuable lessons about friendship, belonging, and finding his true purpose in life. Along the way, he also discovers that he has a special connection to the world of humans and mythical creatures, which makes him a unique and powerful ally in the fight against Pitch.

As the story unfolds, the Guardians face numerous challenges and obstacles as they work together to defeat Pitch and save Christmas. The movie features stunning animation, witty humor, and heartwarming moments that make it a delightful treat for audiences of all ages.

Ultimately, the Guardians succeed in defeating Pitch and restoring balance to the world. Jack Frost finds his place among the other Guardians, and he becomes an integral part of their team. The movie ends on a hopeful note, with the Guardians looking forward to a bright future filled with joy, laughter, and adventure.

Overall, Rise of the Guardians is a charming and entertaining film that celebrates the magic of imagination and the power of friendship. With its lovable characters, engaging storyline, and stunning animation, it's a must-see for fans of animated movies and fantasy adventures.

overview: When his wife is kidnapped by terrorists for ransom, veteran war hero Brad Paxton races against the clock to rescue her in a daring and deadly operation that pits him against powerful and dark forces.
tagline: Taking his wife was their last mistake.
title: Redemption Day
plot:
Redemption Day is a 2021 American action thriller directed and co-written by Hicham Hajji. It stars Gary Dourdan as U.S. Marine captain Brad Paxton and Serinda Swan as his wife Kate, with Andy García as Ambassador Williams, Brice Bexter as Younes Laalej, Martin Donovan as Tom Fitzgerald, Robert Knepper as an oil lobbyist, Ernie Hudson and Samy Naceri as the terrorist leader Jaafar El Hadi. Saban Films distributed it.

Brad, still haunted by his combat tour in Syria, lives in New York with Kate, an archaeologist, and their daughter. Kate travels to Morocco on an expedition with French-Algerian archaeologist Jean Rashidi to search for an ancient city buried beneath the desert. When the team accidentally crosses the border into Algeria, militants kidnap Kate, Jean and their Moroccan guide, Amir Jadid, who is later released. The kidnappers, led by El Hadi, a fugitive wanted by Interpol, demand a $10 million ransom and decide to execute Kate if it is not paid by the evening prayer.

Brad flies to Rabat, where he teams up with Younes, a Moroccan government liaison and former soldier who once served alongside him. Ambassador Williams reluctantly backs their intelligence-gathering effort despite Fitzgerald's objections. With help from Moroccan counterterrorism officials, they trace El Hadi to a compound in Abadla and drive there. Williams persuades the president to send Navy SEALs as support. At night, Brad and Younes kill most of the guards, and Brad finds and hides Kate, but Jean is executed when the French government fails to pay. El Hadi forces Younes to arrange the transfer of the ransom to an offshore account and tries to flee, but the arriving SEALs kill him. Brad and Younes blow up the compound and are left for dead as the SEALs fly Kate out. The next day, Brad and Kate reunite at the Moroccan border. Jadid, rewarded by Fitzgerald with American citizenship, is murdered on his way out. This reveals that Fitzgerald is working for an oil company that also funds the terrorist networks. Younes secretly watches Fitzgerald and his associates and sends Brad evidence of their corruption.

The film was released in January 2021 and received largely negative reviews. Rotten Tomatoes gave it a 14% approval rating and Metacritic a score of 22 out of 100. In Variety, Joe Leydon wrote that if the film were any more generic, it would open with a bar code instead of credits.

overview: When young loner Anna is hired as the surrogate for Matt, a single man in his 40s, the two strangers come to realize this unexpected relationship will quickly challenge their perceptions of connection, boundaries and the particulars of love.
title: Together Together
plot:
Together Together is a 2021 American romantic comedy-drama film that explores the complexities of human relationships and identity through its unique narrative structure.

At its core, the movie delves into the theme of loneliness and the search for connection in a world where people often prioritize superficial relationships over genuine intimacy. The protagonist, Marlon, played by Ed Helms, is a single man who decides to become a sperm donor after his sister's death, hoping to find companionship through his role as a father figure.

However, as Marlon navigates the complexities of his new relationship with Emma, a woman who is also a single parent, he begins to confront the emptiness and disconnection that has defined his life. Through their interactions, the film highlights the tension between the desire for human connection and the fear of vulnerability.

The movie also explores the theme of identity and what it means to be a good person. Marlon's journey is marked by self-discovery, as he grapples with his own sense of purpose and responsibility. Emma, too, is on a path of self-discovery, as she navigates her own feelings of inadequacy and loneliness.

Ultimately, Together Together presents a nuanced portrayal of human relationships, one that acknowledges the complexity and messiness of life while offering a message of hope and connection. The film suggests that true intimacy requires vulnerability, empathy, and a willingness to confront our deepest fears and insecurities.

overview: Laura, traumatized by an abusive relationship, runs away from her former husband with her seven-year-old son Cody. But in their new, idyllic and remote sanctuary, they find they have another, bigger and more terrifying monster to deal with…
tagline: The past can pull you under.
title: Monstrous
plot:
Monstrous is a 2022 American supernatural thriller directed by Chris Sivertson and written by Carol Chrest. Christina Ricci stars as Laura, with Santino Barnard as her son Cody, Colleen Camp as Mrs. Langtree and Lew Temple as Mr. Alonzo.

The story appears to take place in the 1950s. Laura and her seven-year-old son Cody drive to a remote house in rural California to escape her abusive ex-husband. She finds a job as a typist and enrolls Cody in a new school, trying to build a cheerful, orderly life. But Cody is frightened and withdrawn, and at night a creature from the nearby lake appears in his room. After meeting it face to face, he grows calmer and calls it the "pretty lady from the lake", but he keeps begging to go home. Laura insists that they stay. She throws a birthday party for him, decorating the house and preparing food, but no guests arrive. She then learns that Cody never handed out the invitations because he knew no one would come. When Laura sees the monster herself, she starts drinking and quits her job.

One day, Cody is not at school when she arrives to pick him up, and Laura goes to the police. There a woman asks her to remember the accident her son had the year before. Laura recalls that while she was out buying groceries, Cody fell into the pool while his father was supposed to be watching him. She jumped in to save him and paramedics came, and she insists that they revived him. At home, Cody is waiting for her and pleads to be allowed to leave with the lady from the lake. The truth emerges: Cody died in the accident, and Laura, unable to face her grief, has retreated into a fantasy. It is actually 2022, and the house and car belonged to her late grandmother, whose world Laura remembered from childhood. When "Cody" finally leaves with the "pretty lady", the figure turns out to be the grandmother. Laura finds a measure of peace, lets go of her delusion and leaves the house to return home.

Shooting began in December 2020 around Los Angeles, including Simi Valley, Sherman Oaks and Altadena. The film premiered in the FrightFest strand of the Glasgow Film Festival on March 12, 2022, and Screen Media released it in theaters and on demand on May 13. Reviews were mixed. Rotten Tomatoes' consensus said that even Ricci's talents were tested by this often dull horror film, while Deadline praised the performances and score and called it quietly thought-provoking.

overview: Cinderella discovers a secret that could shake their world: an evil witch turned the prince into a mouse and replaced him with a look-alike. Cinderella and her friends must save the real prince and help him defeat the evil witch.
tagline: Can Cinderella rescue her Prince ...?
title: Cinderella and the Secret Prince
plot:
Cinderella and the Secret Prince, also released as Cinderella 3D, is a 2018 American animated fantasy adventure film directed by Lynne Southerland from a screenplay by Francis Glebas, Alice Blehart, Stephanie Bursill and Russell Fung. A new take on the Brothers Grimm version of the "Cinderella" fairy tale, it was produced by the small animation studio Gold Valley Films on a reported budget of 20 million dollars. The English voice cast includes Cassandra Lee Morris as Cinderella, Chris Niosi as Prince Alex, Stephen Mendel as Olaf, Wendee Lee as the Witch, Kirsten Day as the good fairy Crystal, Stephanie Sanditz as the Stepmother, R. Martin Klein and Tony Azzolino as the mice Manny and Walt, and Terrence Stone as the Witch's eagle.

The story opens much like the classic tale. Cinderella, a kind-hearted young woman forced into servitude by her stepmother and two stepsisters after her parents' deaths, is helped to attend the royal ball not by the Fairy Godmother herself but by her young apprentice, Crystal. At the ball, however, the prince turns out to be incredibly rude and mean-spirited. Cinderella and her three mouse friends then discover a secret that could shake their world: the real prince, Alex, was turned into a mouse as a small boy, after his own parents died, by an evil witch who plans to take over the kingdom, and he has been replaced at the palace by a look-alike impostor, Olaf, who cooperates with her. Cinderella and her friends set out to rescue the true prince and restore him to human form with the help of a magic ring. Along the way the stepmother turns Cinderella over to the royal guard for money. Alex, who falls in love with Cinderella, regains his human shape and defeats Olaf, but the witch kidnaps Cinderella, and as the pair escape one of her spells turns Cinderella to stone. To save her, Alex uses the ring to undo the spell, returning himself to mouse form.

The film was released internationally and grossed about 12.1 million dollars. Critical reaction was modest. Folha de S.Paulo's review judged that it would convince only a very young audience. Writing for The Princess Blog, a reviewer found it surprisingly charming and reminiscent of the early Barbie fairy-tale films, with bright colours, expressive faces and costumes that recall Tangled, and praised Cinderella as a warm, optimistic heroine, but criticised the contrived cliffhanger ending as an obvious set-up for a sequel that cheapens the story.

overview: A musical biopic of the Four Seasons—the rise, the tough times and personal clashes, and the ultimate triumph of a group of friends whose music became symbolic of a generation. Far from a mere tribute concert, it gets to the heart of the relationships at the centre of the group, with a special focus on frontman Frankie Valli, the small kid with the big falsetto.
title: Jersey Boys
plot:
Jersey Boys is a biographical musical drama film that tells the story of The Four Seasons, one of the most successful and influential rock bands of all time. The movie delves into the life of Frankie Valli, the lead singer and founder of the band.

At its core, Jersey Boys explores themes of identity, loyalty, and the pursuit of success. The film follows Frankie's journey from his humble beginnings in New Jersey to becoming a household name, while also navigating the complexities of fame, family, and friendship.

One of the main themes is the struggle for self-discovery and finding one's place in the world. Frankie's early life was marked by poverty and hardship, but he found solace in music and eventually became a star. However, as his fame grew, so did the pressures and expectations that came with it. The film shows how Frankie grappled with these challenges, often turning to his friends and family for support.

The movie also highlights the importance of loyalty and camaraderie among the band members. Despite their individual talents and ambitions, the four musicians remained close throughout their careers, supporting each other through thick and thin. This bond is a testament to the power of friendship and the enduring nature of artistic collaborations.

Furthermore, Jersey Boys touches on the theme of redemption and forgiveness. Frankie's personal life was marred by infidelity and family drama, but he ultimately found a way to reconcile with his loved ones and make amends. The film suggests that it's never too late to seek forgiveness and start anew.

Overall, Jersey Boys is a heartwarming and engaging film that celebrates the power of music, friendship, and perseverance.

overview: Determined teen Din is longing to reconnect with his childhood best friend when he meets a wish-granting dragon who shows him the magic of possibilities.
tagline: Three magical wishes. One life changing adventure.
title: Wish Dragon
plot:
Wish Dragon is a 2021 American animated fantasy comedy film produced by Columbia Pictures Animation. The movie follows the story of a young boy named Ethan, who lives with his mother in a small town in China.

Ethan's life takes a dramatic turn when he befriends a magical dragon named Wishing, who has been trapped inside a magical lantern for centuries. According to Chinese legend, if you make three wishes on the lantern, your deepest desires will come true. However, each wish comes with an unintended consequence that can have devastating effects.

As Ethan and Wishing spend more time together, they form a strong bond, and Ethan learns about the importance of being careful what he wishes for. They embark on a series of adventures to uncover the secrets behind the lantern and break the curse that has been cast upon it.

Throughout their journey, Ethan and Wishing encounter various obstacles, including treacherous landscapes, fierce creatures, and rival treasure hunters who seek to claim the lantern's power for themselves. Along the way, Ethan learns valuable lessons about friendship, responsibility, and the true meaning of happiness.

One of the most significant challenges they face is the villainous General Li, a ruthless and cunning adversary who will stop at nothing to possess the magical lantern. As tensions rise, Ethan and Wishing must use all their wits and courage to outsmart General Li and his minions.

As the story unfolds, Ethan comes to realize that the true magic of the lantern lies not in its power to grant wishes but in the connections and experiences it brings people together. With the help of Wishing, Ethan learns to appreciate the beauty of simplicity and finds a new sense of purpose in life.

In the end, Ethan and Wishing successfully break the curse, and the magical lantern is freed from its centuries-long slumber. The movie concludes with Ethan returning home, forever changed by his incredible adventure with Wishing. Though he no longer has the magical powers of the lantern, he knows that the true magic lies within himself and the friendships he's made along the way.

Overall, Wish Dragon is a heartwarming and visually stunning film that celebrates the beauty of Chinese culture and the power of friendship and self-discovery.

overview: After his wife is assaulted, a husband enlists the services of a vigilante group to help him settle the score.
tagline: Vengeance always has a price
title: Seeking Justice
plot:
Seeking Justice is a 2011 American thriller film directed by David Michôd and written by Michael Koryta. The movie stars Nicolas Cage, January Jones, and Guy Pearce.

The story begins with Gary Fencik (Nicolas Cage), a former Marine who has just been released from prison after serving time for a crime he did not commit. Gary is struggling to find work and support his family, including his wife Maureen (January Jones) and their young daughter. The situation becomes even more dire when the police inform them that they have lost custody of their child due to Gary's past conviction.

One day, while out on a walk with his daughter, Gary witnesses a brutal rape in progress. He intervenes and saves the victim, but not before she is severely injured. The police are called, and Gary is once again drawn into the justice system. As he tries to navigate this new situation, he becomes fixated on finding the perpetrator.

Gary's investigation leads him to suspect that the rapist may be connected to a wealthy businessman named Robert Segal (Guy Pearce). As Gary delves deeper into the case, he discovers that Segal is involved in some shady dealings and has connections to the police department. Gary becomes convinced that Segal is responsible for the rape and sets out to confront him.

As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that Gary's obsession with finding the perpetrator is not just about justice, but also about redemption and proving himself as a father. The film builds towards a tense confrontation between Gary and Segal, which ultimately leads to a dramatic showdown.

Throughout the movie, Cage delivers a powerful performance as Gary Fencik, bringing depth and nuance to the character's complex emotions. January Jones provides solid support as his wife Maureen, who is struggling to cope with their situation. Guy Pearce brings a sense of smarmy entitlement to his portrayal of Segal, making him a compelling adversary for Gary.

The film's climax is intense and suspenseful, with Gary facing off against Segal in a desperate bid for justice. The ending is both satisfying and haunting, leaving the audience with a lasting impression of Gary's journey and the consequences of his actions.

Overall, Seeking Justice is a gripping thriller that explores themes of redemption, justice, and the complexities of human nature. With strong performances from its cast and a tense, suspenseful plot, it is a compelling watch for fans of the genre.

overview: A terminally ill woman opts for a cloning procedure to ease her loss on her friends and family. When she makes a miraculous recovery, her attempts to have her clone decommissioned fail and lead to a court-mandated duel to the death.
tagline: The only thing that can stop you is you.
title: Dual
plot:
Dual is a 2022 American satirical science fiction thriller written, directed and produced by Riley Stearns. Karen Gillan plays both Sarah and her clone, with Aaron Paul as the combat trainer Trent, Beulah Koale as her boyfriend Peter and Theo James as Robert Michaels.

In the near future, Sarah is a depressed heavy drinker stuck in a dull relationship with Peter and avoiding her overbearing mother. After waking up in a pool of blood, she learns she has a terminal illness. To spare her loved ones the pain of losing her, she pays for a clone that will learn her life and replace her after she dies. The Double soon develops a personality of her own. Ten months later, doctors tell Sarah that she is inexplicably in full remission. When she goes to share the news, she finds Peter and the Double at her mother's house and learns that the clone has secretly been seeing her mother. Both Peter and her mother prefer the Double. When Sarah asks for the clone to be decommissioned, the Double refuses. By law, the two must now fight a public duel to the death.

Sarah spends a year training with Trent, gaining strength, getting used to violence and studying how clone duels work. She grows more confident and tells Peter she plans to kill her double without apology. Then the Double approaches her, and the two talk and attend a support group for duel survivors. They bond and agree to flee across the border together. On a hike through the forest, it becomes clear that the Double has poisoned Sarah's water. The Double arrives at the duel alone, claims to be Sarah and says the clone has fled. After an investigation, a judge rules that she is the original. But the new Sarah soon finds herself just as unfulfilled as the first, tied to Peter and a controlling mother who both know the truth. After her mother leaves a voicemail implying she could expose her at any time, the Double stops her car in a roundabout and cries.

The film was announced in 2020 with Gillan, Paul and Koale, and Theo James replaced Jesse Eisenberg. Because of the COVID-19 pandemic, it was shot over six weeks in Tampere, Finland. Dual premiered at the Sundance Film Festival on January 22, 2022, and RLJE Films released it in the United States on April 15. Reviews were positive. Rotten Tomatoes' consensus praised it as a smart, deadpan sci-fi comedy well led by Gillan, and Variety called it a fairly astute comedy built on sharp jabs of truth about death, intimacy and being forgotten.

overview: Taking inspiration from The Human Centipede films, the warden of a notorious and troubled prison looks to create a 500-person human centipede as a solution to his problems.
tagline: 100% politically incorrect.
title: The Human Centipede 3 (Final Sequence)
plot:
The Human Centipede 3 (Final Sequence) is a 2015 body horror black comedy from writer-director Tom Six, the concluding chapter of his Human Centipede trilogy. Dieter Laser and Laurence R. Harvey, the leads of the first two films, return in new roles as the sadistic prison warden Bill Boss and his accountant Dwight Butler, with Eric Roberts as Governor Hughes, Bree Olson as Bill's secretary Daisy, and Clayton Rohner, Robert LaSardo and Tommy "Tiny" Lister. Six appears as himself.

At George H. W. Bush State Prison, somewhere in the American Southwest, Bill, a cannibalistic and deranged warden, rules through brutality, breaking one inmate's arms and scalding another. When Governor Hughes visits and threatens to fire both men unless the violence stops, Bill retaliates with a wave of savage punishments. Dwight then proposes surgically joining all the inmates together mouth to anus to form a giant "human centipede", the ultimate deterrent to crime. Bill is at first opposed.

After a nightmare about being attacked by prisoners, Bill summons Tom Six, the director of the Human Centipede films, who assures him that the procedure shown in them is "100% medically accurate" and gives his blessing on condition that he can watch the operation. Screening the films for the inmates sparks a riot in which Daisy is beaten into a coma before a special forces team restores order. Bill sedates the prisoners one by one with a tranquilliser gun, shooting dead those deemed unsuitable and one inmate who wants to join. When the operation is complete, Hughes is horrified to find not only the centipede, which now includes Daisy, but also a "human caterpillar" made from limbless death-row inmates and lifers, and he tells the pair they deserve execution. Bill shoots Dr. Jones in a rage, but Hughes soon returns, having changed his mind, to declare the centipede exactly what America needs. After he leaves, Bill kills Dwight for trying to take credit for the idea, and the film ends with the naked warden whooping with joy in a watchtower above the centipede as "The Star-Spangled Banner" plays. A Blu-ray alternate ending presents the events as a dream of Dr. Josef Heiter, leading into the first film.

Released in theatres and on video on demand on 22 May 2015, the film was almost universally panned for its relentless gore and repetitive story, scoring 20% on Rotten Tomatoes. It earned Golden Raspberry nominations for Worst Prequel, Remake, Rip-off or Sequel and Worst Director.

overview: The family-friendly movie explores the transformational role prayer plays in the lives of the Jordan family. Tony and Elizabeth Jordan, a middle-class couple who seemingly have it all – great jobs, a beautiful daughter, their dream home. But appearances can be deceiving. In reality, the Jordan’s marriage has become a war zone and their daughter is collateral damage. With the help of Miss Clara, an older, wiser woman, Elizabeth discovers she can start fighting for her family instead of against them. Through a newly energized faith, Elizabeth and Tony’s real enemy doesn’t have a prayer.
tagline: Prayer is a Powerful Weapon
title: War Room
plot:
War Room is a 2015 American Christian drama film directed by Alex Kendrick and written by Alex and Stephen Kendrick. The movie stars Priscilla Shirer, Jeremy Camp, Karen Aberastain, T.C. Stallings, and David Otunga.

The story revolves around Missy, a young woman who has just moved to Atlanta with her husband, Jonathan, to pursue his music career. However, their relationship is put to the test when they struggle to communicate effectively due to their busy schedules and personal issues.

One day, while attending church, Missy meets Felicity, a wise and experienced pastor's wife played by Karen Aberastain. Through their conversations, Missy learns about the importance of prayer and seeking God's guidance in her marriage. She begins to develop a close relationship with Felicity, who becomes a mentor and friend.

As Missy navigates her marriage, she faces various challenges, including Jonathan's infidelity and her own feelings of inadequacy as a wife. Despite these struggles, Missy continues to pray and seek God's guidance, often speaking out loud in her room, which is referred to as the "war room."

Through her prayers, Missy receives wisdom and encouragement from God, which she shares with Jonathan. As they work through their issues together, their relationship begins to heal and grow stronger.

Meanwhile, Felicity faces her own struggles, including a difficult marriage and feelings of isolation. Through her conversations with Missy, she is reminded of the importance of prayer and seeking God's guidance in all areas of life.

As the story unfolds, Missy and Jonathan's marriage becomes a model for their friends and family, who are inspired by their commitment to each other and their faith. The movie ends on a hopeful note, with Missy and Jonathan's relationship stronger than ever, and both women having found comfort and guidance in their prayers.

Throughout the film, the title "War Room" refers not only to the physical space where Missy prays but also to the spiritual battles that we all face in life. The movie encourages viewers to seek God's guidance and wisdom in all areas of life, even in the midst of struggle and uncertainty.

Overall, War Room is a heartwarming and inspiring film that explores the importance of prayer, communication, and faith in relationships. With its uplifting message and strong performances from the cast, it has become a beloved Christian movie that continues to resonate with audiences today.

overview: A down-on-his-luck crab fisherman embarks on a journey to get a young man with Down syndrome to a professional wrestling school in rural North Carolina and away from the retirement home where he’s lived for the past two and a half years.
title: The Peanut Butter Falcon
plot:
The Peanut Butter Falcon is a 2019 American comedy-drama film directed by Tyler Goodson and Jordan Roberts, not Bona Fide.

The movie follows the story of Zak (played by Shia LaBeouf), a young man with Down syndrome who runs away from a nursing home to pursue his dream of becoming a wrestler. He meets Tyler (played by Jonah Hill), a small-time outlaw on the run from the law, and together they embark on a journey across the country.

The main themes of The Peanut Butter Falcon include:

1. **Freedom and Independence**: Zak's desire for freedom and independence is a central theme of the film. His decision to leave the nursing home and pursue his dreams is a powerful statement about the importance of autonomy and self-determination.
2. **Friendship and Connection**: The unlikely friendship between Zak and Tyler is a heartwarming aspect of the film. Despite their differences, they form a strong bond that helps them navigate the challenges they face on their journey.
3. **Identity and Self-Discovery**: Throughout the film, Zak struggles to find his place in the world and define himself outside of the nursing home. His adventures with Tyler help him discover new aspects of himself and find a sense of purpose.
4. **Acceptance and Inclusion**: The film promotes acceptance and inclusion of people with disabilities, highlighting the importance of treating individuals with dignity and respect.

Overall, The Peanut Butter Falcon is a beautifully crafted film that explores themes of freedom, friendship, identity, and acceptance in a heartwarming and entertaining way.

overview: Six young ninjas are tasked with defending their island home of Ninjago. By night, they’re gifted warriors using their skill and awesome fleet of vehicles to fight villains and monsters. By day, they’re ordinary teens struggling against their greatest enemy....high school.
tagline: Find your inner piece.
title: The Lego Ninjago Movie
plot:
The Lego Ninjago Movie is a 2017 animated action-comedy film directed by Michael Bacall and written by Bob Persichetti, Peter Sørensen, and Dan Hageman.

The main themes of The Lego Ninjago Movie revolve around the struggle between good and evil, friendship, and self-discovery. Here's a brief overview:

**Beginning:** The movie opens with Lord Garmadon (voiced by Justin Theroux), the father of the main antagonist, Morro, attempting to take over the world using his army of robots. However, he is thwarted by the Ninja team, led by Lloyd Garmadon (voiced by Dave Franco).

**Plot Development:** As the story unfolds, Lloyd discovers that he is the chosen one, destined to defeat Lord Garmadon and save the world from destruction. Along with his friends, Kai (Michael Peña), Cole (Troy Baker), Jay (Zach Woods), and Zane (Abbi Jacobson), they embark on a perilous journey to stop Morro's evil plans.

**Ending:** In the climactic final battle, Lloyd faces off against Lord Garmadon and ultimately defeats him. However, in doing so, he also loses his sense of identity and purpose. With the help of his friends and the wise Master Wu (Jackie Chan), Lloyd comes to terms with his destiny and finds a new sense of self.

Throughout the movie, The Lego Ninjago Movie explores themes such as:

* Friendship: The bond between the Ninja team is put to the test as they face various challenges and obstacles.
* Self-discovery: Lloyd's journey is also one of self-discovery, as he learns to accept his destiny and find his place in the world.
* Good vs. Evil: The movie features a clear distinction between good and evil, with the Ninja team representing the forces of good and Lord Garmadon embodying the forces of evil.

Overall, The Lego Ninjago Movie is an action-packed adventure that balances humor, heart, and excitement, making it a fun and entertaining ride for audiences of all ages.

overview: The Texas Rangers chase down a gang of outlaws led by Butch Cavendish, but the gang ambushes the Rangers, seemingly killing them all. One survivor is found, however, by an American Indian named Tonto, who nurses him back to health. The Ranger, donning a mask and riding a white stallion named Silver, teams up with Tonto to bring the unscrupulous gang and others of that ilk to justice.
tagline: Never Take Off the Mask
title: The Lone Ranger
plot:
The Lone Ranger is a 2013 American Western action-adventure film directed by Gore Verbinski and written by Ted Elliott and Terry Rossio. The movie is a remake of the classic 1938 serial of the same name, starring Johnny Depp as Tonto and Armie Hammer as the Lone Ranger.

The story begins in 1837, where we meet John Reid (Armie Hammer), a young Texas Ranger who is part of a group tasked with capturing the notorious outlaw Butch Cavendish (William Fichtner). During the mission, Reid's brother, Dan (James Badge Dale), is killed by Cavendish. Reid is left traumatized and vows to hunt down Cavendish.

Years later, in 1861, Reid is recruited by Chief Big Bear (Wes Studi) of the Comanche tribe to join him on a quest for revenge against Butch Cavendish, who has taken over the town of Red Rock and is terrorizing its residents. Reid meets Tonto (Johnny Depp), a mysterious and skilled warrior from the Comanche tribe.

Initially, Reid and Tonto have a rocky relationship due to their vastly different backgrounds and cultures. However, as they embark on their mission, they develop a strong bond and learn to trust each other. Along the way, they encounter various obstacles, including treacherous terrain, rival tribes, and Cavendish's henchmen.

As Reid and Tonto get closer to their goal, they realize that Cavendish is being manipulated by a wealthy industrialist named Marcus (Tommy Lee Jones). The industrialist has been using his wealth and influence to drive the Comanche out of their land and exploit its resources. Reid and Tonto must now confront not only Cavendish but also the corrupt industrialist.

The final confrontation takes place in Red Rock, where Reid and Tonto face off against Cavendish and Marcus. In a thrilling showdown, Reid and Tonto work together to defeat the villains and bring justice to the town.

Throughout the movie, there are several themes that emerge, including the importance of friendship, loyalty, and cultural understanding. The relationship between Reid and Tonto is particularly noteworthy, as they learn to put aside their differences and trust each other in order to achieve their goal.

The film features impressive action sequences, stunning cinematography, and memorable performances from its cast. While some critics felt that the movie deviated too far from the original serial, it remains a thrilling adventure that pays homage to the classic tale while also offering something new and exciting.

Overall, The Lone Ranger is an entertaining and visually stunning film that explores themes of friendship, loyalty, and cultural understanding in the context of the American West.

overview: When the initial Cylon attack against the Twelve Colonies fails to achieve complete extermination of human life as planned, twin Number Ones (Cavils) embedded on Galactica and Caprica must improvise to destroy the human survivors.
tagline: They have a plan!
title: Battlestar Galactica: The Plan
plot:
Battlestar Galactica: The Plan is a 2008 television miniseries that serves as a prequel to the re-imagined series. It explores the events leading up to the Cylon attack on the Twelve Colonies, and delves into the complexities of human nature, politics, and the consequences of war.

At its core, the story revolves around the themes of fate, free will, and the cyclical nature of violence. The characters are faced with an existential crisis as they grapple with the inevitability of their own demise, and the question of whether their actions can change the course of events or if it's already set in motion.

The miniseries also delves into the consequences of playing god, as the characters struggle to understand the nature of the Cylons and their motivations. This theme is expertly woven throughout the narrative, raising questions about the ethics of scientific discovery and the responsibility that comes with it.

Furthermore, The Plan explores the human condition, revealing the flaws and vulnerabilities of its characters. The story highlights the tension between individual desire for power and the greater good, as well as the blurred lines between heroism and villainy.

Ultimately, Battlestar Galactica: The Plan is a thought-provoking exploration of the human experience, one that challenges viewers to confront the darker aspects of their own nature and the consequences of their actions.

overview: Women enter and exit a science fiction author's life over the course of a few years after the author loses the woman he considers his one true love.
tagline: Are you still in the mood for love?
plot:
"2046" is a thought-provoking film directed by Wong Kar-wai, released in 2004 by ARTE France Cinéma. The movie is set in Hong Kong and explores several complex themes.

One of the main themes of "2046" is the power of nostalgia and longing. The protagonist, Chow Mo-wan (played by Takeshi Kaneshiro), is a writer who becomes infatuated with a woman named Zigeunerin (played by Zhang Ziyi) in a 1960s Hong Kong amusement park. This encounter sparks a series of memories and fantasies that haunt Chow throughout the film.

Another significant theme is the exploration of time, memory, and the human experience. The title "2046" refers to the year when Chow plans to visit the amusement park again, but the film's non-linear narrative structure blurs the lines between past, present, and future. This ambiguity reflects the subjective nature of human perception and the fragility of memory.

The movie also delves into the theme of love and relationships. Chow's obsession with Zigeunerin is a metaphor for his own unrequited love and longing for connection. The film's portrayal of complex, often fraught relationships between men and women adds to its emotional depth.

Furthermore, "2046" touches on the theme of identity and self-discovery. Chow's writing serves as a means of exploring his own desires, fears, and emotions, highlighting the tension between creative expression and personal truth.

Lastly, the film critiques the societal constraints and expectations placed on individuals in Hong Kong during the 1960s. The movie's portrayal of a patriarchal society that restricts women's agency and freedom serves as a commentary on the limitations faced by women in traditional Asian cultures.

Overall, "2046" is a richly layered film that explores themes of nostalgia, time, love, identity, and societal constraints, all set against the backdrop of Hong Kong's tumultuous history.

overview: An ordinary Lego mini-figure, mistakenly thought to be the extraordinary MasterBuilder, is recruited to join a quest to stop an evil Lego tyrant from gluing the universe together.
tagline: The story of a nobody who saved everybody.
title: The Lego Movie
plot:
The Lego Movie is a 2014 animated adventure-comedy film directed by Phil Lord and Christopher Miller. The movie takes place in a world made entirely of LEGO bricks, where everything is built to be perfect and functional.

The story begins with Emmet Brickowoski (voiced by Chris Pratt), an ordinary LEGO minifigure who lives in the city of Bricksburg. Emmet's life is mundane and uneventful, until he meets Wyldstyle (voiced by Elizabeth Banks), a tough and skilled warrior who is on a mission to stop the evil Lord Business (voiced by Will Ferrell). Lord Business has stolen the "Kragle," a powerful substance that can destroy all LEGO structures.

Emmet and Wyldstyle embark on a journey to find the Kragle's location, which takes them through various LEGO worlds, including the desert, the forest, and the city of Cloud Cuckoo Land. Along the way, they meet a wise-cracking, fast-talking LEGO minifigure named Batman (voiced by Will Arnett), who becomes their guide.

As they progress on their quest, Emmet discovers that he is "The Special," a prophecy foretold by an ancient text that states he will be the one to stop Lord Business. However, Emmet soon realizes that he is not as special as he thought, and that his true purpose is to help others rather than seeking fame or recognition.

Throughout their journey, Emmet and Wyldstyle face numerous challenges and obstacles, including fierce battles with Lord Business's minions and navigating treacherous LEGO landscapes. Along the way, they also learn valuable lessons about teamwork, friendship, and believing in oneself.

As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that Lord Business is not just a villain, but a complex character who was once a hero turned evil by his own ambition. The Kragle's power is revealed to be a corrupting influence that can destroy even the best of intentions.

In the end, Emmet and Wyldstyle reach the location of the Kragle, where they must face Lord Business in an epic battle. With the help of Batman and other allies, Emmet uses his newfound understanding of himself and his purpose to defeat Lord Business and save the LEGO world.

The movie ends with a grand celebration, as Emmet and Wyldstyle are hailed as heroes, and the LEGO world is restored to its former glory. The film concludes on a heartwarming note, as Emmet reflects on the lessons he learned on his journey and realizes that being "The Special" was not about him, but about the impact he had on others.

Overall, The Lego Movie is a hilarious and action-packed adventure that explores themes of identity, friendship, and the power of believing in oneself. With its witty humor, colorful animation, and memorable characters, it has become a beloved classic among both children and adults.

overview: After his family is evicted from their home, proud and desperate construction worker Dennis Nash tries to win his home back by striking a deal with the devil and working for Rick Carver, the corrupt real estate broker who evicted him.
tagline: Greed is the only game in town.
title: 99 Homes
plot: [No information found]

overview: A young Austrian girl is kidnapped and held in captivity for eight years. Based on the real-life case of Natascha Kampusch.
tagline: The story of Natasha Kampusch
title: 3096 Days
plot:
3096 Days (German: 3096 Tage) is a 2013 German drama film directed by Sherry Hormann and based on the true story of Natascha Kampusch, the girl who was abducted at the age of ten and held captive by Wolfgang Přiklopil for eight years. Northern Irish actress Antonia Campbell-Hughes plays Kampusch, with Amelia Pidgeon as the young Natascha, Thure Lindhardt as Přiklopil and Trine Dyrholm as her mother, Brigitta Sirny. The screenplay was the last project of producer and writer Bernd Eichinger before his sudden death, after which Martin Moszkowicz of Constantin Film and Ruth Toma completed it, and it was also the final film of cinematographer Michael Ballhaus.

On the morning of 2 March 1998, ten-year-old Natascha walks to school alone, upset after an argument with her mother, and is dragged into a van. She wakes up in a cellar, the prisoner of Wolfgang Přiklopil, a 35-year-old technician who leads an isolated life and whose main regular contact is his mother. Witness reports about the van bring police to his door, but they find nothing suspicious. For four years Natascha is not allowed to leave the cellar, and hunger, boredom, despair and Přiklopil's constant psychological manipulation gradually wear down her will to escape. As she grows older he lets her spend more time in the house, while shaving her head so that no stray hairs can betray her presence, giving her a new name and forcing her into heavy labor. The abuse becomes sexual and increasingly violent, yet his control over her is so complete that even when he takes her into public, to a hardware store or on a ski trip, she cannot bring herself to ask for help, and an attempt to reach out in a public bathroom fails because the other woman does not speak her language. Meanwhile her mother continues to blame herself for letting her walk to school alone. Desperate, Natascha secretly records each act of abuse on toilet paper and waits for her chance, which finally comes shortly after her eighteenth birthday, when a moment of inattention by her captor gives her an opportunity to run.

The production drew attention for Campbell-Hughes's drastic weight loss for the role. She told the Evening Standard that she wanted to suffer as much as Kampusch had, and she said that she suffered a torn Achilles tendon, a broken toe, a fractured rib and numerous cuts and bruises while working on a set that recreated the dungeon in which Kampusch had been kept.

overview: Ten years after their divorce, Jane and Jake Adler unite for their son's college graduation and unexpectedly end up sleeping together. But Jake is married, and Jane is embarking on a new romance with her architect. Now, she has to sort out her life—just when she thought she had it all figured out.
tagline: First comes marriage. Then comes divorce. And then...
title: It's Complicated
plot:
It's Complicated is a 2009 romantic comedy-drama film that explores the complexities of relationships, identity, and personal growth. The movie delves into the theme of women navigating their lives after a divorce, particularly in regards to their careers, friendships, and romantic connections.

The main character, Jane Adler, played by Meryl Streep, is a successful architect who has built a life around her marriage and family. However, as she navigates her post-divorce reality, she must confront the choices she made and the person she has become. The film showcases Jane's journey of self-discovery, as she rekindles an old flame with her ex-husband's business partner, Adam, while also reconnecting with her daughter.

Throughout the movie, the theme of complicated relationships is woven throughout. The characters' pasts and present interactions are intertwined, revealing a web of emotions, desires, and unresolved issues. The film expertly portrays how people can be both hurtful and loving towards one another, often simultaneously.

The movie also touches on the idea of identity and how it evolves over time. Jane's character is a prime example of this, as she struggles to reconcile her past and present selves. Her relationships with others serve as a catalyst for her growth, forcing her to confront her own desires, fears, and limitations.

Ultimately, It's Complicated presents a nuanced exploration of the human experience, highlighting the complexities and intricacies of relationships, personal growth, and self-discovery. The film encourages viewers to reflect on their own lives, acknowledging that relationships are multifaceted and often messy, but ultimately worth navigating.

original_title: The Girl Who Believes in Miracles
overview: When Sara hears a preacher say faith can move mountains, she starts praying. Suddenly people in her town are mysteriously healed! But fame soon takes its toll – can Sara’s family save her before it’s too late?
tagline: From her lips to God's ears.
title: The Girl Who Believes in Miracles
plot:
The Girl Who Believes in Miracles is a 2021 American Christian drama film directed and produced by Richard Correll. It stars Austyn Johnson as Sara Hopkins, a young girl whose prayers appear to bring about miraculous healings, with Mira Sorvino as her mother, Bonnie, Burgess Jenkins as her father, Alex, Peter Coyote as Sam Donovan, Kevin Sorbo as Dr. Ben Riley, Luke Omalza as her brother, Danny, and Paul-Mikel Williams as her friend Mark. The film was produced by 120 dB Films, Gerson Productions, The Mustard Seed Production and Trailmaker Productions.

Sara is a kind-hearted girl with a deep faith in God. During a visit to a lake with Danny and his girlfriend, Cindy, she finds a dead bird and, to the skepticism of her family, prays that God will bring it back to life, which he does. Not long afterward, Danny pushes his rival, Alvie, out of the path of an oncoming car, and Alvie's dog is struck instead; Sara prays over the animal and it revives, astonishing everyone who sees it. Encouraged, her best friend, Mark, a paraplegic boy who uses a wheelchair, asks her to pray with him, and he is able to walk again.

As word spreads and more miracles are attributed to her, Sara becomes a national celebrity and begins healing blind and sick children. Her family grows alarmed when she collapses after praying so often, and doctors discover that she is dying of an inoperable brain tumor. Her doctor recommends that she be kept comfortable in hospital, but Sara longs to return to the lake where she first saw God. Her grandfather organizes the townspeople to spirit her out of the hospital, and against her parents' wishes they rush her to the lake. There God appears, and Sara's spirit rises to meet him before both vanish, leaving the gathered crowd to mourn her. Danny, however, finds one of her paintings, which shows her leaving God to return to her family; taking it as a sign that she is still alive, he prays for her return, and she wakes, to everyone's joy. Sara modestly insists that it was God who healed the people she prayed for and that she only did what he asked of her.

Distributed by Atlas Distribution Company, the film was released theatrically in the United States on April 2, 2021, and became available on digital platforms on June 1, 2021.

overview: When a crime organization from North Korea crosses borders and enters South Korean soil, a South Korean detective must cooperate with a North Korean detective to investigate their whereabouts.
tagline: Joint Mission, Hidden Intentions.
title: Confidential Assignment
plot:
Confidential Assignment (Korean: 공조) is a 2017 South Korean action comedy film directed by Kim Sung-hoon, about a North Korean officer and a Seoul detective forced to work together to catch a dangerous fugitive who has stolen the plates of a counterfeiting operation. It stars Hyun Bin as the North Korean investigator Im Cheol-ryung, Yoo Hae-jin as the South Korean detective Kang Jin-tae and Kim Joo-hyuk as the renegade officer Cha Ki-seong, with Jang Young-nam, Im Yoon-ah and Lee Dong-hwi.

Cheol-ryung, an officer of a North Korean special investigation unit, storms a counterfeit-money printing plant and finds that his superior, Cha Ki-seong, and his own team are there to steal the master plates used to print the notes. In the shootout that follows, Cheol-ryung's wife, Hwa-ryung, and his comrades are killed and he is gravely wounded. When Ki-seong escapes to South Korea, the North sends Cheol-ryung to capture him and recover the plates within three days.
