Through his journey, the movie delves into the emotional toll of watching a loved one suffer from a debilitating illness, as well as the moral complexities of scientific discovery.

Ultimately, Extraordinary Measures is a powerful exploration of the human spirit, highlighting the resilience of those who refuse to give up in the face of adversity, and the transformative power of love and sacrifice.

overview: A botched store robbery places Wonder Woman in a global battle against a powerful and mysterious ancient force that puts her powers in jeopardy.
tagline: A new era of wonder begins.
title: Wonder Woman 1984
plot:
Wonder Woman 1984 is a 2020 superhero film directed by Patty Jenkins, starring Gal Gadot as Diana Prince / Wonder Woman. The movie takes place four years after the events of the first film.

The story begins with Diana (Gal Gadot) living on Themyscira, her home island, where she has been training to become a warrior and protect her people from the outside world. However, Diana's desire for human connection and experience leads her to leave the island and explore the world beyond.

In 1984, Diana meets Barbara Minerva (Kristen Wiig), an American botanist who is struggling with feelings of inadequacy and jealousy towards men. Barbara discovers a magical flower that grants eternal youth and beauty, but at a terrible cost: it slowly drains the life force from those around her, turning them into mindless, zombie-like creatures.

As Diana becomes increasingly entangled in Barbara's life, she begins to realize that the flower is not just a simple artifact, but a powerful tool created by the gods. The flower's power is so great that it can manipulate reality itself, warping the fabric of time and space.

Meanwhile, Steve Trevor (Chris Pine), Diana's love interest from the first film, has been presumed dead after his plane crashed in World War I. However, he is actually alive and has been living in a mystical realm, where he has become trapped by the gods' magic.

As Barbara's obsession with the flower grows, she becomes increasingly unstable and violent, threatening to destroy everything around her. Diana must confront her own demons and make a choice between saving humanity or protecting herself from Barbara's wrath.

Throughout the film, Jenkins explores themes of feminism, power, and the consequences of playing with forces beyond human control. The movie also delves into the complexities of female relationships, particularly the toxic bond between Barbara and Diana.

The action sequences in Wonder Woman 1984 are intense and visually stunning, with a blend of practical and CGI effects that bring the magical world to life. The film's climax features an epic battle between Diana and Barbara, with the fate of humanity hanging in the balance.

Overall, Wonder Woman 1984 is a thrilling and emotionally resonant sequel that expands on the mythology of the DC Extended Universe while introducing new characters and themes.

overview: A gang of thieves calling themselves the Santa Claus Gang are wreaking havoc, and the police can't keep up. Police Captain Gilbert is distracted by a Chinese reporter writing a story on his squad, and taxi driver Daniel is in the midst of a relationship crisis. After a string of mistakes in which the thieves outsmart the police time and time again, Daniel and his super-taxi pitch in.
tagline: No speed limits the next 90 min.
title: Taxi 3
plot:
Taxi 3 is a 2003 French drama film directed by Gérard Pirès. The movie is set in Paris during World War II and follows the story of a taxi driver, François Mitterrand, who becomes embroiled in the French Resistance.

The main themes of Taxi 3 include:

1. **Resistance and Courage**: The film highlights the bravery and selflessness of those who risked their lives to fight against Nazi occupation. François's actions demonstrate his commitment to the cause and inspire others to join the resistance.
2. **Identity and Belonging**: As a taxi driver, François is an outsider, observing the world around him without being fully part of it. His involvement in the resistance helps him find a sense of purpose and belonging among his fellow fighters.
3. **Morality and Ethics**: The film explores the moral dilemmas faced by those who resist the Nazi regime. François must confront difficult choices and make sacrifices for the greater good, raising questions about the nature of right and wrong.
4. **Human Connection and Empathy**: Through François's relationships with his fellow taxi drivers and resistance fighters, the movie showcases the importance of human connection and empathy in times of adversity.

The film received critical acclaim for its gripping storyline, strong performances, and thought-provoking themes. Taxi 3 is a powerful tribute to the French Resistance and serves as a reminder of the sacrifices made during World War II.

original_title: 劇場版 NARUTO -ナルト- 疾風伝 火の意志を継ぐ者
overview: Ninjas with bloodline limits begin disappearing in all the countries and blame points toward the fire nation. By Tsunade's order, Kakashi is sacrificed to prevent an all out war. After inheriting charms left by Kakashi, Naruto fights through friends and foes to prevent his death while changing the minds of those who've inherited the will of fire.
title: Naruto Shippuden the Movie: The Will of Fire
plot:
Naruto Shippuden the Movie: The Will of Fire is a 2009 Japanese animated martial arts fantasy film based on Masashi Kishimoto's manga and anime series. It is the sixth Naruto film and the third set during Naruto: Shippuden, taking place after episode 126 of the series.

With a fourth Great Ninja World War looming, ninjas with rare hereditary powers known as Kekkei Genkai have vanished from the Lands of Lightning, Earth, Water and Wind. Only the Land of Fire has been spared, so the other nations suspect it and gather armies on its borders. The Land of Fire's feudal lord orders Tsunade, the Fifth Hokage, to catch the real culprit and prove the Leaf Village's innocence. If she fails, he will destroy the village himself to preserve peace. The culprit is Hiruko, a rogue ninja and former comrade of the Legendary Sannin Tsunade, Jiraiya and Orochimaru. He left the village long ago after creating the Chimera Technique, which lets him absorb other ninjas' chakra and bloodline abilities. From his base on Mount Shumi, with his followers Ichi, Ni and San, he projects his image into the sky over the Leaf Village and announces that he will take the Land of Fire's Kekkei Genkai. He plans to use the power of a solar eclipse to become immortal, start the war and conquer the world.

His target is Kakashi Hatake's Sharingan. Hiruko activates a Puppet Curse he placed on Kakashi years earlier, and Kakashi asks Tsunade to put a seal on him that will trigger his Kamui ability if Hiruko tries to absorb him. He then leaves the village, and Tsunade publicly declares him a rogue ninja and forbids anyone to follow him. Naruto Uzumaki and Sakura Haruno set out anyway to rescue their teacher, and Teams 8, 10 and Guy are sent after them. With Sai, Naruto and Sakura defeat Hiruko's subordinates and reach his temple. During the eclipse, Kakashi's Mangekyō Sharingan distorts the absorption, and Naruto pulls him free with a barrage of Rasengan. Hiruko survives and summons a chimera beast, which the other teams defeat. Hiruko absorbs Kakashi's Raikiri and Naruto's giant Rasengan, but he cannot absorb Naruto's Wind Style: Rasenshuriken, which kills him. The ninjas celebrate at Mount Shumi, and Kishimoto adds a closing note.

The film opened in Japan on August 1, 2009, and Viz Media released it in North America on October 23, 2012. Anime News Network gave it a C+, praising its fluid action, background art and ties to the series but criticizing its formulaic story.

overview: Phil Weston has been unathletic his entire life. In college he failed at every sport that he tried out for. It looks like his 10-year old son, Sam, is following in his footsteps. But when Phil's hyper-competitive dad benches Sam, Phil decides to transfer his son to a new team which needs a coach. Phil steps in to be the temporary coach and immediately begins to butt heads with this dad over this new competition in their lives.
tagline: One man could lead this team to glory... That man was busy.
title: Kicking & Screaming
plot:
Kicking & Screaming is a 2005 American sports comedy film directed by Jesse Dylan. The movie revolves around Phil Weston (played by Robert Duvall), a former soccer star who tries to coach his son's under-12 soccer team, the Kicking Kings, despite having no experience.

The main theme of Kicking & Screaming is the importance of perseverance and learning from failure. Phil's journey as he navigates the world of youth soccer coaching serves as a metaphor for life's challenges. As he faces setbacks and disappointments, he must find ways to overcome them and grow both as a person and as a coach.

The film also explores the theme of redemption and second chances. Phil sees his son's under-12 team as an opportunity to redeem himself and make up for past mistakes. Through his experiences with the Kicking Kings, he learns valuable lessons about teamwork, discipline, and the value of hard work.

Furthermore, the movie touches on the theme of generational differences and the challenges that come with bridging the gap between parents and children. Phil's struggles to connect with his son and the other coaches serve as a reminder that effective communication and empathy are essential in building strong relationships.

Overall, Kicking & Screaming is a heartwarming film that celebrates the power of sports to bring people together and teach valuable life lessons.

overview: An Afro-American organization, the B.R.O.T.H.E.R.H.O.O.D., is in permanent fight against a white organization "The Man" defending the values of the black people in North America. When the Afro-American candidate Gen. Warren Boutwell behaves strangely in his presidential campaign, Undercover Brother is hired to work undercover for "The Man" and find what happened with the potential candidate.
tagline: He's All Action
title: Undercover Brother
plot:
Undercover Brother is a 2002 comedy film that satirizes the societal issues of the time, particularly racism and cultural identity. The movie follows the story of Undercover Brother, a black man who infiltrates a white supremacist organization to gather information and bring about change.

The main theme of the movie revolves around the struggle for racial equality and social justice. The film critiques the systemic racism that pervades every aspect of society, from education to employment to entertainment. Through Undercover Brother's undercover mission, the movie highlights the ways in which institutions perpetuate inequality and silence marginalized voices.

At its core, Undercover Brother is a commentary on the power of cultural identity and the importance of self-expression. The film celebrates the diversity of African American culture and challenges the dominant white culture to acknowledge and respect its own privilege. By subverting traditional notions of masculinity and challenging societal norms, the movie promotes a message of empowerment and self-love.

The film also explores themes of paranoia and surveillance, as Undercover Brother navigates a world where he is constantly being watched and judged. This theme speaks to the pervasive feeling of mistrust and suspicion that can come with being an outsider or a minority group.

Overall, Undercover Brother is a satirical comedy that uses humor and wit to tackle some of the most pressing social issues of our time. The movie's irreverent style and clever writing make it a thought-provoking and entertaining watch.

overview: A 17 year old finds out that his girlfriend is dying, so he sets out to give her an entire life, in the last year she has left.
title: Life in a Year
plot:
Life in a Year is a 2020 American romantic drama film directed by Mitja Okorn from a screenplay by Jeffrey Addiss and Will Matthews. It stars Jaden Smith as Daryn and Cara Delevingne as Isabelle, with Cuba Gooding Jr. and Nia Long as Daryn's parents, Xavier and Catherine, and RZA, Chris D'Elia, Stony Blyden and JT Neal in supporting roles. Will Smith and Jada Pinkett Smith served as executive producers through their Overbrook Entertainment banner. Shot in Toronto beginning in April 2017, the film was released in the United States on Amazon Prime Video by Sony Pictures Releasing on November 27, 2020.

Daryn is a high school student whose demanding father, Xavier, has convinced him that his only goal in life should be getting into Harvard. One night, while trying to sneak into a rapper's concert, he meets a girl named Isabelle and is immediately drawn to her. He courts her and falls in love, but when he confesses his feelings, Isabelle reveals that she has cancer and does not have much time left. Determined to make the most of it, Daryn resolves to fit a whole life into a single year. Isabelle, in turn, recognizes his talent as a rapper and helps him record his first demo. When Daryn introduces her to his parents, Xavier treats her as a distraction from his son's future and interrogates her coldly, and Isabelle leaves, offended, with Phil, the drag queen who has acted as a parent to her. At his Harvard interview, Daryn realizes that everything he has achieved has been for his father rather than himself, and he walks out, setting off a bitter confrontation at home. Choosing Isabelle over his family's expectations, Daryn leaves town with her. Together they try to reconnect Isabelle with the mother who abandoned her, and they face the progression of her illness, as Daryn learns what it means to love someone with so little time, and both search for a way to give their short time together the meaning of a lifetime.

Casting was announced in 2017, beginning with Delevingne and Smith in March. Terrence Howard was originally cast as Daryn's father, but Gooding Jr. replaced him in May 2017, when D'Elia also joined the cast. The film's release came more than three years after principal photography had taken place.

overview: In the first century, free-spirited Mary Magdalene flees the marriage her family has arranged for her, finding refuge and a sense of purpose in a radical new movement led by the charismatic, rabble-rousing preacher named Jesus.
tagline: Her story will be told
title: Mary Magdalene
plot:
Mary Magdalene is a 2018 biographical drama film directed by Garth Davis and written by Roseanne Powell. The film tells the story of Mary Magdalene, one of Jesus' twelve apostles, and her journey from being a sinful woman to becoming a devoted follower of Christ.

The film begins with Mary (played by Rooney Mara) as a young woman living in Capernaum, a small fishing village on the shores of the Sea of Galilee. She is portrayed as a complex character, struggling with her own demons and feeling isolated from society due to her past mistakes. The story then shifts to Jesus' (played by Juno Temple) arrival in Capernaum, where Mary meets him and becomes drawn to his teachings.

As Mary spends more time with Jesus, she begins to see the world through new eyes and finds a sense of purpose and belonging. She is introduced as one of Jesus' twelve apostles, alongside other notable figures such as Peter (played by Yul Vazquez) and John (played by Louis Hunter). The film depicts their early days together, exploring the teachings of Jesus and witnessing his miracles.

However, Mary's past mistakes continue to haunt her. She is shown to have been involved with a group of men who were using her for their own gain, leading to her feelings of shame and guilt. Despite this, she finds solace in her relationship with Jesus, who accepts her unconditionally and helps her to confront her demons.

As the story unfolds, Mary becomes increasingly devoted to Jesus' teachings and is present at many key events in his life, including the Last Supper and the Crucifixion. The film's portrayal of these events is poignant and powerful, highlighting the depth of Mary's love for Jesus and her willingness to follow him even into death.

The film's climax features Mary standing by Jesus' side as he dies on the cross, a moment that has been depicted in many other films and artworks throughout history. However, this version offers a fresh perspective on the event, emphasizing Mary's role as a witness and follower of Jesus rather than simply a bystander.

Throughout the film, the cinematography is stunning, capturing the beauty of the natural world and the emotional intensity of the characters' experiences. The score by Jed Kurzel adds to the overall sense of drama and tension, perfectly capturing the mood of each scene.

Overall, Mary Magdalene offers a powerful and moving portrayal of one of Jesus' most devoted followers. By exploring her complex character and her journey towards redemption, the film provides a unique perspective on the life of Christ and his disciples.

overview: An adaptation of Mark Waid's "Tower of Babel" story from the JLA comic. Vandal Savage steals confidential files Batman has compiled on the members of the Justice League, and learns all their weaknesses.
tagline: The end of justice.
title: Justice League: Doom
plot:
Justice League: Doom is an American animated superhero film of 2012 directed by Lauren Montgomery and written by Dwayne McDuffie, his last script before his death. Loosely based on the 2000 JLA storyline "Tower of Babel" and a standalone sequel to Justice League: Crisis on Two Earths, it was the 13th DC Universe Animated Original Movie. Kevin Conroy voices Batman, Tim Daly Superman, Susan Eisenberg Wonder Woman, Nathan Fillion Green Lantern, Carl Lumbly Martian Manhunter, Michael Rosenbaum the Flash and Phil Morris Vandal Savage, many reprising roles from the earlier animated series.

The immortal Vandal Savage plans to wipe out two thirds of humanity and found a new civilisation. He has Mirror Master steal from the Batcomputer the contingency plans Batman devised to neutralise his teammates should they go rogue, alters them to be lethal, and recruits Cheetah, Star Sapphire, Metallo, Bane, Mirror Master and Ma'alefa'ak as the Legion of Doom. Bane lures Batman to his parents' empty graves and buries him alive in his father's coffin. Martian Manhunter is poisoned at his own birthday party and set ablaze with magnesium; Cheetah infects Wonder Woman with nanomachines that make everyone look like Cheetah; Mirror Master straps a bomb to the Flash that will explode if he slows; Star Sapphire breaks Green Lantern's will until he renounces his ring; and Metallo, disguised as a suicidal man on the Daily Planet roof, shoots Superman with a Kryptonite bullet.

Spurred by Bane's taunting recording, Batman escapes, while Cyborg disables Wonder Woman's nanites. Together they save Martian Manhunter, Batman guides the Flash to leave the bomb inside an Arctic iceberg and shows Green Lantern that the hostages he failed were androids, and the heroes cut the bullet from Superman. Using a tracer Batman hid in his files, the League defeats the Legion, but Savage launches a rocket to trigger a devastating solar flare; the heroes use the Hall of Doom's technology to phase the whole planet so that the flare passes harmlessly. Savage is jailed for life, Cyborg joins the team and Batman resigns, telling Superman that the League itself is his plan should Superman ever turn.

Released on home video on 28 February 2012, it earned over $7.5 million in domestic sales, and IGN rated it 7 out of 10, calling it a highly enjoyable ride but a short adaptation.

overview: An ambitious anthology film featuring segments directed by over two dozen of the world's leading talents in contemporary genre film. Inspired by children's educational ABC books, the film comprises 26 individual chapters, each helmed by a different director assigned a letter of the alphabet. The directors were then given free reign in choosing a word to create a story involving death.
tagline: 26 Directors, 26 Ways to Die.
title: The ABCs of Death
plot:
The ABCs of Death is a 2013 anthology horror film that weaves together ten short stories, each starting with a different letter of the alphabet. At its core, the movie explores the darker aspects of human nature and the consequences of our actions.

One of the primary themes of The ABCs of Death is the exploration of mortality and the inevitability of death. Each segment delves into the concept of death in a unique and often disturbing way, showcasing the various ways people can meet their demise. This theme is woven throughout the film, with some segments focusing on the fear of death itself, while others explore the consequences of our actions leading up to it.

Another significant theme present in The ABCs of Death is the exploration of societal norms and expectations. Many of the segments critique societal norms and conventions, often using dark humor and satire to make pointed commentary on issues such as conformity, consumerism, and the pressures placed on individuals by society.

The film also touches on the idea of chaos and anarchy, with some segments depicting a world that has descended into complete chaos and disorder. This theme is often tied to the concept of mortality, suggesting that in the face of death, societal norms and conventions are rendered meaningless.

Furthermore, The ABCs of Death explores the human condition through its portrayal of characters who are often flawed, relatable, and sometimes even likable. Despite their flaws, these characters are forced to confront their own mortality, leading to a deeper exploration of what it means to be human.

Overall, The ABCs of Death is a thought-provoking film that uses horror as a lens to explore some of the darker aspects of human nature and society.

overview: Ray Nettles, a detective of San Francisco, and his partner Fuzzy must take up to one of the most dangerous terrorist gangs of the city. When one of the terrorists, the beautiful scientist Claire Manning is arrested, Swan, the leader of the terrorists, claims he will detonate bombs throughout the city if she is not released. Because of the possible bloodshed, Nettles calls for the help of explosive expert Frank Glass...
tagline: When the countdown hits zero, you're dead
title: Ticker
plot:
Ticker is a 2001 American action film directed by Albert Pyun and starring Tom Sizemore, Steven Seagal, Dennis Hopper and Jaime Pressly, with Ice-T, Kevin Gage, Romany Malco and Nas in supporting roles. Made with Nu Image, with backing from Emmett/Furla's Family Room Entertainment and domestic distribution through Artisan Entertainment, it was released straight to video in the United States on November 13, 2001.

The film opens with a hostage standoff at the home of a United States senator. While a SWAT team battles the hostage takers, bomb squad chief Frank Glass, played by Seagal, disarms a device in the basement, only to realize that it was too easy and intended as a decoy; the real bomb explodes, killing everyone inside. A year later in San Francisco, narcotics detective Ray Nettles, played by Sizemore, is still unable to grieve for his wife and son, who were killed in a car bombing. When Ray and his partner Art "Fuzzy" Rice investigate suspicious activity at a warehouse, Fuzzy is shot by the leader of a gang of bombers, an Irish terrorist named Alex Swan, played by Hopper. Ray arrests a member of the group, Claire Manning, who wears a bracelet that turns out to contain Semtex and detonation cord. Swan demands Claire's release within an hour and, when the deadline passes, blows up a bar. Ray teams up with Glass to track down the remaining bombers, and Claire, claiming she will be killed for having been caught, begins to cooperate, revealing the names of Swan and his associate Vershbow. Swan, however, keeps escalating his campaign, detonating bombs across the city and preparing a massive attack with a crew led by Vincent Cruichshank, played by Ice-T. Hoping to prevent further bloodshed, the police release Claire with a tracking device, but her true loyalties prove more complicated than they seem, and Ray and Glass are forced into a race against time to find and defuse Swan's ultimate "masterpiece".

During post-production, Nu Image imposed many changes that Pyun denounced as horrible, in particular the removal of character-building scenes for Seagal, because the company, according to Pyun, simply wanted him fighting. Pyun later posted an "Anti-Studio Director's Cut" of the film online.

overview: Multi-platinum rap superstars Redman and Method Man star as Jamal and Silas, two regular guys who smoke something magical, ace their college entrance exams and wind up at Harvard. Ivy League ways are strange but Silas and Jamal take it in a stride -- until their supply of supernatural smoke runs dry. That's when they have to start living by their wits and rely on their natural resources to make the grade.
tagline: They've got their degrees all rolled up.
title: How High
plot:
How High is a 2001 American stoner comedy film directed by Jesse Dylan and written by DJ Pooh and Shawn Wayans. The movie follows two high school friends, Jamal (Shawn Wayans) and Silas (Marlon Wayans), who are both struggling to cope with the pressures of college life.

The main themes of How High include:

1. Friendship: The film showcases the strong bond between Jamal and Silas, who support each other through thick and thin. Their friendship is a central theme in the movie, as they navigate the challenges of college life together.
2. Coming-of-age: The movie explores the transition from high school to college, highlighting the difficulties and uncertainties that come with this new chapter in life. Jamal and Silas must adapt to a more mature environment, where they are expected to take responsibility for themselves.
3. Identity: Both characters struggle with their identities, particularly as they navigate their relationships with women and their own sense of self-worth. The movie pokes fun at the stereotypes associated with African American men in college, highlighting the absurdity of these expectations.
4. Social class: The film touches on social class differences, as Jamal and Silas come from different backgrounds. Their experiences are shaped by their socioeconomic status, which affects their relationships and opportunities.

The plot development revolves around Jamal and Silas's decision to smoke marijuana to cope with stress and anxiety. However, they soon discover that the weed has been laced with magic, which gives them incredible intelligence and abilities. As they navigate college life, they must keep their newfound powers a secret while also dealing with the consequences of their actions.

The ending is comedic, as Jamal and Silas's antics become more and more outlandish, leading to a series of hilarious misadventures. Ultimately, the movie concludes on a lighthearted note, with the two friends learning valuable lessons about responsibility, friendship, and growing up.

Overall, How High is a lighthearted, comedic film that explores themes of friendship, coming-of-age, identity, and social class.

overview: Superman and Supergirl take on the cybernetic being known as Brainiac, who boasts that he possesses "the knowledge and strength of 10,000 worlds."
tagline: The machine is coming
title: Superman: Unbound
plot:
Superman: Unbound is an animated film that explores the character's early days on Earth, delving into his struggles with his Kryptonian heritage and his desire to find a place where he belongs. The movie delves into themes of identity, belonging, and the weight of responsibility.

As Superman navigates his new life in Smallville, Kansas, he grapples with the expectations placed upon him by his adoptive parents, Jonathan and Martha Kent. He struggles to reconcile his Kryptonian roots with his human upbringing, feeling like an outsider among both humans and other aliens. This sense of disconnection serves as a catalyst for Superman's growth, as he learns to balance his dual identities and find a sense of purpose.

The film also touches on the theme of sacrifice, as Superman is forced to confront the consequences of his actions and make difficult choices that put those he cares about in harm's way. This serves as a reminder of the immense responsibility that comes with having extraordinary abilities, and the need for selflessness and compassion.

Furthermore, Superman: Unbound explores the idea of home and what it means to belong. Superman's search for a place where he can call home is a metaphor for the human experience, highlighting the universal desire for connection and acceptance. The film suggests that true belonging can be found in embracing one's differences and finding a sense of community with others who share similar struggles and aspirations.

Overall, Superman: Unbound presents a nuanced exploration of Superman's character, delving into the complexities of identity, responsibility, and the human need for connection and belonging.

overview: Set in a 19th-century European village, this stop-motion animation feature follows the story of Victor, a young man whisked away to the underworld and wed to a mysterious corpse bride, while his real bride Victoria waits bereft in the land of the living.
tagline: There's been a grave misunderstanding.
title: Corpse Bride
plot:
Corpse Bride is a stop-motion animated musical fantasy film directed by Tim Burton and Mike Johnson, produced by Tim Burton and Davis Doi, and released by Warner Bros. Pictures.

In a small village in medieval Europe, we meet our protagonist, Victor Van Dort (voiced by Johnny Depp), a shy and awkward young man who is about to get married to Victoria Everglot (voiced by Emily Watson). The wedding ceremony is being held at the local church, where the villagers are gathered to witness the union.

However, during the ceremony, Victor's vows are interrupted by a mysterious and eerie presence. He accidentally marries a dead bride named Emily (voiced by Helena Bonham Carter), who was buried in the nearby graveyard. Unbeknownst to Victor, he has made a promise to Emily that he must keep for eternity.

As the wedding celebration continues, Victor is forced to return to the graveyard to fulfill his vows to Emily. There, he meets a cast of eccentric and supernatural characters, including the Bone Snatcher (voiced by Richard E. Grant), the Corpse Bride's loyal servant, and the Dead Bride herself, who is determined to make Victor hers.

Meanwhile, back in the village, Victoria begins to suspect that something is amiss with her fiancé. She discovers a mysterious letter from Victor, which reveals his accidental marriage to Emily. Believing that Victor has abandoned her, Victoria sets out on a journey to find him and bring him back home.

As Victor navigates the world of the dead, he must confront the consequences of his actions and decide whether to stay with Emily or return to the living world to be with Victoria. Along the way, he learns valuable lessons about love, loyalty, and the importance of following one's heart.

The film features a range of memorable characters, including the Corpse Bride herself, who is both eerie and endearing. Her relationship with Victor is complex and multifaceted, and their romance is both poignant and humorous.

Ultimately, Victor must make a choice between his love for Victoria and his obligations to Emily. In the end, he chooses to return to the living world, but not before saying goodbye to Emily and finding closure with Victoria. The film concludes on a hopeful note, with Victor and Victoria reunited and ready to start their new life together.

Corpse Bride is a beautifully crafted film that showcases Tim Burton's unique visual style and sense of humor. The stop-motion animation is stunning, and the music by Danny Elfman is catchy and memorable. Overall, Corpse Bride is a delightful and entertaining film that explores themes of love, loss, and redemption in a way that is both whimsical and poignant.

overview: When best buds Rick and Fred begin to show signs of restlessness at home, their wives take a bold approach to revitalize their marriages, they grant the guys a 'hall pass'—one week of freedom to do whatever they want. At first, it seems like a dream come true, but they quickly discover that their expectations of the single life—and themselves—are completely and hilariously out of sync with reality.
tagline: One week. No rules.
title: Hall Pass
plot:
Hall Pass is a 2011 American comedy produced and directed by Peter and Bobby Farrelly, who co-wrote it with Pete Jones. Owen Wilson and Jason Sudeikis star as Rick and Fred, with Jenna Fischer and Christina Applegate as their wives, Maggie and Grace. Richard Jenkins and Stephen Merchant also appear.

Rick and Fred are best friends in a Providence suburb whose marriages have gone stale. They openly long for their single days and their wives finally give each of them a "hall pass": one week off from marriage, during which they are free to sleep with anyone. With friends Gary, Flats and Hog Head, the husbands try to pick up women, with little success. Rick flirts with Leigh, a coffee shop waitress, angering her co-worker Brent, then falls asleep for hours in a gym hot tub. Maggie and Grace take hall passes of their own: Grace grows close to Gerry, a minor league ballplayer, and Maggie is drawn to his coach.

On day six, at a bar with the womanizing Coakley, Rick meets his children's babysitter, Paige, who has just turned 21 and is out with her aunt Meg. Rick turns Paige down in favor of Leigh. Fred's hotel date fizzles, but Meg later arrives and, mistaking him for Rick, seduces him. Maggie rebuffs the coach, while Grace sleeps with Gerry. Feeling guilty, she crashes her car on the way home. At Coakley's, Rick surprises himself by refusing Leigh because he loves Maggie. Learning of the accident, he rushes to find Fred, and a fight erupts with Brent, Meg's son, who is arrested at the hospital. Rick goes home and confesses to Maggie that he never used his pass and that she is the only woman he has ever been with. Maggie tells him she did not use hers either. Fred and Grace reconcile and agree to keep their secrets, though Fred soon lets slip what happened with Meg.

The Farrellys bought Jones's spec script in 2005. Although set in New England, it was shot in Atlanta in 2010, for Georgia's film incentives. Warner Bros. released it on February 25, 2011, and it opened at number one with $13.5 million before grossing $83.2 million worldwide on a $36 million budget. Reviews were mixed to negative. Rotten Tomatoes noted that the film defends traditional domestic values but lacks laughs, and Roger Ebert gave it two and a half stars out of four.

overview: It took a lot of cajoling to get Bob, a recently widowed architect, to go on a blind date at a quirky Irish-Italian eatery. Once there, he's smitten instantly not with his date but with the sharp-witted waitress. Everything seems to be going great until an unbelievable truth is revealed, one that could easily break both of their hearts for good.
tagline: A comedy straight from the heart
title: Return to Me
plot:
Return to Me is a romantic drama film that explores the complexities of love, loss, and identity. The story revolves around a man who falls in love with a woman after she receives an organ transplant from a deceased donor named Harry. As he gets to know her better, he discovers that she has memories of him as well, but they are not his own.

The film delves into the theme of identity, as the protagonist struggles to come to terms with the fact that the woman he loves is actually someone else's soulmate. This raises questions about the nature of love and whether it can transcend beyond physical bodies. The movie also touches on the idea of grief and loss, as the protagonist grapples with his own emotional baggage.

Moreover, Return to Me explores the theme of human connection and the power of relationships in shaping our lives. The film shows how two people can form a deep bond despite being connected through an unlikely circumstance, highlighting the complexities and nuances of human emotions.

The movie also has a strong focus on the theme of self-discovery, as the protagonist navigates his feelings for the woman and tries to understand himself better. Through his journey, he learns to let go of his past and find closure, ultimately discovering that love can be found in unexpected places.

Overall, Return to Me is a poignant and thought-provoking film that explores the intricacies of human emotions, relationships, and identity, leaving audiences with a sense of hope and renewal.

overview: Joan Jett and Cherie Currie, two rebellious teenagers from Southern California, become the frontwomen for the Runaways -- the now-legendary group that paved the way for future generations of female rockers. Under the Svengali-like influence of impresario Kim Fowley, the band becomes a huge success.
tagline: It's 1975 and they're about to explode.
title: The Runaways
plot:
The Runaways is a 2010 American biographical drama film about the 1970s rock band of the same name, written and directed by music video director Floria Sigismondi in her feature debut. Based on Neon Angel: A Memoir of a Runaway (1989) by the band's lead singer Cherie Currie, it stars Dakota Fanning as Currie, Kristen Stewart as rhythm guitarist and vocalist Joan Jett and Michael Shannon as the record producer Kim Fowley, with Riley Keough and Stella Maeve. Jett served as an executive producer. The film depicts the band's formation in 1975 and focuses on the relationship between Currie and Jett.

In Los Angeles, teenager Cherie Currie dreams of becoming a rock star; she idolizes David Bowie, styles herself after his Aladdin Sane persona and wins her school talent show despite hecklers. Joan Jett, another teenager with the same dream, meets the flamboyant producer Kim Fowley at a club and tells him she wants to form an all-girl rock band. Fowley introduces her to drummer Sandy West, and the two begin playing together while Fowley insists that they need a striking blonde singer in the style of Brigitte Bardot. Scouring the city's clubs, Joan and Kim find Cherie and invite her to audition at a trailer park in the San Fernando Valley. When her chosen song falls flat, Joan and Kim write "Cherry Bomb" on the spot, and Cherie wins the job. With Lita Ford on lead guitar, the Runaways sign with Mercury Records and the success of their first album takes them to Japan for a concert, where overexcited fans mob them. Fame brings its own pressures, however. Magazine photo shoots that focus on Cherie's sex appeal breed resentment within the band, Cherie's drug use spirals out of control, and Fowley's harsh treatment of the girls takes its toll. As Cherie struggles with addiction and the strain of her troubled family life, the intense bond between her and Joan is tested, and the band begins to come apart under the weight of its own success, while Joan remains fiercely determined to keep playing rock and roll.

The film received generally favorable reviews. On Rotten Tomatoes it holds a 69% rating based on 193 reviews, with a consensus that, while viewers expecting an in-depth biopic will be disappointed, it is as electric as the band's music thanks to strong performances by Shannon, Fanning and Stewart, and Metacritic gave it a score of 65 out of 100. It grossed around $4.6 million worldwide.

overview: When the crew of a space junk collector ship called The Victory discovers a humanoid robot named Dorothy that's known to be a weapon of mass destruction, they get involved in a risky business deal which puts their lives at stake.
tagline: 2092, the space sweep begins!
title: Space Sweepers
plot:
Space Sweepers is a 2021 South Korean science fiction film directed by Jo Sung-hee and produced by Bidangil Pictures, CJ Entertainment, and Studio Dragon. The movie takes place in a dystopian future where humanity has colonized other planets.

The story follows Jang Geu-rin (played by Song Joong-ki), a former space junk collector who now works as a scavenger on the outskirts of Seoul. He lives with his daughter, Ji-an (played by Kim Ji-won), and her mother, who passed away due to an illness caused by pollution in the city.

One day, Geu-rin receives a message from an old friend, Captain Jang Do-won (played by Ma Dong-seok), who is now working for a private space company called "Space Sweepers." The company's mission is to clean up space debris and sell it for profit. However, the company's true intentions are shrouded in mystery.

Geu-rin joins his friend on a mission to collect a valuable piece of space junk, which turns out to be a spaceship carrying a young girl named Ji-an (played by Kim Ji-won). The girl is revealed to be an alien who was sent to Earth as a child and has been living with Geu-rin's daughter.

As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that the Space Sweepers company is involved in a sinister plot to exploit the alien's advanced technology for their own gain. Geu-rin and his friend must navigate through treacherous space terrain and fight against rival treasure hunters to protect Ji-an and uncover the truth about her past.

Throughout the movie, the characters face numerous challenges and obstacles as they try to survive in a harsh environment. The film features stunning visual effects, heart-pumping action sequences, and emotional character development.

Ultimately, Geu-rin and his friend succeed in their mission, but not without sacrifices. The movie ends on a hopeful note, with Ji-an finally finding her place in the world and Geu-rin coming to terms with his past and his role as a father figure to her.

Overall, Space Sweepers is a thrilling and emotionally resonant sci-fi film that explores themes of family, loyalty, and redemption. With its talented cast, stunning visuals, and engaging storyline, it's no wonder this movie has become a fan favorite among science fiction enthusiasts.

overview: Speckles, a ferocious tarbosaurus and his young son junior, mourning the loss of their family in an epic battle, roam the lands in search of food, adventure and peace. Under the watchful eye of his dad, Junior is growing up healthy and strong, but with an overconfidence thanks to his young age. After one encounter results in Junior being kidnapped, Speckles embarks on an adventure to the ends of earth to find his son. Encountering friend and foe, ally and enemy, Speckles will stop at nothing and will take on all corners to save his offspring.
production_companies: Dream Search Contents and Company co.Ltd
tagline: An epic Jurassic adventure for the whole family
title: Dino King: Journey to Fire Mountain
plot:
Dino King: Journey to Fire Mountain, also known as Dino King 3D: Journey to Fire Mountain and Speckles the Tarbosaurus 2: The New Paradise, is a 2018 South Korean-Chinese computer-animated action adventure family film written and directed by Han Sang-ho and produced by Chang Hoon Lee. A sequel to The Dino King, it was released in South Korea on December 25, 2018, and in other countries in 2019. The Korean voice cast includes Park Hee-soon, Ra Mi-ran and Kim Sung-kyun, while the English version features Marcello Fabrizi as Speckles, Jacqui Duncan as Junior and Erin Conner as Fang.

In the Late Cretaceous, the battle-scarred Tarbosaurus Speckles is raising his son, Junior, the last of his offspring with his late mate. Junior is kind but timid, and ever since being swept out to sea as a hatchling he has been terrified of water. When Junior freezes during his first hunt and panics in shallow water, Speckles berates him for his cowardice, and the two part in anger. The next day Junior is snatched by a pack of Deinonychus. Speckles gives chase but is knocked into a river, and a storm wipes out the trail. Junior wakes up in a desert compound where many young dinosaurs are being held captive. There he is bullied by a young Therizinosaurus, Slash, but befriended by a young female Tarbosaurus named Blue and a gentle Monoclonius named Dusty, and he learns from a greedy Dsungaripterus that the Deinonychus are offering their prisoners as sacrifices to a mysterious beast that lives in a volcano and gives them to its offspring as playthings. Meanwhile, Speckles sets out across hostile lands to find his son, joined by Cy, a Saichania seeking revenge for the loss of a friend, and Fang, a female Tarbosaurus searching for her missing daughter, who turns out to be Blue. Fang heals Speckles after he is poisoned by giant scorpions, and when the travelers come upon a herd of Pukyongosaurus whose eggs are being raided by Carnotaurus, she persuades the reluctant and single-minded Speckles to help. As father and son each face their fears, they head toward the fire mountain, where the volcano is about to erupt.

Speckles takes his name from the pattern of spotted rosettes on his muzzle and bears three scars on his collar. His journey from a stern, single-minded father who demands bravery into a more understanding parent, and Junior's struggle to find his own courage, form the emotional core of the story.

overview: New York, 1980. Three complete strangers accidentally discover that they're identical triplets, separated at birth. The 19-year-olds' joyous reunion catapults them to international fame, but also unlocks an extraordinary and disturbing secret that goes beyond their own lives – and could transform our understanding of human nature forever.
tagline: The most amazing, incredible, remarkable true story ever told.
title: Three Identical Strangers
plot:
Three Identical Strangers is a 2018 documentary directed by Tim Wardle. It tells the story of Edward Galland, David Kellman and Robert Shafran, identical triplets who were separated at birth and adopted by different families. Using archival footage, reenactments and interviews, it traces their chance reunion and the truth behind their separation.

In 1980, 19-year-old Robert Shafran arrives at Sullivan County Community College in upstate New York and is repeatedly greeted as Eddy Galland. Meeting that evening, the two realize they are adopted twins. Publicity reaches David Kellman, whose looks and adoption match theirs, revealing that they are triplets. They share tastes in food and cigarettes, all wrestled in high school, and showed separation anxiety as children. They become a media sensation, appear on The Phil Donahue Show, move in together and open a restaurant called Triplets.

The film then turns darker. As children, each boy had been visited regularly and tested by researchers working with psychiatrists Peter B. Neubauer and Viola W. Bernard under the Jewish Board of Guardians,, a study whose purpose was never explained to their parents. The Louise Wise adoption agency had told the families that triplets were difficult to place together. In fact, the infants were deliberately placed in blue-collar, middle-class and affluent homes with different parenting styles as a secret "nature versus nurture" study of identical siblings. The brothers question whether children were chosen because of family histories of mental illness, which a researcher interviewed in the film flatly denies. Differences emerge, and the restaurant strains their bond. All three struggled with mental health in their youth, and Galland, diagnosed with manic depression, died by suicide in 1995. The study's results were never published, and its records are sealed until 2066. Closing text explains that Kellman and Shafran eventually received heavily redacted files with no formal conclusions.

The film premiered at the 2018 Sundance Film Festival, where it won the U.S. Documentary Special Jury Award for Storytelling. It was nominated for a BAFTA for Best Documentary and was shortlisted for the Academy Award for Best Documentary Feature. Rotten Tomatoes reported 96% positive reviews, praising it as a surreal, surprising inquiry into reality and identity.

overview: Nate Johnson, a Los Angeles man estranged from his wife and three children, decides to reconnect with his family by taking them with him on a road trip to Missouri for a big family reunion.
production_companies: A Bird and a Bear Entertainment
tagline: Take the ride.
title: Johnson Family Vacation
plot:
Johnson Family Vacation is a comedy film that revolves around the misadventures of the Johnson family during their disastrous road trip to Walley World. The movie explores several themes, primarily centered around the importance of family bonding and the challenges that come with it.

At its core, the film delves into the complexities of family relationships, showcasing the love, frustration, and humor that often accompany them. The characters' interactions are filled with witty banter, physical comedy, and heartfelt moments, highlighting the ups and downs of family life.

The movie also touches on themes of nostalgia, as the family's trip to Walley World becomes a nostalgic journey for the parents, who are trying to recapture their own childhood memories. This nostalgia serves as a catalyst for the family's bonding experience, as they learn to appreciate each other's quirks and imperfections.

Furthermore, Johnson Family Vacation pokes fun at modern suburban life, satirizing the monotony and superficiality of middle-class existence. The film's portrayal of the characters' mundane daily routines and their desperation for excitement serves as a commentary on the human desire for adventure and connection.

Ultimately, the movie presents a heartwarming and humorous exploration of family dynamics, love, and acceptance, reminding viewers that even in the most chaotic moments, family can be a source of comfort, support, and joy.

belongs_to_collection.name: The Secret Life of Pets Collection

overview: The quiet life of a terrier named Max is upended when his owner takes in Duke, a stray whom Max instantly dislikes.
tagline: Think this is what they do all day?
title: The Secret Life of Pets
plot:
The Secret Life of Pets is a 2016 animated comedy film produced by Illumination Entertainment. The movie revolves around what pets do when their owners are away, and it explores several themes that add depth to the story.

One of the main themes of The Secret Life of Pets is the concept of loneliness and companionship. The protagonist, Max, a terrier who is obsessed with his owner Katie, feels lonely and neglected when she leaves for work every day. He longs for attention and connection, which he finds in Duke, a stray dog who becomes his friend. This theme highlights the importance of social connections and relationships in our lives.

Another significant theme is the idea of identity and self-discovery. Max struggles to find his place in the world when Katie leaves him behind, but eventually, he discovers that being a pet doesn't mean you're not important or loved. He learns to appreciate himself and finds happiness in his own way. This theme encourages viewers to explore their own identities and find their passions.

The movie also touches on the theme of responsibility and ownership. Max's owner Katie is often busy with her work, leaving Max feeling abandoned. However, when Duke gets into trouble, Max takes it upon himself to rescue him, showing that even though we may not be in control of our owners' lives, we can still take care of ourselves and those around us.

Furthermore, The Secret Life of Pets explores the theme of friendship and loyalty. Max and Duke form an unlikely bond, which becomes a source of comfort and support for both characters. Their friendship shows that even though we may come from different backgrounds or have different personalities, we can still find common ground and become close companions.

Lastly, the movie pokes fun at human behavior and societal norms. The Secret Life of Pets satirizes our tendency to anthropomorphize animals and treat them like humans. It also playfully critiques modern society's obsession with technology and social media, highlighting the importance of human connection in a world that often prioritizes screens over relationships.

Overall, The Secret Life of Pets is a heartwarming and entertaining film that explores various themes that resonate with audiences of all ages.

overview: Paris, 1830. In the heart of the town, Vidocq, a famous detective, disappears as he fights the Alchemist, an assassin that he has been pursuing for a few months. His young biographer, Etienne Boisset, decides to avenge Vidocq's death and takes the investigation on...
tagline: To look into his mask was to lose your soul.
title: Vidocq
plot:
Vidocq is a 2001 French drama film directed by Pierre Chovet. The movie is based on the life of Eugène François Vidocq, a French detective and former prisoner who founded the first private detective agency in France.

The main theme of Vidocq revolves around the struggle for identity and redemption. The protagonist, played by Gérard Depardieu, is a complex character who has been to prison and has spent years trying to redeem himself. Throughout the film, he navigates his way through the dark underbelly of 19th-century Paris, using his wits and resourcefulness to survive.

One of the central themes of Vidocq is the concept of identity and how it can be shaped by our experiences and circumstances. The protagonist's past mistakes and failures have left him with a sense of self-doubt and uncertainty, but as he navigates his way through the world, he begins to forge a new identity for himself.

The film also explores the theme of redemption and personal growth. Vidocq is a character who has been given a second chance at life, and he uses this opportunity to make amends for past mistakes and to build a better future for himself.

Furthermore, the movie touches on the social issues of 19th-century France, such as poverty, crime, and corruption. The protagonist's work as a detective allows him to observe the darker aspects of society, but it also gives him a sense of purpose and fulfillment.

Overall, Vidocq is a thought-provoking drama that explores themes of identity, redemption, and personal growth in the context of 19th-century France.

overview: After moving to a new California town, a young woman learns that her new friends are a pack of vampires.
tagline: Never grow old. Never die. Never know fear again.
title: Lost Boys: The Tribe
plot:
Lost Boys: The Tribe is a 2008 supernatural horror film that serves as a sequel to the 1987 cult classic Lost Boys. The movie follows a group of young travelers who stumble upon an isolated tribe living in the desert, and they soon discover that this tribe is comprised of vampires.

The main theme of Lost Boys: The Tribe revolves around the struggle for identity and belonging. The characters are all outsiders who have been rejected by society, and they find themselves drawn to the vampire tribe as a way to escape their painful pasts and find acceptance. However, as they become more entrenched in the tribe's lifestyle, they begin to realize that this sense of belonging comes at a terrible cost.

The film also explores the idea of toxic masculinity and the dangers of patriarchal societies. The vampire tribe is led by a charismatic and ruthless leader who preys on young men, exploiting their vulnerabilities and desires for power and control. This serves as a commentary on how societal expectations can lead individuals to become aggressive and dominant, often at the expense of others.

Furthermore, Lost Boys: The Tribe touches on themes of addiction and codependency. Many of the characters are struggling with substance abuse or other forms of self-destructive behavior, and they find themselves drawn to the vampire tribe's lifestyle as a way to cope with their demons. However, this coping mechanism ultimately proves to be destructive, leading to chaos and devastation.

Overall, Lost Boys: The Tribe is a dark and unsettling film that explores the complexities of human nature and the dangers of toxic relationships.

overview: A high school senior drives cross-country with his best friends to hook up with a babe he met online.
tagline: He's leaving virgin territory.
title: Sex Drive
plot:
Sex Drive is a 2008 American coming-of-age comedy film directed by Steven Anthony Lawrence and written by Steven Anthony Lawrence and Chris Bremner. The movie stars Josh Peck, Amanda Crew, and Nick Swardson.

The story revolves around Adam (played by Josh Peck), a high school senior who has been pining for his best friend's sister, Lane (played by Amanda Crew), since childhood. However, their friendship is put to the test when Adam discovers that Lane is now dating his best friend, Seth (played by Nick Swardson).

Adam decides to embark on a road trip with his friend, Jesse (played by Clark Duke), to lose his virginity before graduation. Along the way, they pick up two women, Lane and Jessica (played by Sara Paxton), who join them for the journey.

As the group travels across the country, Adam's feelings for Lane become increasingly complicated. He struggles with his own desires and the fear of losing his friendship with Seth. Meanwhile, Jesse tries to navigate his own relationships and find a sense of purpose in life.

The movie takes a turn when the group stops at a truck stop, where they meet a mysterious woman named Amber (played by Sarah Roemer). Adam becomes smitten with her, but their relationship is short-lived due to her troubled past.

Throughout the film, the characters face various challenges and learn valuable lessons about friendship, love, and growing up. The movie features a mix of humor, drama, and heartwarming moments that make it relatable to audiences.

As the road trip comes to an end, Adam must confront his feelings for Lane and figure out what he truly wants in life. In the end, Adam learns to appreciate the value of true friendship and the importance of being honest with oneself and others.

Overall, Sex Drive is a lighthearted and entertaining film that explores themes of first love, friendship, and self-discovery. With its talented cast and engaging storyline, it has become a cult classic among fans of coming-of-age comedies.

overview: Jackie Justice is a mixed martial arts fighter who leaves the sport in disgrace. Down on her luck and simmering with rage and regret years after the fight, she's coaxed into a brutal underground fight by her manager and boyfriend Desi and grabs the attention of a fight league promoter who promises Jackie a life back in the Octagon. But the road to redemption becomes unexpectedly personal when Manny - the son she gave up as an infant - shows up at her doorstep. A triumphant story of a fighter who reclaims her power, in and out of the ring, when everyone has counted her out
tagline: It's not a second chance. It's a last chance.
title: Bruised
plot:
Bruised is a 2021 American action-drama film written and directed by Halle Berry. The movie follows the story of Jackie Justice, a former MMA fighter who seeks redemption after a tragic accident in her past.

At its core, Bruised explores themes of trauma, grief, and the complexities of female empowerment. Jackie's journey is marked by a deep-seated need for control and a desperate attempt to reclaim her sense of identity and purpose. As she navigates the dark underbelly of the MMA world, she must confront the painful memories of her past and the ways in which they have shaped her into the person she is today.

Throughout the film, Berry delves into the idea that trauma can be both a source of strength and a crippling burden. Jackie's experiences have left her with physical and emotional scars, but it is through her struggles that she begins to find a sense of purpose and belonging. The movie also touches on the theme of female solidarity and the ways in which women can support and uplift each other in the face of adversity.

One of the most striking aspects of Bruised is its portrayal of the complexities of female rage and the ways in which it can be both a source of power and a destructive force. Jackie's character is multifaceted and nuanced, embodying both vulnerability and ferocity. As she navigates her journey, Berry masterfully captures the intensity and emotionality of this inner conflict, creating a deeply human and relatable character.

Ultimately, Bruised is a powerful exploration of the human condition, one that delves into the darkest corners of the human experience and emerges with a message of hope and resilience.

overview: Tom And Jerry are among the last animals living in Storybook Town, a fairy tale-inspired theme park "where dreams come true, if you believe."
title: Tom and Jerry's Giant Adventure
plot:
Tom and Jerry's Giant Adventure is an animated film that revolves around the classic cat-and-mouse duo, Tom and Jerry, in a fantastical world filled with giant creatures and wacky adventures.

At its core, the movie explores themes of friendship and camaraderie between two sworn enemies. Despite their constant battles, Tom and Jerry develop an unlikely bond as they navigate this new world together. This unexpected alliance allows them to put aside their differences and work towards a common goal: finding a way back home.

The film also touches on the idea of growth and self-discovery. As Tom and Jerry face various challenges in this giant world, they learn valuable lessons about themselves and each other. They discover that there's more to life than just chasing each other around, and that sometimes, it's okay to let your guard down and trust someone else.

Furthermore, the movie pokes fun at the idea of societal expectations and norms. The giant creatures in this world are often portrayed as one-dimensional caricatures, highlighting the absurdity of trying to fit into predetermined roles or categories. Tom and Jerry's adventures serve as a commentary on the importance of embracing individuality and not taking oneself too seriously.

Overall, Tom and Jerry's Giant Adventure is a lighthearted, entertaining film that celebrates the power of friendship and self-acceptance in the face of adversity.

overview: A tough nightclub bouncer struggling to raise his 8-year-old daughter is forced to go undercover after an unfortunate event.
title: The Bouncer
plot:
The Bouncer (original title: Lukas) is a 2018 French-Belgian action thriller film directed by Julien Leclercq and starring Jean-Claude Van Damme, Sveva Alviti, Sami Bouajila, Alice Verset and Sam Louwyck. Set in Belgium, it follows a nightclub bouncer who is coerced into helping the authorities bring down a crime boss. The original European version, released as Lukas, is mostly in French with some Flemish and English, while the version released a year later in the United States as The Bouncer had some scenes cut and was dubbed into English.

Lukas fled South Africa after the death of his wife and now lives quietly in his native Belgium with his eight-year-old daughter, Sarah, working as a bouncer at a nightclub. One night he restrains an aggressive patron who then badly injures himself while trying to attack him. Because the injured man is the son of a member of the European Parliament, Lukas loses his job and comes under investigation by a mysterious officer named Maxim, who gives him a choice: go to prison, or go undercover at a strip club owned by Jan Dekkers, an organized crime figure, and spy on him. Lukas reluctantly agrees and soon finds himself drawn into Jan's world. His first job is to drive Lisa, an Italian woman once indicted for forgery, and he gradually learns that Jan is planning a large counterfeiting operation. Meanwhile his daughter is taken into the care of social services, and Lukas realizes that cooperating may be the only way to get her back. He is sent on increasingly dangerous assignments, including the kidnapping of a drug cook to be traded to Dutch gangsters for the special watermarked paper needed to print banknotes, a deal that turns violent. When Lukas tries to quit, Maxim threatens to send him back to South Africa, to face punishment for what he did after his wife's killers went unpunished by the police. Caught between the police and the criminals, and forming a cautious bond with Lisa, who has her own reasons to escape her past, Lukas must stay alive long enough to see the operation through and protect his daughter.

The film received generally positive reviews from critics, and on Rotten Tomatoes it holds a 100% approval rating based on five reviews. The cast also includes Kevin Janssens, with Van Damme in the title role of Lukas.

overview: Headstrong farmer Rosemary Muldoon has her heart set on winning her neighbour Anthony Reilly's love. The problem is, Anthony seems to have inherited a family curse, and remains oblivious to his beautiful admirer. Stung by his father's plans to sell the family farm to his American nephew, Anthony is jolted into pursuing his dreams.
production_companies: The Western Regional Audiovisual Producers Fund/Wrap Fund
tagline: There's nothing more dangerous... than an Irish woman in love.
title: Wild Mountain Thyme
plot:
Wild Mountain Thyme is a romantic comedy of 2020 written and directed by John Patrick Shanley, who adapted it from his own play Outside Mullingar. Emily Blunt and Jamie Dornan star as Rosemary Muldoon and Anthony Reilly, neighbouring farmers in rural Ireland, with Jon Hamm as Anthony's American cousin Adam Kelly, Christopher Walken as Anthony's father Tony and Dearbhla Molloy, reprising her stage role, as Rosemary's mother Aoife.

In County Mayo, two introverted misfits approaching forty have spent their whole lives on adjoining farms. Rosemary has long loved Anthony, who seems oblivious; a childhood memory shows him pushing her down after she defended him from a girl who mocked him. Anthony hears a voice in the fields telling him to "go", though he will not say where. Convinced that his reclusive son will never marry and continue the family line, Tony plans to disinherit him and sell the farm to his nephew Adam, a New York banker. Anthony resolves to propose to Rosemary with his late mother's ring, only to lose it in a field, and spends weeks combing the ground with a metal detector.

Adam arrives for Tony's 75th birthday, charms Rosemary with his directness and invites her to New York. After Rosemary's mother dies, Tony abandons the sale so as not to spoil the young couple's chances, then reconciles with Anthony on his deathbed. Left alone on their farms, Rosemary reaches out, but Anthony pushes her away and urges her to leave Ireland. She visits Adam, who takes her to Swan Lake, kisses her and tells her that pining for Anthony is making her miserable, yet she refuses to give up. Back home she confronts Anthony, who finally admits the secret that has wrecked his past romances: he believes he is a honeybee. Rosemary produces the ring she found, he proposes, and he realises the voice had been telling him to go to her all along. The film ends in the pub, where the whole village, joined by the couple's late parents, sings "Wild Mountain Thyme".

Shot in and around Crossmolina and Ballina in 2019, the film was released by Bleecker Street in the United States in December 2020. Its trailer was mocked for its Irish accents, and critics were largely negative, with 25% on Rotten Tomatoes.

overview: Fresh out of college and stuck at his New Jersey home without a clear path forward, 22-year-old Andrew begins working as a party starter for bar/bat mitzvahs—where he strikes up a unique friendship with a young mom and her teenage daughter.
tagline: Falling in love is easy. Growing up is hard.
title: Cha Cha Real Smooth
plot:
Cha Cha Real Smooth is a 2022 American coming-of-age comedy-drama film written and directed by Andrew Ahn. The movie follows the story of Dave Johnson, played by Cooper Hoffman, who embarks on a road trip to find his biological father in New York City.

The main themes of Cha Cha Real Smooth include:

1. Identity: The film explores Dave's journey to discover his roots and understand where he comes from. He struggles with his identity as a white man raised by a single mother, and his experiences on the road help him navigate this complex aspect of himself.
2. Family: The movie delves into the complexities of family relationships, particularly the idea that family is not just about blood ties but also about the people who raise and support you. Dave's search for his father forces him to confront his own feelings about family and belonging.
3. Coming-of-age: Cha Cha Real Smooth is a classic coming-of-age story, as Dave navigates the challenges of young adulthood, including relationships, identity, and finding one's place in the world.
4. Cultural heritage: The film explores the cultural heritage of the Latinx community, particularly through the character of Ese, played by Gustavo Quintero, who becomes a mentor to Dave on his journey. The movie highlights the importance of preserving cultural traditions and passing them down to future generations.
5. Human connection: Throughout the film, Dave forms meaningful connections with people he meets on his journey, including Ese, his mother, and other characters. These relationships help him grow as a person and find a sense of belonging.

Overall, Cha Cha Real Smooth is a heartwarming and humorous exploration of identity, family, and coming-of-age themes, set against the vibrant backdrop of New York City's Latinx community.

overview: Years after his squad was ambushed during the Gulf War, Major Ben Marco finds himself having terrible nightmares. He begins to doubt that his fellow squad-mate Sergeant Raymond Shaw, now a vice-presidential candidate, is the hero he remembers him being. As Marco's doubts deepen, Shaw's political power grows, and, when Marco finds a mysterious implant embedded in his back, the memory of what really happened begins to return.
tagline: Everything is under control.
title: The Manchurian Candidate
plot:
The Manchurian Candidate is a 2004 American psychological political thriller film directed and produced by Jonathan Demme. A remake of the 1962 film, itself adapted from Richard Condon's 1959 novel, it stars Denzel Washington as Bennett Marco, Liev Schreiber as Raymond Shaw, Jon Voight as Senator Tom Jordan and Meryl Streep as Eleanor Prentiss Shaw, Raymond's ruthless mother, with Kimberly Elise. While it keeps the title of the novel, the film changes the meaning of "Manchurian", which no longer refers to brainwashing in Manchuria during the Korean War but to a sinister multinational company. Paramount Pictures released it on July 30, 2004.

During the Persian Gulf War in 1991, Major Bennett Marco commanded a U.S. Army unit whose reconnaissance patrol was ambushed in Kuwait. Sergeant Raymond Shaw was awarded the Medal of Honor for leading the survivors on a three-day escape through the desert. Years later, Shaw is a congressman from New York, and his mother, the domineering Senator Eleanor Prentiss Shaw, uses her influence to secure him the vice-presidential nomination over the favorite, Senator Tom Jordan, whose daughter Jocelyn was Raymond's childhood sweetheart. When Al Melvin, one of Marco's former soldiers, tells him about disturbing dreams in which the patrol was captured, tortured and brainwashed, Marco feels compelled to investigate. In New York he meets Rosie, a friendly supermarket clerk who offers him a place to stay, and he discovers a small metal implant buried in his back. Convinced that Shaw has one too, Marco confronts him and bites one out of his back, and with the help of a scientist friend he links the devices to Manchurian Global, a powerful private equity firm with deep political connections, including to Senator Shaw. As he recovers clearer memories of what happened in the desert and learns of a South African geneticist accused of experimenting on political prisoners, Marco realizes that he and Shaw were programmed during their missing days, and that a plot to place a controlled agent a heartbeat away from the presidency is nearing completion, putting him in a desperate race to stop it.

The film received positive reviews. On Rotten Tomatoes, 79% of 208 critics' reviews are positive, with a consensus that although it is not the classic its predecessor is, the update is well acted and has a chilling resonance, and Metacritic gave it a score of 76 out of 100. It grossed $96.1 million worldwide against an $80 million budget.

overview: A frustrated man decides to take justice into his own hands after a plea bargain sets one of his family's killers free. He targets not only the killer but also the district attorney and others involved in the deal.
tagline: Justice at any cost.
title: Law Abiding Citizen
plot:
Law Abiding Citizen is a 2009 American vigilante action thriller film directed by F. Gary Gray and written by Kurt Wimmer. Set in Philadelphia, it stars Gerard Butler as Clyde Shelton, a man who wages war on the justice system after one of his family's killers receives a lenient plea deal, and Jamie Foxx as the prosecutor Nick Rice, with Bruce McGill, Colm Meaney, Leslie Bibb, Regina Hall, Michael Irby, Christian Stolte and Josh Stewart.

When two burglars, Rupert Ames and Clarence Darby, invade Clyde's home, Darby stabs him and rapes and murders his wife and daughter. Prosecutor Nick Rice, unwilling to risk his high conviction rate on weak evidence, ignores Clyde's pleas and lets Darby plead guilty to third-degree murder for a three-year sentence in exchange for testifying against Ames, who is sentenced to death. Ten years later, Ames's execution goes horribly wrong because the drugs have been replaced. Disguised as a police officer, Clyde paralyzes Darby with a toxin-laced trap and records himself torturing him to death. Arrested, he mails the recording to Nick's daughter and, representing himself, berates the judge who approved Darby's deal, who then denies him bail.

From his cell, Clyde trades confessions for luxuries, and when Nick misses a deadline, Darby's lawyer is found buried alive. Clyde kills his cellmate and is put in solitary confinement. A CIA contact reveals that he was once an agency specialist in unconventional assassinations. Clyde says that he is exposing the failures of the justice system, and the killings continue: the judge dies when her phone explodes, Nick's assistant and colleagues die in car bombings, and the district attorney is killed by an armed robot. Promoted to acting district attorney, Nick learns that Clyde owns a building near the prison, where he and a detective find a tunnel leading to the solitary cells, revealing that Clyde has been slipping out undetected. Clyde plants a napalm bomb beneath a City Hall emergency meeting, but it has been moved under Clyde's bed, and Clyde dies clutching his daughter's bracelet when he triggers it. Nick finally attends his daughter's cello recital.

Released on October 16, 2009, the film opened second at the box office and grossed about $127 million worldwide. Reviews were generally negative; critics praised the premise and central performances but criticized the logic, violence and moral stance, and Rotten Tomatoes gave it 26% approval.

overview: A boy named Eli with a rare autoimmune disorder is confined to a special experimental clinic for his treatment. He soon begins experiencing supernatural forces, turning the supposedly safe facility into a haunted prison for him and his fellow patients.
title: Eli
plot:
Eli is a 2019 American supernatural horror film directed by Ciarán Foy from a screenplay by David Chirchirillo, Ian Goldberg and Richard Naing, based on a story by Chirchirillo. It stars Charlie Shotwell as the title character, with Max Martini, Sadie Sink, Lili Taylor and Kelly Reilly. Principal photography took place in New Orleans in early 2018. Paramount Players originally acquired the film and scheduled it for release in January 2019, but Netflix bought the distribution rights from Paramount and released it on its service on October 18, 2019.

Young Eli Miller suffers from such severe allergic reactions to the outside world that he must live inside a protective "bubble suit". Hoping for a cure, his parents, Rose and Paul, take him to the secluded clinic of Dr. Isabella Horn, which has been built inside a renovated old house where Eli can finally remove his suit. At first he is overjoyed to enjoy comforts that have always been denied to him, but the treatments he must undergo prove excruciatingly painful, and he soon begins to experience frightening supernatural phenomena in the house. Ghostly figures repeatedly leave him the message "LIE", making him wonder whether they are warning him about Dr. Horn. Eli befriends Haley, a girl who is the only person who believes the house is haunted; she tells him that none of Horn's previous patients ever left. Eli works out that the word is really the inverted number 317, the code to Horn's office, where he finds records showing that every earlier patient died during the third and final treatment. When his parents refuse to take him away and his father sedates him, Eli becomes desperate, and his search for the truth leads him to a hidden passage beneath the house and to a startling revelation about the nature of his illness, his family and the real purpose of the clinic.

On Rotten Tomatoes the film has an approval rating of 52% based on 25 reviews, with a consensus that, though intermittently effective rather than wholly successful, it offers horror fans a handful of jump scares in search of a truly terrifying story.

overview: The Sharkpack gets ready for Halloween with the spooky legend of the "Fearsome Fog" — and Sharkdog must save trick-or-treating from a slimy sea monster!
title: Sharkdog’s Fintastic Halloween
plot: The Sharkpack gets ready for Halloween with the spooky legend of the "Fearsome Fog" — and Sharkdog must save trick-or-treating from a slimy sea monster!

overview: Ivan is an ordinary guy who is transferred from modern Moscow to the fantasy world Belogorye. In this parallel universe where characters of Russian fairy tales live, magic is an integral part of daily life, and arguments are settled with the help of sword . Unexpectedly, Ivan finds himself in the middle of a battle between good and evil, and he must discover why everyone thinks that he must play the main role in upcoming events...
title: The Last Warrior
plot:
The Last Warrior, also known as The Last Knight (Poslyedniy bogatyr), is a 2017 Russian fantasy comedy directed by Dmitriy Dyachenko. It was produced by The Walt Disney Company CIS with Yellow, Black and White and Kinoslovo. Viktor Khorinyak stars as Ivan, with Mila Sivatskaya as Vasilisa the Wise, Elena Yakovleva as Baba Yaga, Konstantin Lavronenko as Koschei, Ekaterina Vilkova as Princess Varvara and Yevgeny Dyatlov as Dobrynya Nikitich.

In Belogorie, a magical parallel ancient Russia, the sorceress Varvara petrifies the hero Alyosha Popovich and casts him into the sea. In Moscow, the orphan Ivan Naydenov is a con artist posing as a "white mage" on rigged psychic shows. He begins to doubt his life when he is asked to cure a boy in a coma. Fleeing a client's husband, he lands in Belogorie, a world of Russian fairy-tale characters. A volkhv tells him he is the lost son of the hero Ilya Muromets. He is brought to the friendly Prince Dobrynya, but Dobrynya's wife Varvara secretly imprisons him. There, the disembodied Koschei tells him only the sword Kladenets can send him home. Baba Yaga and Vasilisa, cursed to live mostly as a frog, free the prisoners, and the unlikely group sets out to find the sword with help from Vodyanoy the merman.
