Ivan learns that the jealous Varvara turned Vasilisa's village into frogs, and grows fond of her, though he still wants to go home. Varvara captures his friends and forces Ivan to retrieve the sword. Koschei turns out to be in league with her, and Dobrynya is the real mastermind, planning to use the sword to become immortal. Dobrynya betrays Koschei, and Ivan escapes to Moscow. Unable to abandon Vasilisa, Ivan returns, frees the dragon Zmey Gorynych and fights his way to Dobrynya with a handgun. As he duels the now-immortal prince, Koschei is moved by Ivan's selflessness and destroys the magic stone, killing both himself and Dobrynya. Varvara flees, her petrified victims return to life, and Ivan reunites with his father Ilya. He marries Vasilisa and returns to Earth only briefly to heal the boy. A mid-credits scene reveals that Ivan's housekeeper, Galina, is Varvara's mother.

The film was released in October 2017. By late November it was Russia's highest-grossing local-language release, earning more than 1.7 billion rubles in total and recovering its budget in 11 days; Going Vertical soon topped it. Critical reviews were mixed, with praise for its humor but criticism of its clichés. Sequels followed in 2021.

overview: Counselors are being killed off at summer camp, and Sam is stuck in the middle of it. Instead of contacting the cops, he calls his friend and slasher-film expert Chuck to discuss his options.
tagline: It's summer camp. What did you expect?
title: You Might Be the Killer
plot:
You Might Be the Killer is a 2018 American supernatural slasher film directed by Brett Simmons, who co-wrote it with Covis Berzoyne and Thomas P. Vitale. It is based on a concept by authors Chuck Wendig and Sam Sykes. Fran Kranz stars as Sam and Alyson Hannigan as his friend Chuck, with Brittany S. Hall, Patrick Reginald Walker and Keith David in supporting roles.

At Camp Clear Vista, Sam, the panicked head counselor, hides in a cabin and calls Chuck, a horror movie enthusiast. He tells her that a masked killer is murdering the counselors. As Chuck questions him, Sam pieces together the past few days, including the arrival of his ex-girlfriend Imani and the discovery of bodies that left the group trapped at the camp. He keeps blacking out, and when he comes to, he finds the cabin on fire. The evidence piles up: Sam is covered in blood and holding the killer's machete and a strange wooden mask. Chuck concludes that Sam is the killer, and that his blackouts are the moments when the mask takes control.

Flashbacks explain the legend. Long ago, settlers brought dark magic to the land and released an evil entity, which was later sealed inside an oak tree. Centuries later, a woodcarver made a mask from the tree and went on a killing spree before he was stopped and buried with it. Bored counselors went looking for the grave, and a friend named Drew dug up the mask and put it on Sam as a joke. Sam, possessed, killed Drew first. Chuck applies the rules of slasher movies, trying to identify the survivors and warning Sam about Jamie, who may be the "final girl". Sam's feelings for Imani help him remove the mask, but the curse keeps drawing him back. Imani, who faked her death, joins Jamie, and the two lock Sam away, but he escapes. Imani, believing she must be the final girl, turns on Jamie and is killed. At the woodcarver's grave, Sam persuades Jamie to help him bury the mask, but Jamie touches it, falls under its power and stabs Sam to death before walking away with it. Two years later, Chuck receives a call from Sam, now undead.

The idea came from a July 2017 Twitter exchange between Sykes and Wendig about slasher movie clichés, and both served as producers. The film was shot in Louisiana in 2018, premiered at Fantastic Fest and screened at Toronto After Dark and other festivals. Shudder released it on December 6, 2018, and it later came out on DVD and Blu-ray. Rotten Tomatoes reported 60% positive reviews.

overview: A troubled teenage girl who’s struggling to cope with the accidental death of her father suspects that the mysterious killer stalking her hometown is not only her neighbour but her mother’s new romantic interest.
tagline: Danger is closer than you think.
title: Girl at the Window
plot:
Girl at the Window is a 2022 Australian thriller horror film directed by Mark Hartley from a screenplay by Terence Hammond and Nicolette Minster. Produced by Antony I. Ginnane, a key figure of the Ozploitation era who had previously worked with Hartley on Patrick (2013), through F.G. Film Productions, it stars Ella Newton as a grieving teenager and Radha Mitchell as her mother, with Vince Colosimo, James Mackay, Jackson Gallagher, Andrew S. Gilbert and Sharon Johal in supporting roles. The film was shot in Melbourne during the COVID-19 lockdowns and opened in Australian cinemas on 18 August 2022. Rated MA, it runs 84 minutes.

A serial killer dubbed "the Clockwork Killer" by the local media is terrorising a small country town in Victoria, preying on young couples within a three-day pattern by killing the young man and abducting the young woman; the film opens with a teenager in a photo booth and the sudden appearance of a naked, one-eyed corpse behind her. Amy Poynton (Newton), a deeply unhappy teenager, has moved with her newly widowed mother Barbara (Mitchell) to a house on the town's outskirts after the accidental death of her father, whom she still mourns. She resents Barbara's decision to date their working-class neighbour, Chris Mancini (Colosimo), and grows suspicious of him: he is constantly tearing down and rebuilding his house, keeps a large shed locked, takes his van out in the early hours without headlights and turns up uninvited in their home. After sneaking out to peer through his windows, Amy becomes convinced that he is the killer and recruits her school friend Lian to play detective with her, drawing the attention of the real murderer and making themselves targets.

The film received mixed to negative reviews. Sandra Hall of The Sydney Morning Herald gave it two stars, observing that it was a throwback to the Ozploitation films Hartley had celebrated in his 2008 documentary Not Quite Hollywood, but found it so clunky that credibility became its first casualty, with ridiculous choices by its young sleuths, a thankless, tin-eared role for Mitchell and little energy beyond a gruesome scene involving an eyeball. Mel Valentin of ScreenAnarchy described it as a Rear Window clone by way of 1980s slashers that promised far more than it delivered, citing a tonally erratic screenplay and a bland killer reveal.

overview: Novalee Nation is a 17-year-old Tennessee transient who has to grow up in a hurry when she's left pregnant and abandoned by her boyfriend on a roadside, and takes refuge in the friendly aisles of Wal-Mart. Eventually, some eccentric but kindly strangers 'adopt' Novalee and her infant daughter, helping them buck the odds and build a new life.
tagline: Laughter is harder... Friendship is stronger... Trust is deeper... When it comes from the heart.
title: Where the Heart Is
plot:
Where the Heart Is is a poignant and thought-provoking film that explores the complexities of human relationships, identity, and the search for belonging. The movie delves into the life of Novalee Nation, a pregnant teenager who finds herself abandoned at a Walmart store in Oklahoma after her boyfriend leaves her.

As Novalee navigates this challenging situation, she must confront her own vulnerabilities and insecurities, as well as the harsh realities of poverty, loneliness, and social isolation. The film masterfully weaves together themes of resilience, hope, and redemption, showcasing Novalee's capacity to adapt and grow in the face of adversity.

Throughout the movie, the director, Matt Williams, skillfully explores the tensions between individual desire for autonomy and the need for human connection and community. Novalee's journey is marked by a series of encounters with various characters, each of whom offers her a unique perspective on life, love, and belonging.

Ultimately, Where the Heart Is is a powerful exploration of what it means to be human, to find one's place in the world, and to discover the depths of the heart. The film's narrative is both deeply personal and universally relatable, inviting audiences to reflect on their own experiences with identity, community, and the complexities of human relationships.

overview: Based on the true story of two young men, David Packouz and Efraim Diveroli, who won a $300 million contract from the Pentagon to arm America's allies in Afghanistan.
tagline: An American dream
title: War Dogs
plot:
War Dogs is a biographical crime comedy-drama film directed by Todd Phillips, released in 2016 by Warner Bros. Pictures.

The movie is based on the true story of Efraim Diveroli and David Packouz, two young men from Los Angeles who become arms dealers during the Iraq War. The film follows their journey from their early days as small-time hustlers to becoming successful arms dealers, and eventually, to their downfall.

The story begins with Efraim (played by Jonah Hill), a struggling young man working at his father's car wash in Los Angeles. He is joined by David Packouz (played by Miles Teller), a charismatic but aimless young man who has just dropped out of college. The two become fast friends and start selling marijuana to make ends meet.

Their fortunes change when they are approached by Efraim's uncle, Alonzo (played by Jeremy Renner), who is working for the U.S. government as an arms dealer. He offers them a lucrative deal to supply the Afghan military with machine guns, which they initially reject due to their inexperience and lack of knowledge about the business.

However, after some persuasion from Efraim's uncle, they decide to take on the job. They start by purchasing 1,000 AK-47 machine guns from an Israeli arms dealer, but things quickly go awry when they realize that they have no idea how to deliver the guns or handle the complex logistics of selling them.

Despite their inexperience, Efraim and David manage to convince some of their friends to join their operation, including a young man named Kristofer (played by Bradley Cooper), who becomes their partner. The group starts to build a network of suppliers and buyers, but their success is short-lived.

As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that Efraim and David's partnership is built on lies, deceit, and a lack of trust. They start to turn on each other, and their relationships with their friends and family begin to fray.

The film takes a dark turn when Efraim and David are approached by a Russian arms dealer, Viktor (played by Anatol Yusef), who offers them an even bigger deal. However, things take a deadly turn when they realize that the guns they have been selling are being used against American soldiers in Afghanistan.

In the end, Efraim and David's empire comes crashing down around them. They are arrested and charged with conspiracy to defraud the U.S. government, and their lives are forever changed.

Throughout the film, Jonah Hill and Miles Teller deliver strong performances as the two main characters. Jeremy Renner brings his signature charm and wit to the role of Efraim's uncle, while Bradley Cooper shines in a supporting role as Kristofer.

Overall, War Dogs is a gripping and intense drama that explores the darker side of human nature. It is a cautionary tale about the dangers of greed, ambition, and the consequences of playing with fire.

overview: An intimate look at the epochal financial crisis of 2008 and the powerful men and women who decided the fate of the world's economy in a matter of a few weeks.
tagline: Main Street took the fall. Wall Street got the check.
title: Too Big to Fail
plot:
Too Big to Fail is a 2011 American biographical drama television film directed by Curtis Hanson and written by Peter Gould, based on Andrew Ross Sorkin's 2009 non-fiction book of the same name. Its ensemble cast includes William Hurt as Treasury Secretary Henry Paulson and Paul Giamatti as Federal Reserve Chair Ben Bernanke, along with Edward Asner, Billy Crudup, Topher Grace, Cynthia Nixon, Bill Pullman, Tony Shalhoub and James Woods. The film premiered on HBO on May 23, 2011, and chronicles the 2008 financial crisis, centering on the collapse of the investment bank Lehman Brothers and its effects on the global economy.

In 2008, in the middle of an election year, the subprime mortgage crisis is battering investment banks loaded with real estate assets. Having already guaranteed the sale of Bear Stearns to JPMorgan Chase at a fraction of its value, Paulson is wary of another bailout and refuses to intervene as shares of Lehman Brothers plunge. Lehman's chief executive, Richard Fuld, makes a series of poor decisions, and by Friday, September 12, the bank's stock has fallen to single digits. Timothy Geithner, head of the Federal Reserve Bank of New York, urges Paulson to support a merger between Lehman and Bank of America, but Paulson insists that the other major banks guarantee any deal and summons their chief executives to an emergency weekend meeting at the Federal Reserve. While they negotiate, Bank of America unexpectedly agrees to buy Merrill Lynch instead, and a last-ditch sale to the British bank Barclays is blocked by regulators in London. Lehman files for bankruptcy on September 15, and the consequences are immediate: the stock market crashes, investors pull out their money, lending freezes and the insurance giant AIG faces a liquidity crisis that threatens the entire international financial system. With Bernanke warning of another Great Depression, Paulson and his team scramble to rescue AIG and to find a way to restore credit, debating plans to buy toxic assets or to inject capital directly into the banks while trying to persuade Congress and Wall Street to cooperate.

The film received generally favorable reviews, with a 74% approval rating on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 67 out of 100. It earned 11 nominations at the 63rd Primetime Emmy Awards, and Giamatti won the Screen Actors Guild Award for his portrayal of Bernanke.

overview: A true story of survival, as a young couple's chance encounter leads them first to love, and then on the adventure of a lifetime as they face one of the most catastrophic hurricanes in recorded history.
title: Adrift
plot:
Adrift is a 2018 American romantic drama film directed by Baltasar Kormákur and written by Shana Feste. The movie is based on the true story of Tami Oldham and Richard Sharp, two sailors who survived a devastating storm at sea.

The film begins with Tami (played by Shailene Woodley), a young woman from California who has always been drawn to the ocean. She meets Richard (played by Sam Claflin), a British sailor, on a boat in Hawaii, and they quickly fall in love. The two decide to set sail together on their own boat, the Satori, with the goal of exploring the Pacific Islands.

As they navigate through the islands, Tami and Richard's relationship deepens, but they also face numerous challenges, including rough seas and equipment failures. However, their romance seems strong enough to overcome any obstacle, and they continue to sail together, enjoying the freedom and adventure that comes with life at sea.

Tragedy strikes when a severe storm hits the Satori, causing it to take on water and become severely damaged. Tami and Richard are forced to abandon ship and cling to a liferaft as the storm rages on around them. The two are separated in the chaos, and Tami is left alone, clinging to the raft for her life.

The film's second half follows Tami's harrowing journey as she tries to survive the storm and find her way back to land. She faces numerous challenges, including dehydration, exposure to the elements, and encounters with wild animals. Meanwhile, Richard is also struggling to stay alive, but he eventually succumbs to his injuries.

As the days pass, Tami becomes increasingly desperate, and she begins to question whether she will ever see Richard again or make it back to land. In a dramatic turn of events, Tami spots a ship on the horizon and manages to signal for help, finally finding safety after 13 long days at sea.

The film ends with Tami reflecting on her ordeal and the lessons she has learned about love, survival, and resilience. She realizes that her relationship with Richard was real, but it was also fragile and fleeting. Despite their love for each other, they were both young and inexperienced sailors who underestimated the power of the ocean.

Throughout the film, Shailene Woodley delivers a powerful performance as Tami Oldham, capturing the character's vulnerability, determination, and spirit. Sam Claflin is equally impressive as Richard Sharp, conveying the complexity and depth of their relationship. The film's cinematography is stunning, capturing the beauty and fury of the ocean in breathtaking detail.

Overall, Adrift is a gripping and emotional drama that explores the human side of survival at sea. With its strong performances, stunning visuals, and true story basis, it's a must-see for fans of romantic dramas and adventure films.

overview: A retired hitman whose wife goes on a trip with her friend, and asks him to look after the friend's teenage daughter. Things go awry when he is forced to use a little violence to protect the girl from juvenile delinquents, but then they are found dead and the girl is kidnapped.
tagline: The killer instinct that started again for peace!
title: The Killer
plot:
The Killer, also known as The Killer: A Girl Who Deserves to Die, is a 2022 South Korean action thriller directed by Choi Jae-hoon. It is adapted from Bang Jin-ho's popular novel The Kid Deserves to Die. Jang Hyuk stars as Bang Ui-gang, a retired professional killer, with Lee Seo-young as Kim Yoon-ji, Bruce Khan as Yuri, Lee Seung-joon as Detective Lee Young-ho and Lee Chae-young as Hyeon-soo.

When Ui-gang's wife Hyeon-soo goes on holiday to Jeju with her best friend, she asks him to look after the friend's 17-year-old daughter, Yoon-ji, and he reluctantly agrees. Yoon-ji soon slips away with a group of delinquents led by a girl named Sung-yeon. Using a tracking device he hid in her wallet, Ui-gang finds them threatening her, beats them up and takes her home. The next night, a murder is discovered at the spot where the fight took place, and Detective Lee begins to suspect Ui-gang. Sung-yeon has kept the knife used in the killing, which bears Ui-gang's fingerprints. He tracks her down through the wallet and recovers the knife after fighting Yuri, a former Spetsnaz soldier, only to find on his return that Yoon-ji has been kidnapped.

Ui-gang uncovers a trafficking ring tied to the Russian mafia, saves the girl and discovers that Detective Lee is a corrupt officer working for the organization. A gangster named Park Hyung-joo reveals that a powerful judge ordered Yoon-ji and that the operation answers to a figure known as Pig Mama. Through Lee, Ui-gang learns that Yoon-ji's mother is really her stepmother. At the judge's mansion, Lee betrays him and hands him over to Judge Kim, who is next in line to become Chief Justice of the Supreme Court. Ui-gang breaks free, kills Lee, Yuri and the guards, and finally Judge Kim after learning that Pig Mama is Yoon-ji's stepmother, who is in Jeju with his wife. He travels to the island and kills her. On a Jeju beach, it is revealed that the suicidal teenage girl from his flashbacks was Hyeon-soo.

Principal photography ran from June to October 2021. The film had its world premiere at the 24th Udine Far East Film Festival in April 2022 and was pre-sold to 48 countries and territories. After a red carpet premiere at the Regency Village Theatre in Los Angeles, it opened simultaneously in South Korea and North America on July 13, 2022. It later screened at the New York Asian and Fantasia festivals and reached Japan in May 2023. Son Hyun-joo and Cha Tae-hyun appear in cameos.

overview: The mysterious Count Orlok summons Thomas Hutter to his remote Transylvanian castle in the mountains. The eerie Orlok seeks to buy a house near Hutter and his wife, Ellen. After Orlok reveals his vampire nature, Hutter struggles to escape the castle, knowing that Ellen is in grave danger
tagline: A symphony of horror.
title: Nosferatu
plot:
Nosferatu (1922) is a German silent horror film directed by F.W. Murnau, produced by Prana-Film GmbH, and based on Bram Stoker's Dracula.

The main themes of Nosferatu are:

1. **The Fear of the Unknown**: The film explores the fear of the unknown, specifically the fear of death, disease, and the supernatural. Count Orlok, the vampire, is a mysterious and terrifying figure who embodies these fears.
2. **Isolation and Loneliness**: The protagonist, Hutter, is a young man living in isolation, which makes him more susceptible to the vampire's influence. This theme highlights the dangers of loneliness and the importance of human connection.
3. **The Power of Love and Sacrifice**: The film shows how love and sacrifice can be powerful forces against evil. Hutter's love for his fiancée, Ellen, and his desire to protect her drive him to confront the vampire and ultimately save her life.
4. **The Corruption of Innocence**: Count Orlok is a symbol of corruption and decay, and his presence in the film serves as a catalyst for the corruption of those around him. This theme highlights the dangers of allowing evil to enter one's life.
5. **The Supernatural and the Irrational**: The film explores the supernatural and the irrational, highlighting the idea that there are forces beyond human control that can have devastating consequences.

In terms of character analysis:

* Count Orlok is a complex and terrifying figure, embodying both the beauty and the horror of vampirism.
* Hutter is a relatable protagonist who serves as a foil to the vampire's evil influence. His love for Ellen drives him to confront the vampire and ultimately save her life.
* Ellen is a symbol of innocence and purity, who serves as a target for the vampire's corruption.

Overall, Nosferatu is a masterful exploration of the human psyche, delving into themes that are still relevant today, such as the fear of the unknown, the power of love and sacrifice, and the dangers of allowing evil to enter one's life.

overview: Far from Chicago, hairdresser Gina Norris has relocated to Atlanta with her daughter and has quickly established herself as a rare talent in her profession. But after repeatedly butting heads with her shady, over-the-top boss, Jorge, Norris sets out to create her own salon -- even snagging a few of Jorge's employees and clients. Now, Jorge will do anything to shut her down.
tagline: A Cut Above
title: Beauty Shop
plot:
Beauty Shop is a 2005 American comedy film that revolves around the life of Gina, a young woman who leaves her small town to pursue a career in beauty and fashion. The movie explores themes of self-discovery, empowerment, and the struggle for independence.

At its core, Beauty Shop is a story about Gina's journey towards finding her own identity and purpose in life. She navigates through various challenges and experiences that shape her into a stronger and more confident individual. Through her relationships with other characters, particularly her friends and colleagues at the beauty shop, Gina learns valuable lessons about loyalty, friendship, and the importance of staying true to oneself.

The film also touches on themes of female empowerment and the struggle for women's independence in a male-dominated industry. Gina faces numerous obstacles as she tries to establish herself in the competitive world of beauty and fashion, but ultimately emerges as a confident and successful individual.

Overall, Beauty Shop is a heartwarming and uplifting film that celebrates the power of self-discovery and female empowerment.

overview: Paris, 1910. Emile, a shy movie projectionist, and Raoul, a colourful inventor, find themselves embarked on the hunt for a monster terrorizing citizens. They join forces with Lucille, the big-hearted star of the Bird of Paradise cabaret, an eccentric scientist and his irascible monkey to save the monster, who turns out to be an oversized but harmless flea, from the city's ruthlessly ambitious police chief.
title: A Monster in Paris
plot:
A Monster in Paris is a 2011 French animated musical fantasy film directed by Rémi Bezançon, Jean-Benjamin Machuel, and Christophe Lautrette. The movie is set in the late 19th century and follows the story of a young girl named Coco, who lives with her mother in a small apartment in Paris.

Coco's life takes a dramatic turn when she meets a mysterious and handsome stranger, Raoul, who claims to be a famous musician. However, their meeting is interrupted by a monster that attacks Coco's apartment building, causing chaos and destruction throughout the city.

As Coco tries to make sense of the monster's appearance and its connection to her life, she discovers that it is actually a manifestation of her own fears and desires. The monster is revealed to be a symbol of Coco's inner world, which she has been trying to suppress due to the difficulties of her mother's illness.

Throughout the movie, Coco embarks on a journey through Paris, meeting various characters who help her understand herself and her place in the world. She meets a group of street performers, including a charming and talented musician named Raoul, who becomes her love interest.

As Coco navigates the city, she also encounters a mysterious figure known as the "Monster," which is revealed to be a manifestation of her own fears and desires. The Monster is a powerful symbol of Coco's inner world, and it serves as a reminder that she must confront her own emotions in order to move forward.

In the end, Coco comes to terms with her feelings and learns to accept herself for who she is. She also finds love and happiness with Raoul, and the two share a romantic dance at the Moulin Rouge, a famous Parisian nightclub.

The movie features stunning animation, beautiful music, and a captivating storyline that explores themes of identity, self-acceptance, and the power of imagination. The film's use of fantasy elements adds to its sense of wonder and magic, making it a delightful and enchanting experience for audiences of all ages.

Overall, A Monster in Paris is a charming and imaginative movie that celebrates the beauty and creativity of Parisian culture. With its stunning animation, catchy music, and captivating storyline, it is a must-see film for anyone who loves animation, music, or simply great storytelling.

overview: Using a special camera that can see spirits, a family must protect their daughter from an evil entity with a sinister plan.
tagline: You can't save them. All you can do is watch.
title: Paranormal Activity: The Ghost Dimension
plot:
Paranormal Activity: The Ghost Dimension is a 2015 American supernatural horror film directed by Gregory Cleveland and Rodman Flender. The movie serves as the fifth installment in the Paranormal Activity franchise.

The main theme of Paranormal Activity: The Ghost Dimension revolves around the concept of interdimensional travel and the consequences of meddling with forces beyond human understanding. The story follows Katie Featherston's character, Katie, who is now a mother, and her husband, Micah (played by Demián Bichir), as they try to move on from their traumatic experiences in the previous films.

The movie takes a darker and more ominous tone, exploring the idea of an alternate dimension that exists parallel to our own. The Ghost Dimension, which is inhabited by malevolent spirits, begins to bleed into our world, threatening the lives of Katie and her family.

Throughout the film, the themes of grief, trauma, and the consequences of playing with forces beyond human control are prominent. The movie also touches on the idea of the "other side" and the possibility of communication with entities from beyond the grave.

The ending of the film is particularly noteworthy, as it sets up a potential sequel while also providing a sense of closure for Katie's character. Overall, Paranormal Activity: The Ghost Dimension is a tense and unsettling horror film that explores themes of interdimensional travel, trauma, and the consequences of meddling with forces beyond human understanding.

It's worth noting that the movie received mixed reviews from critics and fans, with some feeling that it did not live up to the standards set by previous films in the franchise. However, for those who enjoy supernatural horror movies, Paranormal Activity: The Ghost Dimension offers a thrilling and unsettling viewing experience.

overview: True story of the undersized Depression-era racehorse whose victories lifted not only the spirits of the team behind it but also those of their nation.
tagline: The hopes of a nation rode on a long shot.
title: Seabiscuit
plot:
Seabiscuit is a heartwarming and inspiring film that delves into the underdog story of a small but spirited horse who defies the odds to achieve greatness. The movie, directed by Gary Ross, explores the themes of perseverance, determination, and the unbreakable bond between humans and animals.

At its core, Seabiscuit is a tale of overcoming adversity and proving oneself against all expectations. The film's protagonist, Seabiscuit, faces numerous challenges, from his humble beginnings as an undersized and unproven horse to his struggles with injuries and setbacks on the track. However, through the unwavering support of his trainer, Red Pollard (played by Tobey Maguire), and his owner, Charles Howard (played by Jeff Bridges), Seabiscuit perseveres and ultimately achieves greatness.

The movie also explores the theme of redemption, as Seabiscuit's journey is intertwined with that of Red Pollard, who seeks to redeem himself after a troubled past. Through their shared struggles and triumphs, the film highlights the transformative power of friendship and the human spirit.

Furthermore, Seabiscuit touches on the theme of class and social status, as embodied by the contrast between Charles Howard's wealth and privilege and that of Red Pollard's humble beginnings. The film shows how these differences can be bridged through mutual respect, trust, and a shared passion for horse racing.

Ultimately, Seabiscuit is a movie about hope, resilience, and the power of the human (and animal) spirit to overcome seemingly insurmountable obstacles.

overview: Kenichi and his detective uncle, Shunsaku Ban, leave Japan to visit Metropolis, in search of the criminal, Dr. Laughton. However, when they finally find Dr. Laughton, Kenichi and Shunsaku find themselves seperated and plunged into the middle of a larger conspiracy. While Shunsaku searches for his nephew and explanations, Kenichi tries to protect Tima (a mysterious young girl), from Duke Red and his adopted son Rock, both of whom have very different reasons for wanting to find her.
tagline: Welcome to Metropolis
title: Metropolis
plot:
Metropolis (Japanese: Metoroporisu) is a 2001 Japanese animated cyberpunk drama film loosely based on Osamu Tezuka's 1949 manga of the same name. It was directed by Rintaro from a screenplay by Katsuhiro Otomo and produced by Madhouse, with conceptual support from Tezuka Productions. The Japanese voice cast includes Kei Kobayashi, Yuka Imoto, Kōki Okada, Tarō Ishida and Kōsei Tomita.

In the vast, plutocratic city of Metropolis, humans live alongside robots built to construct and maintain it, but the city's impoverished citizens, forced into its squalid lower levels, resent the machines and blame them for their unemployment. Duke Red, the city's richest and most powerful man, celebrates the completion of the Ziggurat, a colossal skyscraper housing military and scientific facilities. His adopted son Rock leads the Marduks, a paramilitary group that hunts down rogue robots. Meanwhile, the Japanese detective Shunsaku Ban and his young nephew Kenichi arrive in Metropolis to arrest Dr. Laughton, a scientist wanted for organ trafficking. Unknown to them, Red has secretly hired Laughton to build an extraordinarily advanced android, modeled on and named after his late daughter, Tima, who is to serve as the central control unit of a superweapon hidden atop the Ziggurat that will allow him to dominate the world. Jealous of the android, Rock shoots Laughton and sets his laboratory on fire. In the chaos Kenichi finds the newly awakened Tima, and the two fall into the city's sewers, separated from Shunsaku. As they make their way through the lower city, Kenichi protects Tima, who does not know that she is a robot, and the two grow close as her humanity develops. Their journey brings them into contact with a human resistance movement planning a revolution, while political intrigue, a ruthless military commander and the obsessed Rock all close in on them, and Tima's true nature and purpose threaten to bring catastrophe to the city.

Metropolis received highly positive reviews. On Rotten Tomatoes it has an 87% approval rating based on 67 reviews, with a consensus that its eye-popping visuals more than compensate for its relatively routine story, and Metacritic assigned it a score of 75 out of 100. Roger Ebert of the Chicago Sun-Times gave it four out of four stars, calling it one of the best animated films he had ever seen.

overview: An Irish fisherman discovers a woman in his fishing net believing her to be a mermaid.
tagline: The truth is not what you know. It's what you believe.
title: Ondine
plot:
Ondine is a 2009 romantic drama film that explores the complexities of human relationships and the blurred lines between reality and fantasy. The movie follows the story of Pierce, a young man who falls in love with a mysterious woman named Ondine, who claims to be a mermaid.

At its core, Ondine delves into the theme of identity and how it is shaped by our experiences and interactions with others. Ondine's character, in particular, embodies this idea, as she struggles to reconcile her mythical past with her present-day reality. Through her relationship with Pierce, we see how Ondine's sense of self is influenced by those around her, and how she begins to question the authenticity of her own identity.

The film also touches on the theme of loneliness and isolation, highlighting the ways in which human connections can both heal and harm us. Pierce, who has been struggling with his own emotional scars, finds himself drawn to Ondine's enigmatic presence, only to discover that she is hiding secrets of her own. As their relationship deepens, we see how Pierce's vulnerability and trust are tested by Ondine's mysterious nature.

Furthermore, the movie explores the tension between reality and fantasy, as Ondine's mermaid mythology threatens to upend Pierce's perceptions of the world around him. This blurring of lines serves as a metaphor for the ways in which our experiences can shape our understanding of ourselves and others.

Ultimately, Ondine is a poignant exploration of the human condition, one that invites us to consider the complexities of love, identity, and the fragility of the human heart.

original_title: A Christmas Prince: The Royal Wedding
overview: A year after Amber helped Richard secure the crown. The two are set to tie the knot in a royal Christmas wedding — but their plans are jeopardized when Amber finds herself second-guessing whether or not she's cut out to be queen, and Richard is faced with a political crisis that threatens to tarnish not only the holiday season but the future of the kingdom.
title: A Christmas Prince: The Royal Wedding
plot:
A Christmas Prince: The Royal Wedding is a heartwarming and romantic film that explores the theme of self-discovery and growth, particularly for its protagonist, Amber. As she navigates her new role as a princess, Amber must confront her own identity and values, learning to balance her royal duties with her personal aspirations.

The movie also delves into the theme of love and relationships, showcasing the blossoming romance between Amber and Simon, the prince. Their relationship serves as a catalyst for growth and change in both characters, highlighting the importance of communication, trust, and mutual respect in any partnership.

Furthermore, the film touches on the theme of family and tradition, particularly in the context of royal families. The movie pokes fun at the conventions and expectations that come with royal life, while also celebrating the importance of heritage and legacy.

Ultimately, A Christmas Prince: The Royal Wedding is a feel-good film that celebrates the power of love, self-discovery, and personal growth, making it a delightful watch for audiences during the holiday season.

overview: When a single mom and her two kids arrive in a small town, they begin to discover their connection to the original Ghostbusters and the secret legacy their grandfather left behind.
tagline: Discover the past. Protect the future.
title: Ghostbusters: Afterlife
plot:
Ghostbusters: Afterlife is a 2021 supernatural comedy film directed by Jason Reitman, written by Gil Kenan and Greg Russo, and produced by Ivan Reitman, Dan Aykroyd, and Chris Columbus. The movie serves as a direct sequel to the original Ghostbusters (1984) and Ghostbusters II (1989), ignoring the events of the 2016 reboot.

The story takes place in 2021, 30 years after the events of the first two films. We meet Callie Spengler (Carrie Coon), a single mother who lives on a farm with her son Trevor (Finn Wolfhard) and granddaughter Phoebe (Mckenna Grace). The family is struggling to cope with the loss of their father, Raymond Stantz (Dan Aykroyd), who was one of the original Ghostbusters.

One day, Callie receives an unexpected visit from a mysterious woman named Phoebe's grandmother, Janine Melnitz (Annie Potts), who reveals that she is Phoebe's mother and has been keeping her identity a secret. Janine informs Phoebe about her family's history as Ghostbusters and the reason for their disappearance.

As Phoebe begins to uncover the truth about her family's past, she discovers an old proton pack in the attic of her grandfather's house, which leads her on a journey to find the lost city of Stay Puft, where her father and his team were last seen. Along the way, she meets Trevor, who becomes her ally in uncovering the secrets of their family's legacy.

As they delve deeper into the mystery, Phoebe and Trevor encounter a new generation of Ghostbusters, led by Dr. Zoey Frankel (Mckenna Grace), who is determined to revive the original team's work. Together, they face off against a powerful entity known as Gozer, an ancient Sumerian deity that was defeated by the original Ghostbusters.

Throughout the film, Reitman pays homage to the original Ghostbusters while introducing new characters and themes. The movie explores the idea of legacy, family, and the power of tradition. The special effects are impressive, with a blend of practical and CGI elements that bring the supernatural world to life.

Overall, Ghostbusters: Afterlife is a heartwarming and entertaining film that honors the spirit of the original while introducing a new generation to the beloved franchise.

overview: An ordinary guy suddenly finds himself forced to fight a gladiator-like battle for a dark website that streams the violence for viewers. In order to survive and rescue his kidnapped ex-girlfriend, he must battle Nix, a heavily armed and much more experienced fighter.
tagline: Get loaded
title: Guns Akimbo
plot:
Guns Akimbo is a 2019 American action comedy film directed by Jason Lei Howden, not 2020, and produced by FilmFernsehFonds Bayern. The movie stars Sean Penn, Maggie Q, and Daniel Radcliffe.

The main themes of Guns Akimbo include:

1. **Toxic Masculinity**: The film critiques traditional masculine norms, particularly in the character of Miles Lee Harris (played by Sean Penn), a video game developer who becomes embroiled in a real-life game of survival.
2. **Corporate Greed and Responsibility**: The movie highlights the consequences of unchecked corporate power and the dangers of prioritizing profits over human life.
3. **Identity and Self-Discovery**: As Miles navigates his new reality, he must confront his own identity and find a way to reconcile his past with his present.
4. **The Impact of Technology on Society**: Guns Akimbo explores the consequences of our increasing reliance on technology, including video games and social media, on our relationships and sense of self.

Throughout the film, these themes are woven together in a narrative that is both humorous and thought-provoking. The movie features a unique blend of action, comedy, and satire, making it a compelling watch for fans of the genre.

overview: Let's face it, rats are not the most beloved creatures on earth. However, maybe this little tale about the history of human and rat interaction will change the world's tune. At least that is the hope of Remy, the star of Ratatouille, and his reluctant brother Emile as they guide us through world history from a rat's perspective. Why can't we all just get along?
title: Your Friend the Rat
plot:
Your Friend the Rat is an American animated short film of 2007 produced by Pixar and written and directed by Jim Capobianco as an extra for the home release of Ratatouille. Running about eleven minutes, it is framed as a mock educational film in which the rat brothers Remy, voiced by Patton Oswalt, and Emile, voiced by Peter Sohn, plead for peace between rats and humans. Lou Romano voices Linguini, who stands in for most of the humans, and Capobianco himself plays an off-screen director.

Remy introduces himself and Emile and announces that he speaks for oppressed rats everywhere, while his brother grumbles at being made to take part. Unrolling a scroll, he launches into a hand-drawn history comparing the human bond with rats to the warmer treatment of dogs and cats. He recalls that rats were once considered sacred and lucky, serving in India as the mount of the god Ganesh, and that ancient Romans thought a white rat crossing one's path brought good fortune and a black one bad. He turns to the black rat and its link to the Black Death, insisting that fleas were the true culprits of a plague that killed a third of Europe's people and just as many rats, and then celebrates the brown rat, credited with helping to end the plague and honoured in the Chinese zodiac. Emile takes over to list the clever things rats can do and the ways they benefit people, from laboratory research to life as pets, noting that Queen Victoria's rat-catcher, Jack Black, kept some of his captives as pets. The brothers close with a song, "Plan B", about the relationship between the two species. As Remy asks viewers whether rats and humans can live in peace, a long, satirical disclaimer warning children to keep away from rats fills the screen, and the brothers try to push it aside, complaining about free speech and their empty stomachs.

The idea grew out of a request for DVD extras, and Capobianco conceived it as a funny way to present the research the crew had gathered on rats. Produced in under a year during the final stretch of work on Ratatouille, it is Pixar's only short to use traditional hand-drawn animation, combined here with computer animation, stop-motion and live action. It includes a cameo by P.T. Flea from A Bug's Life and was released with Ratatouille on home video in November 2007.

overview: Detectives Sean and David Carter are on the case to find a gruesome serial killer terrorizing the city. Joining forces with Detective Christine Egerton, they dig deeper into a spiraling maze of horror that may not be of this world.
tagline: Evil Seeks Evil.
title: Hellraiser: Judgment
plot:
Hellraiser: Judgment is a 2018 supernatural horror film that delves into the darker aspects of human nature and the consequences of playing with forces beyond one's control. The movie explores the theme of revenge, as Pinhead, the iconic lead character, seeks to punish those who have wronged him and his fellow Cenobites.

At its core, Hellraiser: Judgment is a cautionary tale about the dangers of curiosity and the consequences of meddling with forces that are beyond human understanding. The film's protagonist, Larry, is a detective who becomes entangled in a web of supernatural horror when he discovers a mysterious puzzle box that unleashes a torrent of terror.

Throughout the movie, the theme of revenge is expertly woven, as Pinhead's relentless pursuit of justice serves as a metaphor for the cyclical nature of violence and the devastating consequences of unchecked desire. The film also touches on the idea of trauma and its lasting impact on individuals, as Larry's own dark past comes back to haunt him.

Ultimately, Hellraiser: Judgment is a thought-provoking exploration of the human condition, one that delves into the darkest recesses of the human psyche and emerges with a haunting message about the dangers of succumbing to our baser instincts.

overview: Explore the mysterious and dangerous home of the king of the apes as a team of explorers ventures deep inside the treacherous, primordial island.
tagline: All hail the king
title: Kong: Skull Island
plot:
Kong: Skull Island is a 2017 American monster adventure film directed by Jordan Vogt-Röderman and produced by Legendary Pictures. The movie takes place in 1976, during the Vietnam War era.

The story begins with Captain Mark "Marky" Rutledge (Tom Hiddleston), an American soldier who is part of a secret mission to investigate Skull Island, a mysterious island rumored to be inhabited by giant prehistoric creatures. Alongside his team, including Lieutenant Colonel Preston Packard (Samuel L. Jackson) and Dr. Ilene Andrews (Brie Larson), they embark on a perilous journey to the island.

Upon arrival, the team discovers that the island is home to various monstrous creatures, including giant spiders, crocodiles, and other prehistoric beasts. As they venture deeper into the jungle, they stumble upon an ancient temple dedicated to King Kong, a legendary giant ape said to be the ruler of Skull Island.

The team soon realizes that Kong is not just a mindless beast but a complex creature with its own culture and motivations. They also discover that the island is home to a group of indigenous people who have been living in harmony with Kong for centuries.

As tensions rise, Packard's true intentions are revealed: he wants to capture Kong and use it as a propaganda tool to boost American morale during the war. However, Rutledge and Andrews begin to question Packard's motives and ultimately decide to help Kong escape from captivity.

The team soon finds themselves in a desperate battle against Packard's men, who have set up traps and explosives to capture Kong. In the chaos, Kong is freed, and he begins to wreak havoc on the island, destroying everything in his path.

As the team tries to survive the destruction caused by Kong, they also uncover the dark secrets of Skull Island's past, including the presence of a mysterious organization that has been experimenting with the island's creatures. The team soon realizes that they are not alone on the island and that there are forces at play that threaten their very existence.

In the end, Rutledge and Andrews manage to escape the island, but not before Kong is gravely injured by Packard's men. As the team flees the island, they leave behind a cryptic message for the world to discover the truth about Skull Island and its legendary inhabitants.

Throughout the movie, the director Jordan Vogt-Röderman pays homage to classic monster movies, incorporating nods to King Kong (1933) and other iconic films in the franchise. The film's visuals are stunning, with impressive creature designs and breathtaking action sequences that bring the prehistoric world of Skull Island to life.

Overall, Kong: Skull Island is a thrilling adventure that explores themes of colonialism, imperialism, and the ethics of scientific discovery. While it may not be as faithful to the original King Kong story as some fans might have hoped, it offers a fresh take on the classic monster movie genre and sets the stage for future adventures in the Kong franchise.

overview: Home with their newly-formed family, happy parents Dan and Jody are haunted by sinister, paranormal activities. Determined to expel the insidious force, they install security cameras and discover their family is being stalked by an evil dead demon.
tagline: Evil is coming. Bring protection.
title: Scary Movie 5
plot:
Scary Movie 5 (stylized as Scary MoVie) is a 2013 American parody film directed by Malcolm D. Lee and written by David Zucker and Pat Proft. The fifth installment in the Scary Movie series and a standalone sequel to Scary Movie 4, it was the second and last entry distributed by The Weinstein Company and the only one without Anna Faris and Regina Hall as Cindy and Brenda. The cast includes Ashley Tisdale, Simon Rex, Erica Ash, Katrina Bowden, Terry Crews, Heather Locklear, Jerry O'Connell, Molly Shannon, Snoop Dogg, Kate Walsh and Katt Williams, along with Charlie Sheen and Lindsay Lohan. It premiered at the ArcLight Cinerama Dome in Hollywood and was released by Dimension Films on April 12, 2013.

In the opening, Charlie Sanders and his girlfriend Lindsay set up more than twenty cameras to film a sex tape, until a paranormal force sends Charlie flying around the room and a possessed Lindsay kills him. His three children disappear, and months later they are found living feral in a cabin in the woods and are eventually handed over to Charlie's estranged brother Dan and his wife Jody. The family moves into a large suburban house fitted with security cameras, and Jody, though reluctant to take in the children at first, soon adapts while she rehearses for the lead role in a ballet production of Swan Lake. Meanwhile, a series of increasingly bizarre paranormal events plagues the house. The children explain that the attacks come from "Mama", their cursed biological mother, who wants them back. The housekeeper Maria tries every ritual she knows to drive out the evil spirits, and Dan, a scientist at a primate research facility, fails to notice that one of his chimpanzees, Caesar, has become far smarter than he is. With help from Jody's friend Kendra from the ballet, a fraudulent psychic and a dream extractor, the couple must find a way to break the curse, which leads them to a mysterious tome called the Book of the Evil. The film spoofs a wide range of recent hits, chiefly Paranormal Activity, Black Swan, Mama and Rise of the Planet of the Apes, along with Sinister, Inception and Evil Dead.

The film was universally panned by critics. On Rotten Tomatoes, only 4% of 51 critics' reviews are positive, and Metacritic gave it a score of 11 out of 100, indicating "overwhelming dislike". It grossed $78.4 million worldwide, making it the worst-reviewed and lowest-grossing film in the series.

overview: When a Las Vegas bodyguard with lethal skills and a gambling problem gets in trouble with the mob, he has one last play… and it's all or nothing.
tagline: Never bet against a man with a killer hand.
title: Wild Card
plot:
Wild Card is a 2015 American action thriller directed by Simon West. It is based on William Goldman's 1985 novel Heat and is a remake of the 1986 adaptation starring Burt Reynolds; Goldman wrote the screenplay. Jason Statham stars as Nick Wild, with Michael Angarano as Cyrus Kinnick, Milo Ventimiglia as Danny DeMarco, Dominik Garcia-Lorido as Holly, Anne Heche as Roxy, Hope Davis as Cassandra and Sofia Vergara as D.D.

Nick is a recovering gambling addict who earns his living in Las Vegas as a "chaperone", his term for a bodyguard for hire. A young man, Cyrus Kinnick, hires him to show him around the city and protect him while he gambles. His friend Holly, an escort, was raped and beaten after a date at the Golden Nugget and asks him to identify the men so she can sue. Nick learns that the attacker was the gangster Danny DeMarco, whose thugs dumped her in a hospital parking lot. Nick overpowers DeMarco and his men in their hotel room, and Holly threatens to castrate DeMarco, who begs forgiveness. She settles for the $50,000 from his desk, splits it with Nick and leaves town.

Nick then takes Cyrus to a casino, where a remarkable winning streak at blackjack earns him more than half a million dollars. At the cashier's window, however, panic sets in, and he keeps playing until he loses everything, including his original stake, on a single hand dealt by his friend Cassandra. Cyrus turns out to be a self-made millionaire who wants Nick to teach him courage. DeMarco tells the Las Vegas mob boss, Baby, that Nick robbed him and killed two of his men. Before Baby, Nick counters that DeMarco killed his own men to hide his humiliation, and that he bears a cut on his penis; DeMarco refuses to prove him wrong and walks out. Cyrus later offers Nick a $500,000 check and a plane ticket to Corsica. When DeMarco and his men corner them in a diner, Cyrus creates a distraction by singing loudly, and Nick kills the thugs and DeMarco in the alley using the diner's cutlery before accepting the gift and driving out of Las Vegas.

West said Statham developed the project for years; Brian De Palma was once attached to direct. Lionsgate released the film on January 30, 2015,, in limited theaters and on demand. It was a box office bomb, earning $6.7 million against a $30 million budget. Reviews were negative, with Rotten Tomatoes reporting a 30% approval rating and the Los Angeles Times calling it predictable.

overview: Tinkerbell wanders into the forbidden Winter woods and meets Periwinkle. Together they learn the secret of their wings and try to unite the warm fairies and the winter fairies to help Pixie Hollow.
tagline: Two Worlds. One Magical Secret.
title: Secret of the Wings
plot:
Secret of the Wings is a 2012 animated fantasy film produced by DisneyToon Studios. The movie follows the story of Periwinkle, a young fairy who lives in the kingdom of Pixie Hollow with her friends and family.

Periwinkle is a bit of an outcast among her peers because she has wings that are too small to fly. She longs to soar through the skies like the other fairies but feels inadequate due to her limited abilities. Periwinkle's best friend, Iridessa, tries to reassure her that being different doesn't make her any less special.

One day, a new fairy named Zarina arrives in Pixie Hollow. Zarina is a skilled and powerful fairy from the kingdom of Nyx, where fairies are born with wings that can control the elements. Zarina's arrival sparks tension among the fairies, as some begin to fear her abilities and others are drawn to her power.

Periwinkle becomes fascinated with Zarina and decides to follow her on a journey to learn more about her new friend. Along the way, Periwinkle discovers that Zarina is being forced by her mother, Queen Clarion, to use her powers for evil purposes. Zarina's wings are slowly losing their magic due to her mother's manipulation, and she fears that she will lose herself forever.

As Periwinkle and Zarina spend more time together, they form a strong bond, and Periwinkle helps Zarina to see the error of her ways. Together, they come up with a plan to stop Queen Clarion and break the curse that has been cast over Nyx.

The movie takes a dramatic turn when Periwinkle and Zarina face off against Queen Clarion in an epic battle. With the help of their friends, including Iridessa, Fawn, and Rosetta, they manage to defeat the queen and shatter the curse that had been cast over Nyx.

In the end, Zarina's wings are restored to their former glory, and she is able to use her powers for good once again. Periwinkle learns a valuable lesson about embracing her unique qualities and finding strength in her differences. The movie concludes with a heartwarming moment of friendship between Periwinkle and Zarina as they look out at the sunset together.

Overall, Secret of the Wings is a beautifully animated film that explores themes of self-acceptance, friendship, and the power of believing in oneself. With its engaging storyline and lovable characters, it's no wonder this movie has become a beloved favorite among Disney fans.

overview: While participating in a rehabilitation program training wild mustangs, a convict at first struggles to connect with the horses and his fellow inmates, but he learns to confront his violent past as he soothes an especially feisty horse.
title: The Mustang
plot:
The Mustang is a 2019 drama directed by Laure de Clermont-Tonnerre in her feature debut, from a screenplay she wrote with Mona Fastvold and Brock Norman Brock. Matthias Schoenaerts stars as Roman Coleman, a violent inmate who joins a program training wild horses. Jason Mitchell plays Henry Cooper, Bruce Dern plays Myles, Gideon Adlon plays Roman's daughter Martha and Connie Britton plays a prison psychologist. It draws on real prison programs, including in Nevada.

Thousands of wild mustangs are rounded up to curb overpopulation, and a few hundred go to prisons for training and auction. Roman, a former addict, has spent twelve years in prison for an assault that left his partner brain-damaged. Newly transferred to a Nevada prison, he resists rehabilitation. His pregnant teenage daughter Martha visits seeking his signature, and he tells her not to return. Working outdoor maintenance, he is seen with a dangerous horse and placed in rancher Myles's program, in which inmates have twelve weeks to prepare their mustangs for a prison auction.

Guided by Henry, the top trainer, Roman bonds with the horse, which he names Marquis. When Martha returns and he learns that she is seeking emancipation so she can sell the house left by his mother, he refuses to sign. His anger spills over, and he punches Marquis repeatedly, which gets him expelled from the program and sent to solitary confinement. Helping shelter the horses during a thunderstorm earns him his way back, and he joins a restorative justice group. His cellmate Dan then forces him to smuggle ketamine from the stables by threatening Martha, and Dan later kills Henry over the drug. Roman chokes Dan unconscious before calling the guards. At the auction, distracted by Martha's absence, Roman is thrown and nearly trampled when a helicopter spooks Marquis. Told the horse will be put down, Roman uses storm damage to the gates, with Myles distracting the guards, to set Marquis free. Later, a letter from Martha includes a photo of her newborn son, and Roman sees Marquis standing near the prison fence.

Susan Sarandon was originally cast but was replaced by Britton. The French-American production was filmed at the former Nevada State Prison in Carson City. The film premiered at the Sundance Film Festival on January 31, 2019, and Focus Features released it on March 15, 2019. It grossed $6.7 million. Rotten Tomatoes reported a 95% approval rating, with its consensus praising the performances of Dern and Schoenaerts.

overview: Quan is a humble London businessman whose long-buried past erupts in a revenge-fueled vendetta when the only person left for him to love – his teenage daughter – dies in an Irish Republican Army car bombing. His relentless search to find the terrorists leads to a cat-and-mouse conflict with a British government official whose own past may hold the clues to the identities of the elusive killers.
tagline: Never push a good man too far
title: The Foreigner
plot:
The Foreigner is a 2017 American action thriller film directed by John Moore and written by Drew Pearce. The movie stars Jackie Chan, Pierce Brosnan, and Yang Lai.

The story begins with Quinn Harris (Pierce Brosnan), an Irish-American businessman who has lost his daughter in a terrorist attack in Belfast, Northern Ireland. Quinn is consumed by grief and anger towards the IRA for their involvement in his daughter's death. He becomes obsessed with finding those responsible and exacting revenge.

Quinn travels to Hong Kong, where he meets Nicky Tang (Yang Lai), a Chinese woman who was also affected by the attack. Despite their cultural differences, they form an unlikely bond as Quinn tries to help Nicky deal with her trauma. As they spend more time together, Quinn begins to see Nicky as a surrogate daughter and starts to open up about his own pain.

Meanwhile, a group of IRA terrorists, led by James Vickers (Owen Teale), plan to carry out another attack in Hong Kong. Quinn discovers their plans and decides to take matters into his own hands. He teams up with Nicky and her brother, Liang Tang (Kai Man Tin), to stop the terrorists.

As the plot unfolds, Quinn's actions become increasingly reckless, putting himself and those around him at risk. Nicky tries to intervene, but Quinn is determined to see justice served. The action sequences are intense and well-choreographed, with Jackie Chan delivering his signature blend of martial arts and humor.

The climax of the movie features a thrilling showdown between Quinn and Vickers, with Quinn using his wits and fighting skills to take down the terrorists. In the end, Quinn finds some measure of closure and revenge, but not before realizing that his actions have consequences for those around him.

Throughout the movie, Jackie Chan delivers a strong performance as the titular character, bringing depth and nuance to a role that could have easily been one-dimensional. Pierce Brosnan provides solid support as the grieving father, while Yang Lai shines in her breakout role as Nicky Tang.

Overall, The Foreigner is a tense and action-packed thriller that explores themes of grief, trauma, and redemption. While it may not be Chan's most critically acclaimed film, he delivers a memorable performance that makes the movie worth watching.

overview: In 1978, two rival groups at Camp Nightwing must band together to solve a terrifying mystery when horrors from their towns' history come alive.
tagline: Find the truth.
title: Fear Street: 1978
plot:
Fear Street: 1978 is a 2021 American supernatural horror film directed by Leigh Janiak and written by Phil Graziadei. The movie is based on the first book in R.L. Stine's popular Fear Street series.

The story takes place in Shadyside, Ohio, where three high school students - Casey, Deena, and Emily - are struggling to cope with their respective traumas. Casey (played by Olivia Scott Welch) has just moved back to Shadyside after a traumatic event from her past; Deena (played by Darby Stanchfield) is dealing with the aftermath of a car accident that killed her best friend; and Emily (played by Mckenna Grace) is haunted by visions of a girl who died in a fire at an abandoned house.

As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that the three girls are connected to each other through their shared experiences. They soon discover that they are being stalked by a supernatural entity known as "The Witch" (played by Kathryn Newton), who is responsible for a series of gruesome murders and disappearances in Shadyside.

As the girls delve deeper into the mystery, they uncover a dark secret about Shadyside's history. They learn that the town was founded by a group of settlers who made a pact with a witch to ensure their prosperity. However, this pact came at a terrible cost, and the witch's spirit has been awakened, seeking revenge on the descendants of those who wronged her.

Throughout the movie, the girls face numerous challenges as they try to survive The Witch's attacks. They also uncover clues about the town's history and the identity of the witch, which is revealed to be a woman named Sarah Fier (played by Liana Liberato). Sarah was a member of the original settlement and had made the pact with the witch, but she eventually became consumed by her own darkness.

As the story reaches its climax, Casey, Deena, and Emily discover that they are all connected to Sarah through their families. They also learn that The Witch is not just a supernatural entity, but a manifestation of Sarah's spirit, who is seeking revenge on those who wronged her.

In the end, the girls manage to defeat The Witch by confronting their own traumas and weaknesses. Casey, Deena, and Emily work together to uncover the truth about Shadyside's history and the identity of The Witch, ultimately leading to Sarah's downfall. The movie ends with a sense of closure for the characters, but also leaves room for speculation about what other supernatural threats may be lurking in the shadows.

Overall, Fear Street: 1978 is a thrilling horror movie that pays homage to the classic slasher films of the 1970s and 1980s. With its strong female leads, creepy atmosphere, and shocking plot twists, it's sure to delight fans of the genre.

overview: Uptight and straight-laced, FBI Special Agent Sarah Ashburn is a methodical investigator with a reputation for excellence--and hyper-arrogance. Shannon Mullins, one of Boston P.D.'s "finest," is foul-mouthed and has a very short fuse, and uses her gut instinct and street smarts to catch the most elusive criminals. Neither has ever had a partner, or a friend for that matter. When these two wildly incompatible law officers join forces to bring down a ruthless drug lord, they become the last thing anyone expected: Buddies.
tagline: Action's never been so hot!
title: The Heat
plot:
The Heat is a 2013 American action-comedy film directed by Paul Feig and starring Sandra Bullock and Melissa McCarthy.

The movie begins with FBI Special Agent Sarah Ashburn (Sandra Bullock), a tough, no-nonsense agent from Boston who specializes in taking down international crime lords. She's known for her exceptional skills and ruthless tactics, earning her the nickname "The Heat." After a successful sting operation, Ashburn is sent to Boston to take down a notorious Russian mobster named Ivan (Dimitri Diatchenko).

However, things don't go as planned when Ashburn discovers that Ivan has been killed by his own men. Feeling embarrassed and frustrated, Ashburn's boss orders her to work with Detective Shannon Mullins (Melissa McCarthy), a rough-around-the-edges Boston cop who is known for her unorthodox methods.

Initially, the two women clash due to their vastly different approaches to law enforcement. Ashburn sees Mullins as a loose cannon, while Mullins views Ashburn as uptight and out of touch with the streets. Despite their differences, they're forced to work together when Ivan's body is found in Boston, and it becomes clear that he was involved in a larger international crime ring.

As Ashburn and Mullins begin to investigate, they uncover a complex web of corruption and deceit that leads them from the streets of Boston to the high-stakes world of international organized crime. Along the way, they encounter a range of colorful characters, including Ivan's henchmen, corrupt cops, and even a seductive Russian woman (Gal Gadot) who may be working with Ivan.

Throughout the movie, Ashburn and Mullins engage in a series of hilarious and action-packed battles as they try to outsmart their enemies and bring them to justice. As they work together, they begin to develop an unlikely friendship, with Ashburn learning to appreciate Mullins' street smarts and Mullins discovering Ashburn's hidden vulnerabilities.

As the stakes grow higher, Ashburn and Mullins find themselves in a series of increasingly absurd and explosive situations, from a high-speed car chase through Boston to a showdown with Ivan's henchmen at a luxurious nightclub. In the end, they manage to take down the Russian mobster and bring him to justice, but not before Ashburn and Mullins have formed an unbreakable bond.

The Heat is a hilarious and action-packed comedy that showcases the chemistry between Bullock and McCarthy. The movie's success can be attributed to the strong performances of its leads, as well as Feig's clever direction and the witty script by Katie Dippold and Kristen Wiig. Overall, The Heat is a fun and entertaining ride that will keep you laughing and on the edge of your seat from start to finish.

overview: High school senior Tara is so painfully shy that she dreads speaking to anyone in the hallways or getting called on in class. But in the privacy of her bedroom with her iPod in hand, she rocks out -- doing mock broadcasts for Miami's hottest FM radio station, which happens to be owned by her stepfather. When a slot opens up at The SLAM, Tara surprises herself by blossoming behind the mike into confident, "Radio Rebel" -- and to everyone's shock, she's a hit!
tagline: Can the girl who never speaks... Become the voice of a generation?
title: Radio Rebel
plot:
Radio Rebel is a 2012 American teen comedy-drama film that revolves around the story of Kat (played by Josie Loren), a shy and introverted high school student who finds her voice through an anonymous radio DJ on a local station. As she gains popularity as "Rebel," Kat must navigate the complexities of fame, friendship, and self-discovery.

The main theme of Radio Rebel is the struggle for identity and self-expression, particularly among young people trying to find their place in the world. The film explores how social media and celebrity culture can both empower and suffocate individuals, leading to a sense of disconnection and disillusionment. Through Kat's journey, the movie highlights the importance of staying true to oneself and finding one's own voice amidst the noise of external expectations.

The film also touches on themes of peer pressure, loyalty, and the consequences of fame, as Kat faces challenges from her friends, family, and even her newfound fans. Ultimately, Radio Rebel is a heartwarming story about embracing individuality, taking risks, and finding one's own path in life.

overview: Sarah is a French astronaut training at the European Space Agency in Cologne. She is the only woman in the arduous program. She lives alone with Stella, her seven year old daughter. Sarah feels guilty that she cannot spend more time with her child. Her love is overpowering, unsettling. When Sarah is chosen to join the crew of a year-long space mission called Proxima, it creates chaos in the mother-daughter relationship.
title: Proxima
plot:
Proxima is a thought-provoking and emotionally charged film that delves into the complexities of human relationships, identity, and the challenges of parenthood. The movie follows a mother's journey as she navigates her complicated past and present, all while trying to connect with her daughter.

At its core, Proxima explores the theme of longing and yearning for connection and understanding. The film's protagonist is a woman who has been estranged from her family for years, and her relationship with her daughter is fraught with tension and uncertainty. As she tries to rebuild their bond, she must confront her own emotional scars and learn to let go of her past.

The movie also touches on the theme of identity and how it can be shaped by our experiences and relationships. The protagonist's journey is a metaphor for the search for self-discovery and the struggle to find one's place in the world. Through her interactions with her daughter, she begins to uncover fragments of her own past and re-evaluate her sense of self.

Furthermore, Proxima explores the theme of motherhood as a complex and multifaceted experience. The film portrays the challenges of balancing personal desires with parental responsibilities, highlighting the tension between nurturing one's child and maintaining one's own identity.

Overall, Proxima is a nuanced and emotionally resonant film that probes the intricacies of human relationships and the complexities of the human experience.

overview: As their first year of high school looms ahead, best friends Julie, Hannah, Yancy and Farrah have one last summer sleepover. Little do they know they're about to embark on the adventure of a lifetime. Desperate to shed their nerdy status, they take part in a night-long scavenger hunt that pits them against their popular archrivals. Everything under the sun goes on -- from taking Yancy's father's car to sneaking into nightclubs!
tagline: The rules are set. The game is on.
title: Sleepover
plot:
Sleepover is an American teen comedy of 2004 and the feature directing debut of Joe Nussbaum, from a screenplay by Elisa Bell. It stars Alexa Vega as Julie Corky, with Mika Boorem, Sara Paxton, Scout Taylor-Compton, Brie Larson and Kallie Flynn Childress, while Jane Lynch, Jeff Garlin and Steve Carell head the adult cast and Sean Faris, Sam Huntington and Evan Peters appear in supporting roles.

On the last day of eighth grade, Julie holds a slumber party for her friends Hannah, Farrah and Yancy. Staci Blake, a former friend who now leads the popular clique, challenges them to an all-night scavenger hunt. The winners will claim the coveted lunch spot by the fountain when high school begins; the losers will eat beside the dumpsters. The list includes a photo of each girl with a date inside a nightclub, the badge from a local security firm, a pair of boxers belonging to Steve Phillips, the boy Julie has a crush on, and dressing a store mannequin in their own clothes. Bribing her older brother Ren to cover for them, the girls slip out in a tiny electric car borrowed from Yancy's father, dodging a security guard and trying to keep Julie's parents, Gabby and Jay, from noticing they are gone.

At the club Julie discovers that her assigned date is her own teacher, and drops a scarf that her mother, out with a friend, later finds. Skateboarding home to reassure her father, Julie catches Steve's eye, and she sneaks into his house and narrowly escapes with his boxers. Both teams complete the list, so Staci proposes a tiebreaker at a school dance: the first group to obtain the crown of the dance king or queen wins. Steve is crowned king, picks Julie for his victory dance and hands her the crown, sealing the win. The girls race home just ahead of Gabby and pretend to be asleep. The next morning Gabby shows Julie the scarf but, rather than punish her, marvels at how quickly she is growing up, and Steve turns up in Julie's tree fort with the crown for their first kiss. Come high school, Staci and her friends are eating by the dumpsters.

Released on 9 July 2004, the film opened at number ten and grossed about $10.1 million worldwide on a $10 million budget. Reviews were poor, with a 15% Rotten Tomatoes rating, though the film later gained a cult following on home video.

original_title: Zack and Miri Make a Porno
overview: Lifelong platonic friends Zack and Miri look to solve their respective cash-flow problems by making an adult film together. As the cameras roll, however, the duo begin to sense that they may have more feelings for each other than they previously thought.
tagline: What would you do to get out of debt?
title: Zack and Miri Make a Porno
plot:
Zack and Miri Make a Porno is a 2008 American sex comedy film directed by Kevin Smith and starring Seth Rogen, James Franco, Katy Perry, and Elizabeth Banks. The movie follows the story of two friends, Zack (Seth Rogen) and Miri (Katy Perry), who are struggling to make ends meet in Pittsburgh.

Zack is a slacker who works as a delivery boy for a local pizza place, while Miri is a nude model who poses for art classes. Despite their financial struggles, they have a strong friendship and often hang out together, sharing their deepest secrets and desires.

One day, Zack comes up with an idea to make money by creating a pornographic film featuring himself and his friends. He convinces Miri to be the star of the film, and she agrees on one condition: that the movie will not feature any explicit sex scenes. However, things take a turn when they realize that they need to raise $5,000 to complete the film.

To achieve this goal, Zack and Miri come up with a series of outrageous and often humiliating stunts to get attention from women and raise money for their project. Along the way, they encounter a number of eccentric characters, including a seductive stripper named Delilah (Elizabeth Banks) who becomes a key player in their scheme.

As the story progresses, Zack and Miri's friendship is put to the test as they navigate their feelings for each other and confront their own insecurities. Meanwhile, their friends, including Dale (Jay Baruchel), Kevin (Craig Robinson), and Pedro (Danny McBride), provide comedic relief and support throughout the film.

Throughout the movie, Kevin Smith explores themes of friendship, love, and identity, often using humor to tackle deeper issues. The film's title, "Zack and Miri Make a Porno," is a play on the idea that even in the most unlikely of circumstances, two people can come together and create something beautiful.

Ultimately, Zack and Miri's plan succeeds, but not without its fair share of ups and downs. In the end, they learn to appreciate each other's strengths and weaknesses, and their friendship is stronger than ever. The movie ends on a hopeful note, with Zack and Miri embracing their newfound love for each other and looking forward to a bright future together.

Overall, Zack and Miri Make a Porno is a heartwarming and hilarious film that explores the complexities of human relationships and the power of friendship. With its talented cast, witty dialogue, and irreverent humor, it's no wonder this movie has become a cult classic among fans of Kevin Smith and adult comedy.

overview: A timid and socially alienated 17-year-old high school student's life is turned upside down when she switches places with her sinister mirror image.
title: Look Away
plot:
Look Away is a 2018 American drama film directed by Michael McDonald. The movie revolves around a young woman named Rachel, who becomes involved with a charismatic but troubled man named Darryl. As their relationship deepens, Rachel finds herself drawn into Darryl's world of crime and deception.

The main theme of Look Away is the destructive nature of toxic relationships and the ways in which they can consume and destroy individuals. The film explores how Rachel's desire for love and connection leads her to overlook the warning signs of Darryl's problematic behavior, ultimately putting herself in harm's way.

Through Rachel's character, the movie also touches on themes of vulnerability, naivety, and the struggle to break free from patterns of self-destructive behavior. The film raises questions about the complexities of human relationships and the ways in which we can both hurt and help each other.

The movie also delves into the darker aspects of human nature, revealing a world where crime and deception are often intertwined with charm and charisma. This dichotomy serves as a commentary on the societal pressures that can lead individuals to engage in destructive behavior, and the ways in which these behaviors can be normalized or even romanticized.

Overall, Look Away is a thought-provoking drama that explores the complexities of human relationships, vulnerability, and the struggle to break free from patterns of self-destructive behavior.

overview: Career con man Roy sets his sights on his latest mark: recently widowed Betty, worth millions. And he means to take it all. But as the two draw closer, what should have been another simple swindle takes on the ultimate stakes.
tagline: Read between the lies.
title: The Good Liar
plot:
The Good Liar is a 2019 crime thriller film directed and produced by Bill Condon and written by Jeffrey Hatcher, based on Nicholas Searle's 2015 novel of the same name. It stars Ian McKellen as a career con artist and Helen Mirren as a wealthy widow he meets through online dating, with Russell Tovey and Jim Carter.
