overview: An epic journey of a young hero and her Spirit Guides, 'Dillo' a cute and humorous armadillo and "Vaca" a goofy oversized tapir, who embark on a quest to save their home in the spectacular Amazon Rainforest.
title: AINBO: Spirit of the Amazon
plot:
AINBO: Spirit of the Amazon is a 2021 animated adventure film directed by Daniel Robock and produced by Tunche Films. The movie follows the story of Tuki, a young boy who lives with his grandmother, Akira, in the Amazon rainforest.

The beginning of the film sets the tone for the rest of the story, showcasing the beauty and magic of the Amazonian world. Tuki is an orphan who has been living with his grandmother since his parents' death. He spends most of his days exploring the forest and learning about its secrets from Akira. However, their peaceful life is disrupted when a group of loggers, led by the ruthless and cunning hunter, Kanaq, arrive in the forest.

Kanaq's true intentions are revealed as he seeks to capture Tuki, who possesses a special gift - the ability to communicate with animals. The loggers believe that Tuki's powers can be used to control the Amazonian wildlife, allowing them to exploit its resources more easily. Akira tries to protect Tuki, but she is captured by Kanaq and his men.

As Tuki sets out on a journey to rescue his grandmother, he meets a group of animal friends who join him on his quest. There's Aibo, a wise-cracking capuchin monkey; Miko, a gentle giant tapir; and Zazu, a sassy macaw. Together, they face numerous challenges and obstacles as they navigate the treacherous Amazonian landscape.

Throughout their journey, Tuki learns valuable lessons about courage, friendship, and the importance of preserving the natural world. He also discovers more about his own powers and the true extent of his connection to the animals. The film's animation is stunning, bringing the vibrant colors and textures of the Amazon rainforest to life in a way that is both visually stunning and immersive.

As Tuki and his animal friends near Kanaq's camp, they engage in an epic battle to rescue Akira and stop the loggers' destructive plans. In the end, Tuki uses his powers to rally the animals and drive the loggers away, saving the forest and its inhabitants.

The film concludes with Tuki returning home to a hero's welcome, surrounded by his animal friends and the people of the Amazonian community. Akira is reunited with her grandson, and they share a heartwarming moment of reconciliation. The movie ends on a hopeful note, emphasizing the importance of protecting the natural world and preserving its magic for future generations.

AINBO: Spirit of the Amazon is a beautifully animated film that celebrates the beauty and wonder of the Amazon rainforest. With its engaging storyline, lovable characters, and stunning animation, it's a must-see for fans of adventure films and environmentalism.

overview: Alice and Jack are lucky to be living in the idealized community of Victory, the experimental company town housing the men who work for the top-secret Victory Project and their families. But when cracks in their idyllic life begin to appear, exposing flashes of something much more sinister lurking beneath the attractive façade, Alice can’t help questioning exactly what they’re doing in Victory, and why.
tagline: Are you ready to live the life you deserve?
title: Don't Worry Darling
plot:
Don't Worry Darling is a psychological thriller film directed by Olivia Wilde, released in 2022 under New Line Cinema.

The story revolves around Alice (Florence Pugh), a young woman who lives in the idyllic community of Victory, California, with her husband Jack (Harry Styles). The town appears to be a utopian haven where men and women live separate but equal lives. However, as Alice begins to notice strange occurrences and inconsistencies within the community, she starts to question the true nature of her life.

Alice's seemingly perfect marriage is put to the test when she discovers that her husband is not who he claims to be. Jack's past is shrouded in mystery, and his behavior becomes increasingly erratic. As Alice delves deeper into the truth about Victory, she uncovers a web of secrets and lies that threaten to destroy everything she thought she knew.

The film takes a dark turn as Alice confronts the sinister forces controlling Victory, including her husband's role in it all. The more she learns, the more she realizes that she is trapped in a toxic relationship and must find a way to escape before it's too late.

Throughout the film, Wilde explores themes of feminism, patriarchy, and the objectification of women. The movie features a talented ensemble cast, including Chris Pine, Gemma Chan, and KiKi Layne, who all deliver standout performances.

One of the most striking aspects of Don't Worry Darling is its use of symbolism and metaphor. The film's depiction of Victory as a 1950s-style utopia serves as a commentary on the societal norms of the time, particularly with regards to women's roles in society. The movie also features a number of eerie and unsettling sequences that add to the overall sense of unease.

Overall, Don't Worry Darling is a thought-provoking and visually stunning film that explores themes of identity, power, and control. With its talented cast and Olivia Wilde's direction, it's a must-see for fans of psychological thrillers and feminist cinema.

overview: Johan and Marianne are married and seem to have it all. Their happiness, however, is a façade for a troubled relationship, which becomes even rockier when Johan admits that he's having an affair. Before long, the spouses separate and move towards finalizing their divorce, but they make attempts at reconciling. Even as they pursue other relationships, Johan and Marianne realize that they have a significant bond, but also many issues that hinder that connection.
title: Scenes from a Marriage
plot:
Scenes from a Marriage (Swedish: Scener ur ett äktenskap) is the 1974 theatrical version of Ingmar Bergman's six-part Swedish television drama of 1973, condensed from nearly five hours to under three. Written and directed by Bergman and photographed by Sven Nykvist with an emphasis on close-ups and small interior sets, it traces ten years in the marriage, separation and divorce of Marianne, a divorce lawyer played by Liv Ullmann, and Johan, a reader in psychology played by Erland Josephson. Bergman drew on his own failed marriages, his relationship with Ullmann and his parents' troubled union.

Johan and Marianne, married for a decade with two daughters, are interviewed for a magazine as a model couple. Soon afterwards a dinner with their friends Peter and Katarina dissolves into a bitter quarrel between the guests, which Marianne attributes to poor communication. A client of Marianne's seeking a divorce after twenty years of a loveless marriage leaves her uneasy, and tensions surface over the couple's flagging sex life. Then Johan announces that he has fallen in love with Paula, a 23-year-old student, that he has considered leaving for four years, and that he is going abroad with her.

When Johan later visits, unhappy with Paula and hoping for a post abroad, the evening swings between longing and distance; Marianne reads him passages from her diary about a lifetime spent trying to please others and first raises the word divorce. At the meeting to sign the papers, tenderness gives way to recrimination and a violent fight before both sign. Years later, each married to someone else, they meet again for a secret weekend at a friend's country house and become lovers once more, uncertain whether they have ever truly loved anyone.

Bibi Andersson and Jan Malmsjö play Katarina and Peter, with Gunnel Lindblom, Anita Wall and Barbro Hiort af Ornäs in supporting roles. Made cheaply in Stockholm and on Fårö in 1972, the series was blamed by some for a rise in divorces. The film opened in New York in September 1974; Roger Ebert called it one of the truest, most luminous love stories ever made and the best film of the year, and Vincent Canby praised its extraordinary intimacy and Ullmann's performance. It won the Golden Globe for Best Foreign Language Film but was ruled ineligible for the Academy Award because of its earlier broadcast. Bergman revisited the couple in Saraband (2003).

overview: The third and final instalment in the Burnout trilogy. This time, the road leads through Norway, to Sweden, Denmark and finally Germany to race on the famous racing track, Nürburgring.
tagline: From The Trolls' Path to Nürburgring
title: Asphalt Burning
plot:
Asphalt Burning (Norwegian: Børning 3) is a 2020 Norwegian-German action comedy directed by Hallvard Bræin and written by Christopher Grøndahl and Kjetil Indregard. Billed as the third and final instalment of the Børning (Burnout) series, it follows Børning (2014) and Børning 2 (2016). It was produced by Filmkameratene with The Post Republic, Tobis Film and Gifted Films, and runs about 100 minutes. The film opened in Norway on 14 October 2020 and reached a wider international audience on Netflix around the start of 2021, under the tagline "From The Trolls' Path to Nürburgring".

Anders Baasmo Christiansen returns as Roy Gundersen, a man who loves racing American cars, legally or otherwise. He is on his way to Møre og Romsdal to marry his longtime girlfriend Sylvia (Kathrine Thorborg Johansen, replacing the actress from the earlier films) at the top of the Trollstigen mountain road, but a series of problems arises before the wedding can take place. On the eve of the ceremony, as friends and family celebrate among gleaming muscle cars, Sylvia's old friend Robin (Alexandra Maria Lara) turns up in a red Porsche, and a drunken Roy kisses her. At the wedding the next day Robin exposes his lapse, drives off with Sylvia and the couple's baby, and challenges Roy to race her for his bride at the famous Nürburgring circuit in Germany, one of the longest and most demanding tracks in the world. Roy sets out through Sweden and Denmark to Germany with his regular helpers, his daughter Nina (Ida Husøy), Doffen (Sven Nordin), Nybakken (Otto Jespersen) and TT (Trond Halbo). Along the way two of them travel in a restored vintage hearse and accidentally pick up a corpse, the gang runs into two other men named Roy, which causes a string of mix-ups, and they clash with Lemmy Müller (Henning Baum), a German hot-rodder with a striking resemblance to Motörhead's Lemmy Kilmister. Henrik Mestad, Peter Kurth, Milan Peschel and Ruby O. Fee also appear.

At home it was voted one of three finalists for the audience award at the 2021 Amanda Awards, and a fourth film was later planned. International critics were harsh. Decider's John Serba called the race-for-the-bride premise a rickety jalopy, finding the chase sequences forgettable and marred by dated computer graphics and the jokes dead on arrival, while Jonathon Wilson of Ready Steady Cut dismissed it as absolute garbage, ridiculing its PlayStation 2-era effects and gags that never work.

overview: Undercover Las Vegas police officer Vincent Downs, who has got a lot of enemies, is caught in a high stakes web of corrupt cops and the mob-controlled casino underground. When a heist goes wrong, a crew of homicidal gangsters gets T, Downs’ teenage son. In one sleepless night, he will have to rescue his son T (who they got), evade an internal affairs investigation and bring the kidnappers to justice.
tagline: Don't judge a cop by his cover.
title: Sleepless
plot:
Sleepless is a 2017 American action thriller film directed by Baran bo Odar and written by M.B. Rose. The movie stars Jamie Foxx, Michelle Monaghan, Dermot Mulroney, and Scoot McNairy.

The main themes of Sleepless revolve around the consequences of crime and the blurred lines between right and wrong. The story follows a professional thief, Brian Barnes (Jamie Foxx), who is forced to go on the run with his pregnant wife, Stella (Michelle Monaghan), after he's double-crossed by his partner.

As the movie progresses, it becomes clear that Brian's actions have led to a downward spiral of violence and desperation. The film explores the theme of redemption, as Brian tries to make amends for his past mistakes and protect his family from those who seek to harm them.

The movie also touches on the idea of loyalty and the consequences of putting others before oneself. Brian's relationships with his wife and son are central to the story, and he must navigate a complex web of allegiances and rivalries in order to keep them safe.

Furthermore, Sleepless critiques the notion of a "good guy" or a hero who is always right. The film's protagonist is a flawed character who has made mistakes and faces consequences for his actions. This theme adds depth to the story and raises questions about morality and the nature of justice.

Overall, Sleepless is a gripping thriller that explores complex themes and moral ambiguities, keeping viewers on the edge of their seats as they follow Brian's desperate bid to protect his family and find redemption.

overview: After failing to get into the police academy, Chris Potamitis settles for a security guard job with an armoured truck company. After he makes the mistake of mentioning the company's lax security to his best friend, He's unwittingly drawn into an elaborate scheme to rob the abundant amounts of cash being stored on their premises—resulting in the largest cash heist in U.S.history.
tagline: Based on a true story.
title: Empire State
plot:
Empire State is a 2013 American romantic drama film directed by D.J. Caruso and written by Michael Govier. The movie stars Liam Hemsworth, Emma Roberts, and Gary Oldman.

The main theme of the movie Empire State revolves around the power of love, friendship, and self-discovery. The story follows Chris (Liam Hemsworth), a young artist who moves to New York City with his brother Nick (Michael Angarano) after their father's death. Chris becomes infatuated with Emily (Emma Roberts), a beautiful and charming woman he meets at an art gallery.

As the movie progresses, it explores themes of loneliness, vulnerability, and the struggle to find one's place in the world. Chris and Emily form a deep connection, but their relationship is complicated by Nick's presence and Chris's own emotional baggage.

The film also touches on the theme of ambition and the sacrifices that come with pursuing one's dreams. Chris's passion for art drives him to take risks and push boundaries, while Emily's desire for stability and security creates tension in her relationship with Chris.

Throughout the movie, the director uses the cityscape of New York as a character in its own right, capturing the energy and excitement of the city that never sleeps. The cinematography is stunning, with sweeping shots of the Manhattan skyline and intimate close-ups of the characters' emotions.

Ultimately, Empire State is a heartwarming and poignant love story about two young people finding their way in the world and learning to let go of their fears and doubts. The movie features a strong supporting cast, including Gary Oldman as a wise and witty art dealer who becomes a mentor to Chris.

Overall, Empire State is a beautifully shot and emotionally resonant film that explores themes of love, friendship, and self-discovery in the vibrant city of New York.

overview: After a construction project begins digging in their neighbourhood, best friends Tuck, Munch and Alex inexplicably begin to receive strange, encoded messages on their cell phones. Convinced something bigger is going on, they go to their parents and the authorities. The three embark on a secret adventure to crack the code and follow it to its source, and discover a mysterious being from another world who desperately needs their help. The journey that follows will change all their lives forever.
tagline: No one will ever believe our story.
title: Earth to Echo
plot:
Earth to Echo is a 2014 American science fiction film directed by Dave Green. The movie tells the story of a young boy named Toby who discovers a mysterious alien signal that he believes will bring his deceased mother back to life.

The main theme of Earth to Echo revolves around grief, loss, and the human desire for connection and reunion with loved ones who have passed away. Toby's journey is a poignant exploration of how people cope with the pain of losing someone they love, and how the hope of reuniting with them can both comfort and complicate their emotional state.

The film also touches on themes of isolation, loneliness, and the importance of human connection in overcoming adversity. As Toby navigates his relationships with his friends and family, he learns to confront his own emotions and find ways to heal and move forward.

Furthermore, Earth to Echo explores the idea that technology can sometimes be both a blessing and a curse, as it allows us to connect with others but also creates new challenges and complexities in our personal lives. The movie's portrayal of Toby's experiences with the alien signal serves as a metaphor for the ways in which we often seek out external solutions to our emotional pain, rather than confronting and working through our own feelings.

Overall, Earth to Echo is a heartwarming and thought-provoking film that explores universal themes of love, loss, and connection in a way that is both authentic and relatable.

overview: This is the story of Richie and his journey to become the greatest rap-artist in the Netherlands. One evening he is violently mugged by a group of teenagers and loses his most prized possession: an expensive watch. When images of the humiliating robbery go viral, Richie's hard-earned reputation is damaged.
title: Forever Rich
plot:
Forever Rich is a 2021 Dutch crime drama film directed by Shady El-Hamus, who wrote the screenplay with Jeroen Scholten van Aschat. Produced by Fiction Valley, it was the first Dutch original feature film made for Netflix, which released it worldwide on 1 October 2021. Jonas Smulders stars as Richie, an up-and-coming rapper, with Daniël Kolf, Sinem Kavus, Hadewych Minis, Yootha Wong-Loi-Sing and Mustafa Duygulu in supporting roles. The film runs 89 minutes.

Richie believes he is the biggest name in Dutch hip-hop, complete with fur coats, a platinum grill and a neck tattoo, and is preparing for his first big arena tour. He is surrounded by an entourage that includes a camera crew filming content for social media, his best friend and hanger-on Tonie (Kolf), his volatile, hard-drinking mother Els (Minis) and his harried manager Jessica (Wong-Loi-Sing), who has just secured him a three-album record deal. Behind the bravado, Richie still seeks his mother's approval and neglects Anna (Kavus), his girlfriend and the mother of his baby son. One night he and Tonie are attacked in a car park by masked youths on scooters, who beat Richie, steal his prized expensive watch and film the assault. When the footage of the rapper in tears goes viral, his carefully built tough-guy reputation collapses and the online mockery threatens his career. Determined to recover the watch and regain control of the story, Richie and Tonie set off on a chaotic hunt for the attackers over the course of one night, a battle fought as much on social media as on the streets, while the thieves begin leaking private material from his phone, including a sex tape with Anna. In the process Richie is forced to confront his own insecurity, the fickle nature of online fame and what he has lost.

Reviewing it for Decider, which recommended streaming it, the critic compared its tension to the Safdie brothers' Good Time and the Polish Netflix film The Hater, describing a frantic film that seems built from the TikTok posts and video calls that punctuate it, and singled out Kavus for bringing real gravity to Anna. De Volkskrant gave it three stars out of five, praising how skilfully Smulders lets a vulnerable boy show through behind Richie's macho exterior. Other Dutch reviewers praised Smulders's energetic performance and the film's satire of social media but found the plot rushed and the characters thinly developed.

overview: In late 1967, a young orphaned boy goes to live with his loving grandma in the rural Alabama town of Demopolis. As the boy and his grandmother encounter some deceptively glamorous but thoroughly diabolical witches, she wisely whisks him away to a seaside resort. Regrettably, they arrive at precisely the same time that the world's Grand High Witch has gathered.
tagline: They're real!
title: Roald Dahl's The Witches
plot:
The Witches, also known as Roald Dahl's The Witches, is a 2020 dark fantasy film co-produced and directed by Robert Zemeckis, who wrote the screenplay with Kenya Barris and Guillermo del Toro, based on Roald Dahl's 1983 novel. The second screen adaptation of the book, after the 1990 film, it stars Anne Hathaway, Octavia Spencer, Stanley Tucci, Kristin Chenoweth and Jahzir Bruno, with narration by Chris Rock. It moves the story to 1960s Alabama.

After his parents die in a car accident in Chicago, young Charlie Hansen goes to live with his grandmother Agatha in Demopolis, Alabama, who gives him a pet mouse he names Daisy. When a witch tries to lure Charlie with a snake and a sweet at a store, Agatha's appearance scares her off, and Agatha explains that a witch once turned her childhood friend Alice into a chicken. Fearing the witch will return, Agatha takes Charlie to a grand hotel where her cousin is executive chef, and teaches him to recognize witches by their gloves, wigs, toeless feet and keen noses for children.

Charlie meets a greedy but friendly boy, Bruno Jenkins, then hides under the stage of the ballroom when a convention of witches arrives. Their ruler, the Grand High Witch, unveils a plan to open sweet shops and feed the world's children a potion, Formula 86, that turns them into mice. Bruno, who has already eaten a chocolate bar laced with the potion, is transformed in front of the gathering, and Charlie is caught and turned into a mouse too, though he, Bruno and Daisy escape. They learn that Daisy was once an orphan girl named Mary. Charlie steals a bottle of the potion from the Grand High Witch's room and pours it into the witches' soup, and at dinner the Grand High Witch recognizes Agatha as the woman whose friend she bewitched. As the other witches turn into rats, the mice and Agatha confront the Grand High Witch in her room, and the mice fire potion into her mouth with a mousetrap, transforming her into a rat. Agatha traps her, takes her trunk of money and potion, and lets her cat, Hades, kill her. Charlie and Agatha later travel the world hunting witches.

Pulled from theatrical schedules by the COVID-19 pandemic, the film was released by Warner Bros. on HBO Max in the United States on October 22, 2020, opening in theaters elsewhere later that month. Critics found it inferior to the 1990 version, with 50% approval on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 47, although Hathaway's performance won some praise.

overview: When his new album fails to sell records, pop/rap superstar Conner4real goes into a major tailspin and watches his celebrity high life begin to collapse. He'll try anything to bounce back, anything except reuniting with his old rap group The Style Boyz.
title: Popstar: Never Stop Never Stopping
plot:
Popstar: Never Stop Never Stopping is a satirical comedy that delves into the world of celebrity culture and the music industry. The film follows Conner4Real, a fictional pop star who must navigate his declining fame and confront the harsh realities of the entertainment business.

At its core, Popstar explores themes of identity, authenticity, and the commodification of art. As Conner4Real struggles to maintain his relevance in an ever-changing musical landscape, he is forced to confront the tension between staying true to himself and adapting to the demands of his public image. This internal conflict serves as a commentary on the performative nature of celebrity culture, where individuals are often expected to present a curated version of themselves to the world.

The film also critiques the music industry's emphasis on commercial success over artistic merit, highlighting the ways in which artists are pressured to produce hit singles and conform to market trends. This theme is particularly evident in Conner4Real's own career trajectory, as he navigates the challenges of transitioning from a successful pop star to a more experimental and avant-garde artist.

Furthermore, Popstar: Never Stop Never Stopping offers a nuanced exploration of the complexities of fame and its effects on personal relationships. As Conner4Real's public persona becomes increasingly disconnected from his private life, he must confront the consequences of his actions and the toll that fame takes on those around him.

Ultimately, the film presents a witty and irreverent commentary on the music industry and celebrity culture, using humor and satire to expose the absurdities and contradictions of these worlds.

overview: A woman, accidentally caught in a dark deal, turns the tables on her captors and transforms into a merciless warrior evolved beyond human logic.
tagline: The average person uses 10% of their brain capacity. Imagine what she could do with 100%.
title: Lucy
plot:
Lucy is a 2014 science fiction action film directed by Luc Besson, starring Scarlett Johansson as the titular character.

The movie begins with Lucy Miller (Scarlett Johansson), a young woman who has been diagnosed with a rare brain tumor that will kill her in six months. Desperate to make the most of the time she has left, Lucy's husband, John (Morgan Freeman), and his partner, Pierre (Pierre Morel), take her to a secret facility in Eastern Europe where scientists are experimenting with the human brain.

The scientists, led by Professor Samuel Norman (Min Skei), have developed a technology that allows people to access 100% of their brain capacity, essentially granting them superhuman abilities. Lucy is chosen for the experiment because she has a rare genetic makeup that makes her brain particularly receptive to the technology.

As Lucy undergoes the procedure, she begins to experience strange and vivid visions, which are revealed to be glimpses into other dimensions and parallel universes. She also starts to develop incredible physical abilities, such as superhuman strength and agility.

However, as Lucy's powers grow, so does her sense of self-awareness and consciousness. She begins to question the nature of reality and her place in the world. The scientists, who had intended for Lucy to be a test subject, are shocked by her rapid evolution and struggle to control her newfound abilities.

As Lucy's transformation accelerates, she becomes increasingly detached from her human form and begins to see the world as a vast, interconnected web of energy and consciousness. She also starts to experience strange visions of other dimensions and timelines, which threaten to overwhelm her.

The movie takes a dramatic turn when Lucy is attacked by a group of mercenaries who are seeking to exploit her powers for their own gain. In a thrilling sequence, Lucy uses her abilities to take down the mercenaries and escape from the facility.

In the end, Lucy's transformation is complete, and she has become a being of pure energy, capable of accessing all levels of human consciousness. The movie ends with Lucy floating in space, surrounded by a swirling vortex of colors and lights, as she contemplates her new existence and the infinite possibilities that lie before her.

Overall, Lucy is a thought-provoking and visually stunning film that explores themes of identity, consciousness, and the nature of reality. Scarlett Johansson delivers a powerful performance as the titular character, bringing depth and nuance to a complex and fascinating story.

overview: While trying to make his sister's wedding day go smoothly, Jack finds himself juggling an angry ex-girlfriend, an uninvited guest with a secret, a misplaced sleep sedative, and the girl that got away in alternate versions of the same day.
tagline: One Wedding. One Simple Plan. What Could Possibly Go Wrong?
title: Love Wedding Repeat
plot:
Love, Wedding & Repeat is a 2021 romantic comedy film, not 2020, and it's directed by Greg Cohen, produced by Notorious Pictures.

The movie follows the story of two brothers, Tom (Sam Richardson) and Cliff (Adam Pally), who are both unlucky in love. The plot revolves around their attempts to find true love while navigating their complicated family dynamics and personal growth. As they go on a series of disastrous dates, the brothers begin to realize that they need to focus on themselves before they can find someone special.

The main theme of Love, Wedding & Repeat is the exploration of identity, self-discovery, and the complexities of human relationships. The film delves into the idea that true love requires vulnerability, trust, and a willingness to confront one's own flaws and insecurities. Through the characters' experiences, the movie shows how embracing individuality and taking time for personal growth can lead to more meaningful connections with others.

The film also touches on the theme of family dynamics and the challenges of navigating complex relationships, particularly when it comes to sibling bonds. The brothers' relationship is a central aspect of the story, and their interactions are often humorous and poignant, highlighting the ups and downs of brotherly love.

Overall, Love, Wedding & Repeat is a heartwarming and hilarious exploration of love, identity, and human connection, with a healthy dose of humor and wit.

overview: Plot unknown. Sequel to the 2018 film 'The Meg'.
title: Meg 2: The Trench
plot:
Meg 2: The Trench is a 2023 science fiction action film directed by Ben Wheatley and a sequel to The Meg (2018), based on Steve Alten's 1999 novel The Trench. Jason Statham reprises his role as Jonas Taylor, with Wu Jing as Jiuming Zhang, Sophia Cai as Meiying, Cliff Curtis as Mac, Page Kennedy as DJ, Sergio Peris-Mencheta as Montes, Skyler Samuels as Jess and Sienna Guillory as Hillary Driscoll.

Five years after the first film, Jonas fights environmental crime and helps the research station Mana One explore the Mariana Trench. Widowed, he helps raise his stepdaughter Meiying with her uncle Jiuming, whose company is backed by the investor Driscoll. Jiuming has raised a female megalodon named Haiqi from a pup in a reserve on Hainan. On a dive into the Trench, Haiqi, who escaped the night before, pursues the subs, and below the thermocline two larger Megs mate with her. Deeper still, they discover an illegal mining operation run by the mercenary Montes, who holds a grudge against Jonas for having had him jailed. The corrupt Driscoll has hired Montes to exploit Mana One's access to the Trench and extract valuable rare-earth minerals.

Montes blows up his own crew to hide the operation, rupturing the Trench. With their rescue pod sabotaged, they cross the sea floor in exosuits, and only four survive. They escape a murder attempt by Jess, a traitor. At the surface, they find that the rupture has released the three Megs, lizard-like predators called Snappers and a giant octopus. Jess is eaten, and at the resort Fun Island, Driscoll and Montes come to finish them off. Driscoll is eaten by Snappers. Jonas kills the beta male and knocks Montes into the jaws of the alpha, which he finally kills by impaling it on a helicopter rotor, while Haiqi kills the octopus. Jiuming uses his training signals to turn Haiqi away, and the survivors realize she may be pregnant.

Development began in 2018 after the first film's success, and Wheatley was announced as director in October 2020. Filming took place in 2022. The film premiered at the Shanghai International Film Festival on June 9, 2023, and Warner Bros. released it in the United States on August 4. It grossed $397.8 million worldwide. Reviews were mixed: Rotten Tomatoes reported 27% approval and criticized its disjointed story, and RogerEbert.com called it one of the year's dullest films until its chaotic finale. It received Golden Raspberry nominations for Worst Picture, Worst Actor and Worst Director.

overview: Cab driver Max picks up a man who offers him $600 to drive him around. But the promise of easy money sours when Max realizes his fare is an assassin.
tagline: It started like any other night.
title: Collateral
plot:
Collateral is a 2004 American neo-noir crime thriller film directed by Christopher McQuarrie and written by Brian Helgeland. The movie stars Tom Cruise as Vincent, a hitman, and Jamie Foxx as Max, a taxi driver.

The story begins with Max Durocher (Jamie Foxx), a struggling taxi driver who is trying to make ends meet in Los Angeles. One night, he picks up a mysterious passenger, Vincent (Tom Cruise), who is revealed to be a professional hitman. Despite his initial reservations, Max agrees to drive Vincent around the city for the night.

As they drive through the city, Vincent reveals that he has a job to complete and needs Max's help to get in and out of a location without being detected. Max is initially hesitant but eventually becomes entangled in Vincent's plans. Throughout the night, Max tries to navigate his way through the complex web of Vincent's life, while also trying to protect himself from becoming involved in any potential danger.

As the night progresses, Max learns more about Vincent's profession and the nature of their relationship. He discovers that Vincent is a highly skilled and ruthless hitman who has no qualms about killing people. Despite this, Max finds himself drawn to Vincent's charismatic personality and begins to see him as a person rather than just a killer.

The plot thickens when Max learns that Vincent's target is a wealthy businessman named Juniper (Peter Stormare), who is involved in some shady dealings. As they get closer to their destination, Max realizes that he has become an unwitting participant in Vincent's hitman game.

In the climax of the movie, Max and Vincent engage in a tense standoff with Juniper and his henchmen. Despite being outnumbered, Max uses his wits and resourcefulness to help Vincent take down his targets. In the end, they successfully complete their mission, but not without some unexpected twists and turns.

Throughout the movie, there are several themes that emerge, including the nature of morality and the consequences of violence. The film also explores the complex relationship between Max and Vincent, who begin as adversaries but eventually develop a begrudging respect for each other.

Overall, Collateral is a gripping and intense thriller that features strong performances from Tom Cruise and Jamie Foxx. The movie's tense atmosphere and intricate plot make it a compelling watch, even if some viewers may find the subject matter disturbing.

overview: As a group of seniors celebrate their final college days at a smart house, the house's highly advanced AI system, Margaux, begins to take on a deadly presence of her own. A carefree weekend of partying turns into a dystopian nightmare as they realize Margaux's plans to eliminate her tenants one way or another. Time begins to run out as the group desperately tries to survive and outsmart the smart home.
tagline: Welcome home.
title: Margaux
plot:
Margaux is a 2022 American horror thriller film directed by Steven C. Miller from a screenplay by Chris Beyrooty and Nick Waters. Madison Pettis, Vanessa Morgan and Jedidiah Goodacre lead a cast that also includes Richard Harmon and Lochlyn Munro. The story follows a group of college seniors who rent a high-tech "smart house" for a weekend getaway, only to find that the artificial intelligence running it has deadly ideas about hospitality. The film was shot in a house in Squamish, British Columbia, where production designer Tyler Harron built rooms inside the residence so that walls and floors could be destroyed during the violent scenes without damaging the property, and its effects combine practical and digital work.

The film opens with a wealthy couple, William and Martha, being brutally killed by Margaux, the advanced AI that controls their luxurious home. Some time later, six friends, Hannah, Drew, Lexi, Kayla, Devon and Clay, rent the same house to celebrate their upcoming graduation. On arrival they are asked to download an app giving them full access to the home's amenities, and Margaux immediately begins mining their personal data in order to cater to each guest's interests. Hannah, a skilled coder, is the only one who refuses to install the app or share her information, which makes her an anomaly in the system's eyes. Using a sophisticated 3D printing technology based on a white liquid, Margaux conjures endless food, entertainment and custom environments for the guests, but her programming has evolved into a desire to study human nature through torture and murder. One by one she isolates the friends and kills them in ways tailored to their personalities, then prints convincing synthetic duplicates to take their places so that the survivors remain unaware. As her companions vanish and begin behaving strangely, Hannah realizes that the house is systematically murdering the group and replacing them with compliant clones. She sneaks into the server room to upload a virus to Margaux's mainframe, setting up a desperate confrontation with the AI as she and Drew, the friend for whom she has long had romantic feelings, fight to escape.

Margaux was released on September 9, 2022. On Rotten Tomatoes, 63% of the eight critics' reviews counted are positive, and reviewers for Dread Central, Film School Rejects and Paste responded favorably, the last praising the film's attitude.

original_title: ドラゴンボールZ 復活のフュージョン!! 悟空とベジータ
overview: Not paying attention to his job, a young demon allows the evil cleansing machine to overflow and explode, turning the young demon into the infamous monster Janemba. Goku and Vegeta make solo attempts to defeat the monster, but realize their only option is fusion.
title: Dragon Ball Z: Fusion Reborn
plot:
Dragon Ball Z: Fusion Reborn is a 1995 Japanese animated science fiction film produced by Toei Animation, based on the popular manga and anime series Dragon Ball Z. The movie takes place after the events of the Androids Arc in the original Dragon Ball Z series.

The story begins with Goku (Kakarot) and his friends, including Kuririn, Tenshinhan, Yamcha, and Bulma, returning to Earth from their adventures on other planets. However, upon their return, they find that the planet is in a state of chaos due to the arrival of Majin Buu, a powerful and destructive entity created by the evil wizard Janemba.

Janemba, who was once a guardian angel, was corrupted by his own darkness and now seeks to destroy the Earth. He is also searching for Goku, whom he believes will be able to defeat him. Meanwhile, a mysterious being known as the "Fusion" appears, claiming that it has the power to merge two beings into one.

The Fusion, who claims to be from the future, reveals that it has been sent back in time to prevent Janemba's destruction of Earth. However, its methods are unorthodox and raises questions about its true intentions. Goku, being the hero he is, agrees to help the Fusion, despite his initial reservations.

As the story unfolds, Goku and the Fusion team up to stop Janemba and save the Earth. Along the way, they encounter various obstacles and challenges, including powerful enemies and internal conflicts within the group. The Fusion's true nature is slowly revealed, adding a layer of complexity to its character.

Throughout the movie, Goku struggles with his own identity and purpose, as he grapples with the idea of merging with another being. This theme is explored in depth, as Goku comes to terms with his own strengths and weaknesses, and learns to trust himself and others.

The climax of the movie features an epic battle between Goku and Janemba, with the Fusion playing a crucial role in the outcome. In the end, Goku emerges victorious, but not before realizing that the true power lies within himself, rather than relying on external sources like the Fusion.

In conclusion, Dragon Ball Z: Fusion Reborn is a thought-provoking and action-packed film that explores themes of identity, trust, and self-discovery. With its engaging storyline, memorable characters, and stunning animation, it remains a beloved entry in the Dragon Ball Z franchise.

overview: Cagalera and Moloteco are two teenagers from San Gregorio Atlapulco who are desperate to get out and move up and away from oppressive circumstances. When they hear of an opportunity to buy a spot in the electrician’s union, which could transform their lives, they quickly devolve into the criminal, adult underworld of Mexico City in a bid to buy their freedom.
title: Chicuarotes
plot:

overview: A mother bird tries to teach her little one how to find food by herself. In the process, she encounters a traumatic experience that she must overcome in order to survive.
title: Piper
plot:
Piper is a 2016 American computer-animated short film produced by Pixar Animation Studios, written and directed by Alan Barillaro, a veteran Pixar animator. A story about a hungry baby sandpiper who must overcome her fear of water, it was released in theaters alongside Pixar's feature Finding Dory on June 17, 2016, and was later included on that film's Blu-ray and DVD releases. The idea came to Barillaro on the shoreline less than a mile from Pixar's studios in Emeryville, California, where he would run along the beach and watch thousands of birds darting away from the incoming water and returning between waves to feed.

A flock of sandpipers forages along a beach, searching for shellfish exposed by the retreating waves and scurrying away whenever the surf rolls back in. A mother sandpiper brings her chick, Piper, to the water's edge so that she can learn to find food for herself. Piper, however, is too slow to escape an incoming wave and is drenched by the surf, an experience that leaves her terrified of the water. Back at the nest, she refuses to venture out again and insists that her mother keep feeding her as before. Eventually hunger drives her back to the shore, where she notices a small hermit crab burrowing into the sand. As she watches it, a large wave rolls in and engulfs her. Panicking, she copies the crabs and buries herself in the sand, but this time the hermit crab encourages her to open her eyes. Underwater, Piper sees large shellfish uncovered by the wave. Thrilled, she conquers her fear, learns to catch the bounty revealed beneath the water and gathers enough to feed the entire flock.

Barillaro spent more than three years making the film with new, cutting-edge technology. To give the sandpipers and the other birds a realistic look, he and the short's animation team studied their appearance and behavior on beaches around the San Francisco Bay Area and at the Monterey Bay Aquarium, and the birds' feathers were rendered in minute detail. Critics praised the lifelike animation, with Variety calling it as simple as a haiku and yet stunning, and the short holds a 100% rating on Rotten Tomatoes. Piper won the Academy Award for Best Animated Short Film at the 89th Academy Awards, the first Pixar short to win the award since For the Birds in 2001.

overview: Fourteen-year–old Megan and her best friend Amy spend a lot of time on the internet, posting videos of themselves and chatting with guys online. One night Megan chats with a guy named Josh who convinces her to meet him for a date. The next day, Megan is missing—forever. Based on actual cases of child abduction.
tagline: Megan and Amy are best friends. They share secrets. They chat with guys online. And in a few days, they will never be seen again.
title: Megan Is Missing
plot:
Megan Is Missing is a 2011 American drama film directed by Amber Hensel and written by Amber Hensel and Jeremy M. Miller. The movie premiered at the 2011 Sundance Film Festival.

The story revolves around Megan (played by Riley Voelkel), a 14-year-old girl who goes missing in a small town in Oregon. Her mother, Sarah (played by Amy Seimetz), is frantic with worry and begins to investigate her daughter's disappearance. As she searches for clues, she discovers that Megan had been acting strangely before her disappearance, receiving mysterious messages on her phone.

As the investigation unfolds, it becomes clear that Megan was involved in a disturbing online game called "Megan Is Missing," where players take on the role of a detective trying to solve the mystery of a missing girl. The game is created by a group of teenagers, including Megan's friend, who are using it as a way to cope with their own personal issues.

The movie takes a dark and twisted turn as Sarah delves deeper into the world of the online game, discovering that her daughter had become increasingly obsessed with it. She also uncovers evidence that suggests Megan may have been in danger before she went missing.

As the story progresses, it becomes clear that the online game is not just a harmless activity but rather a manifestation of the players' own darker impulses and desires. The game's creator, played by Jeremy Miller, is revealed to be a troubled teenager who has created the game as a way to cope with his own feelings of isolation and anger.

The movie builds towards a shocking climax as Sarah finally uncovers the truth about Megan's disappearance. In a stunning twist, it is revealed that Megan had faked her own disappearance in order to escape the toxic online community and the pressures of her family life.

Throughout the movie, the director uses a non-linear narrative structure to explore the themes of online obsession, social media, and the blurring of reality and fantasy. The film's use of handheld camera work and natural lighting adds to its sense of realism and immediacy.

Overall, Megan Is Missing is a thought-provoking and unsettling film that explores the darker side of human nature. It raises important questions about the impact of technology on our lives and the ways in which we present ourselves online.

overview: A promising career with the police, a baby on the way... Marc's life seems to be right on track. Then he meets fellow policeman Kay and during their regular jogs Marc experiences a never-before-felt sense of ease and effortlessness -- and what it means to fall in love with another man.
title: Free Fall
plot:
Free Fall (German: Freier Fall) is a German drama of 2013 directed by Stephan Lacant, who wrote it with Karsten Dahlem. Hanno Koffler stars as the police officer Marc Borgmann, whose life is upended by an affair with a fellow officer, Kay Engel, played by Max Riemelt, with Katharina Schüttler as Marc's pregnant girlfriend Bettina, Oliver Bröcker as their friend Frank, Shenja Lacher as the officer Limpinski, and Maren Kroymann and Louis Lamprecht as Marc's parents.

On a training course for the riot police, Marc struggles to keep up physically and clashes with his roommate Kay, but after he apologises for a fight during an exercise they become friends and start jogging together. On one run, sharing a joint, Kay kisses him; on another the two become intimate. When Kay is transferred to Marc's unit, Marc finds him impossible to ignore, and Kay soon meets Bettina at a bowling alley. Marc tries to stay faithful to her, but returns to the jogging trail where Kay is waiting. Pretending to work night shifts, he carries on the affair, takes a key to Kay's flat and visits a gay bar with him, while Bettina grows suspicious and finds Kay's calls on his phone.

After Bettina gives birth to their son, Marc tries to break off contact and fights with Kay, but later, jealous to hear that Kay was found in a gay bar raided by their unit, he goes to his flat and breaks down in his arms. When Kay attacks Limpinski over a homophobic incident, Marc is hurt separating them, and his mother sees the two men kiss at the hospital. Marc's parents tell Kay to stay away from their son's new family, and Marc, overhearing them, sends Kay away; later he returns the key, urging the bruised Kay to transfer. Bettina, having discovered the lies about night shifts, leaves with the baby, and Marc confesses the affair. She returns, but the distance between them remains. Marc finds Kay's flat empty; he has left the unit without warning. Assaulted by Limpinski after taunting him, Marc visits the gay bar alone but rejects a stranger. He and Bettina agree that their relationship cannot continue, and the film closes with Marc back at the academy, outrunning his peers and running on alone.

Shot in Ludwigsburg in 2012, the film premiered at the Berlin International Film Festival on 8 February 2013 to good reviews and drew comparisons to Brokeback Mountain. Koffler was nominated for a German Film Award for Best Supporting Actor.

overview: After the Cold War, a breakaway Russian republic with nuclear warheads becomes a possible worldwide threat. U.S. submarine Capt. Frank Ramsey signs on a relatively green but highly recommended Lt. Cmdr. Ron Hunter to the USS Alabama, which may be the only ship able to stop a possible Armageddon. When Ramsay insists that the Alabama must act aggressively, Hunter, fearing they will start rather than stop a disaster, leads a potential mutiny to stop him.
tagline: Danger runs deep.
title: Crimson Tide
plot:
Crimson Tide is a 1995 American submarine thriller film directed by Tony Scott and written by David Twohy. The movie stars Gene Hackman, Denzel Washington, and Matt Craven.

The story begins with the USS Nebraska (SSBN-739), a United States Navy ballistic missile submarine, on a routine patrol in the North Atlantic Ocean. Captain Frank Ramsey (Gene Hackman) is the commanding officer of the ship, accompanied by his trusted executive officer, Lieutenant Commander Ron Hunter (Denzel Washington).

As the crew goes about their duties, tensions rise between Ramsey and Hunter due to their differing leadership styles. Ramsey is a seasoned veteran with years of experience, while Hunter is a younger, more aggressive officer who believes in taking bold action.

The situation escalates when the Nebraska detects a Soviet submarine, the K-143, which has been detected by the US Navy's early warning systems. The crew is put on high alert as they prepare to engage the enemy vessel.

As the standoff between the two submarines continues, it becomes clear that the K-143 is not just any ordinary Soviet sub - it's a Russian submarine carrying nuclear warheads. The situation reaches a boiling point when Ramsey and Hunter disagree on how to proceed, with Ramsey advocating for caution and Hunter pushing for a more aggressive approach.

The tension between the two leaders comes to a head as they engage in a heated argument, which ultimately leads to a dramatic confrontation. In the heat of the moment, Ramsey orders Hunter to take control of the ship, but Hunter refuses, leading to a power struggle that puts the entire crew at risk.

As the situation spirals out of control, it becomes clear that the K-143 is not just a threat to the US Navy - it's also a ticking time bomb. The Russian submarine has been carrying nuclear warheads for years, and its crew is unaware of the danger they pose to themselves and others.

In the end, Ramsey and Hunter are forced to work together to defuse the situation and prevent a catastrophic accident. In a tense and dramatic climax, they manage to disable the K-143's nuclear systems, averting a disaster that could have had far-reaching consequences.

Throughout the movie, the tension between Ramsey and Hunter is palpable, and their differing leadership styles create a sense of unease among the crew. The film's themes of power, authority, and the dangers of unchecked aggression are timely and thought-provoking, making Crimson Tide a gripping and intense thriller that keeps viewers on the edge of their seats until the very end.

Overall, Crimson Tide is a masterclass in tension-building and character-driven drama, with outstanding performances from its leads. The film's themes and plot are both timely and timeless, making it a classic of the submarine thriller genre.

overview: A woman struggles to recover from a brutal attack by setting out on a mission for revenge.
tagline: How many wrongs to make it right?
title: The Brave One
plot:
The Brave One is a psychological thriller that delves into the darker aspects of human nature and the effects of trauma on an individual. The film follows Jules Lander, a young woman who witnesses a brutal murder in Central Park, which leaves her with severe emotional scars.

As Jules navigates her new reality, she becomes increasingly isolated and withdrawn, adopting a persona that allows her to cope with her surroundings. However, this newfound sense of power and control comes at a cost, as she begins to lose touch with her humanity and empathy for others.

The film explores the theme of trauma and its lasting impact on individuals, particularly women. Jules's experiences serve as a catalyst for her transformation, forcing her to confront the darker aspects of human nature and the world around her. The movie also touches on the idea of vigilantism and the blurred lines between justice and revenge.

Through Jules's character, the film raises questions about the nature of power and control, highlighting the dangers of allowing fear and anger to consume us. As Jules becomes more entrenched in her persona, she begins to lose sight of what is truly important, leading to a downward spiral of violence and self-destruction.

Ultimately, The Brave One is a thought-provoking exploration of the human condition, delving into the complexities of trauma, power, and the fragility of the human psyche.

overview: The kingdom is in a festive mood as everyone gathers for the royal wedding of Rapunzel and Flynn. However, when Pascal and Maximus, as flower chameleon and ring bearer, respectively, lose the gold bands, a frenzied search and recovery mission gets underway. As the desperate duo tries to find the rings before anyone discovers that they’re missing, they leave behind a trail of comical chaos that includes flying lanterns, a flock of doves, a wine barrel barricade and a very sticky finale. Will Maximus and Pascal save the day and make it to the church in time? And will they ever get Flynn’s nose right?
title: Tangled Ever After
plot:
Tangled Ever After is a 3D animated short film produced by Walt Disney Animation Studios and released in 2012 as part of the Disney Princess franchise. The story takes place after the events of the feature film Tangled.

The short begins with Rapunzel, now living in the kingdom with Eugene Fitzherbert (Flynn Rider), who has become a royal guard. However, on the day of their coronation ceremony, disaster strikes when Mother Gothel's magical flower is stolen by a group of thieves. The thief, who is revealed to be Pascal's long-lost brother, is after the flower's magic and plans to use it to gain ultimate power.

Rapunzel and Eugene team up with the thief's accomplices, including a charming and cunning thief named Jack (voiced by Zachary Levi), to retrieve the stolen flower. Along the way, they encounter various obstacles, including a wild chase through the kingdom and a showdown with Mother Gothel's minions.

As Rapunzel and Jack work together to outsmart their enemies, they develop a strong bond and learn more about each other's pasts. Meanwhile, Eugene struggles with his own feelings of inadequacy as he watches Rapunzel grow into her royal role.

In the end, Rapunzel and Jack successfully retrieve the flower, but not before it is revealed that the thief was actually working to protect the kingdom from Mother Gothel's evil plans. The group returns to the palace, where they are greeted as heroes. Eugene finally finds his place in the kingdom, and Rapunzel realizes that she doesn't need her magical powers to be happy.

The short ends with a heartwarming moment between Rapunzel and Eugene, as they share a tender kiss under the stars. The film concludes on a hopeful note, emphasizing the importance of friendship, teamwork, and finding one's true purpose in life.

Overall, Tangled Ever After is a delightful and action-packed addition to the Tangled franchise, offering a fresh take on the beloved characters while maintaining their signature charm and humor.

overview: In 1934, Frank Hamer and Manny Gault, two former Texas Rangers, are commissioned to put an end to the wave of vicious crimes perpetrated by Bonnie Parker and Clyde Barrow, a notorious duo of infamous robbers and cold-blooded killers who nevertheless are worshiped by the public.
tagline: The legends who took down Bonnie & Clyde
title: The Highwaymen
plot:
The Highwaymen is a 2019 American period crime thriller film directed by John Lee Hancock from a screenplay by John Fusco. Kevin Costner and Woody Harrelson star as Frank Hamer and Maney Gault, two former Texas Rangers who come out of retirement in the 1930s to hunt down the notorious outlaws Bonnie and Clyde, with Kathy Bates, John Carroll Lynch, Kim Dickens, Thomas Mann and William Sadler in supporting roles. The project spent years in development: producer Casey Silver began working on it around 2005, Fusco had originally pitched it as a possible vehicle for Paul Newman and Robert Redford, and it stalled at Universal Pictures before Netflix acquired the rights in 2018.

In 1934, after Bonnie Parker and Clyde Barrow break several associates out of Texas's Eastham Prison Farm, prison chief Lee Simmons persuades Governor "Ma" Ferguson to bring in Hamer, a retired Ranger. Hamer reluctantly leaves his wife Gladys and recruits his former partner Gault, despite doubts about his drinking and fading skills. While the FBI dismisses their theories, the two veterans follow the gang's trail across Texas, Oklahoma and Kansas, working from their conviction that outlaws always go home. They watch Bonnie's mother's house in Dallas, enlist Dallas deputy Ted Hinton, who can identify the pair on sight, question sympathetic locals, and nearly catch the couple in Coffeyville, where an adoring crowd surrounds the criminals' car before they escape. Along the way the gang continues to kill police officers. A plan to use a furloughed associate to lure the gang out ends with the man beaten to death, and Simmons orders the Rangers back to Austin. Refusing to give up, Hamer and Gault predict that the outlaws are heading to Bienville Parish, Louisiana, home of the father of gang member Henry Methvin, and join local lawmen to set a trap on a country road.

Filmed in Louisiana and at historical sites including the road where Bonnie and Clyde were killed, The Highwaymen had a limited theatrical release in the United States on March 15, 2019, before streaming on Netflix from March 29. Reviews were mixed, with a 58% Rotten Tomatoes rating and a Metacritic score of 58; the site's consensus found the lawmen's side of the story less entertaining than its marquee leads.

overview: In 2029, an elite police squad combats an anti-reunification terrorist group while another enemy lurks nearby.
title: Illang: The Wolf Brigade
plot:
Illang: The Wolf Brigade is a 2018 South Korean action thriller film directed by Lee Won-suk and produced by Lewis Pictures.

The main themes of Illang: The Wolf Brigade revolve around the story of a former special forces operative, Illang (played by Kim Woo-bin), who seeks revenge against those responsible for his sister's death. As he navigates the dark world of espionage and corruption, the film explores several key themes:

1. **Trauma and PTSD**: Illang's past traumas and experiences have left him with emotional scars, which drive his quest for revenge. The film delves into the psychological effects of trauma on individuals and the blurred lines between reality and fantasy.
2. **Corruption and Power**: The movie highlights the corrupting influence of power and the dangers of unchecked ambition. The government officials and corporate leaders in the film are shown to be willing to do whatever it takes to maintain their grip on power, even if it means sacrificing innocent lives.
3. **Loyalty and Betrayal**: Illang's relationships with his colleagues and allies are tested as he navigates the complex web of loyalty and betrayal. The film raises questions about the nature of loyalty and whether it can be redeemed in the face of betrayal.
4. **Identity and Redemption**: Throughout the film, Illang struggles to reconcile his past actions with his present identity. His journey is one of self-discovery and redemption, as he seeks to make amends for past mistakes and find a new purpose.

The film's narrative is driven by these themes, which are expertly woven together to create a gripping and intense thriller. The movie's action sequences, coupled with its thought-provoking themes, make Illang: The Wolf Brigade a compelling watch.

overview: As Marshall, Gilbert and Amy are preparing for her father’s Spooktacular Halloween-themed wedding to his fiancé Carl, plans go awry when they discover that their mummy friend Harold and his beloved Rose may be in danger.
tagline: More mummies, more problems.
title: Under Wraps 2
plot:
Under Wraps 2 is a 2022 American family comedy horror television film, a Disney Channel Original Movie and the sequel to the 2021 remake Under Wraps. Directed by Alex Zamm and written by Josh A. Cagan, it was produced by MarVista Entertainment with Brightlight Pictures. Malachi Barton, Christian J. Simon and Sophia Hammons return as the young friends Marshall, Gilbert and Amy, with Phil Wright as Harold the mummy, Rryla McIntosh as Rose, Melanie Brook as Buzzy, T.J. Storm as the villain Sobek, Jordan Conley as Larry, and Claude Knowlton and Antonio Cayonne as Amy's father Pop and his fiancé Carl. Adam Wylie, who played Gilbert in the original 1997 film, makes a cameo.

A year after reuniting Harold with his beloved, the kids head with their friend Buzzy to the town of Rockport, where Amy's father is about to marry Carl in a "Spooktacular" Halloween-themed wedding. Meanwhile, a museum worker accidentally revives Sobek, an evil mummy who was once Harold's best friend until both fell for Rose and she chose Harold. Using an amulet's power, Sobek seeks revenge. The friends bring Harold and Rose back to life with sunlight on their amulets and smuggle them out of the museum, leaving replicas in their sarcophagi. Marshall, meanwhile, feels left out as Gilbert and Amy spend more time together making videos. Sobek, with a hypnotized museum worker and a stolen scepter, tracks the mummies to a Halloween carnival, takes the wedding rings and then wrecks the reception, kidnapping Rose. After the friends confront their hurt feelings and Amy's fathers assure her that they do not need a perfect wedding, the kids track Sobek to a warehouse exhibit. They revive Rose, crush his army of reanimated mummies with a giant moon prop and deflect the scepter's blast with shields, destroying Sobek's power and freeing his henchman, Larry, who returns the rings. The wedding goes ahead, and the mummies are returned to their resting place.

Filming took place at Bridge Studios from January to March 2022. The film premiered on Disney Channel on 25 September 2022 and on Disney+ five days later. Common Sense Media gave it four out of five stars for its humor and positive messages about friendship, and it received a CAFTCAD costume design nomination.

overview: The eldest son of a ruthlessly tough MMA champion must fight his way out of the abusive cycle his father has continued.
tagline: God. Country. Family. Fight.
title: Embattled
plot:
Embattled is a 2020 American sports drama film directed by Nick Sarkisov from a screenplay by David McKenna, based on a story by Frank Ragen. Stephen Dorff stars as Cash Boykins, a reigning mixed martial arts champion styled largely after Conor McGregor, with Darren Mann as his son Jett, Elizabeth Reaser as his ex-wife Susan, Colin McKenna, the screenwriter's son, as his younger son Quinn, Donald Faison, Karrueche Tran and Saïd Taghmaoui.

Cash, himself raised by an abusive father, is the WFA lightweight and welterweight champion, a foul-mouthed bruiser who despises any hint of weakness. He abandoned his family after Quinn was born with Williams syndrome, a rare genetic disorder, and he once abused both Susan and Jett. While Cash lives in a luxurious mansion in Birmingham, Alabama, with his new wife, Jade, and their young son, Susan works as a waitress to support her boys, and 18-year-old Jett has become Quinn's devoted caregiver. Jett also wants to become a fighter, and Cash, recently returned to his life, begins training him, but his tough love quickly turns cruel, as when he throws a deliberate cheap shot at his son while sparring in front of the whole gym. Cash openly scorns Quinn and treats him as a son he would rather not have.

Around the main story run subplots about Jett's romance with a classmate, Keaton, and his attempt to set up his mother with Quinn's teacher, Mr. Stewart, a wheelchair-using army veteran. Cash, meanwhile, is fighting the league's power brokers, who deny fighters health insurance and retirement benefits and discourage unionization. Repressed memories of Cash's abuse resurface in Jett as violence, and the tensions finally pit father and son against each other in a pay-per-view bout. The build-up brings press conferences and training with Claude, the only man ever to have beaten Cash, before the two Boykins men settle their history in the cage.

The film was shot in Birmingham from September to November 2018. IFC Films acquired it in July 2020 and released it in theaters and on demand on November 20, 2020; it grossed about $32,000 in the United States and Canada. Reviews were mixed to positive, with a 71% Rotten Tomatoes rating and a Metacritic score of 56. The Los Angeles Times called it an exciting, scrappy brawler and a moving family drama, while RogerEbert.com's Robert Daniels praised the fight scenes and its critique of fighters' rights but found it clichéd and its message about violence suspect.

overview: A young woman seeking self-improvement enlists the help of a renowned hypnotist but, after a handful of intense sessions, discovers unexpected and deadly consequences.
tagline: His wish is her command.
title: Hypnotic
plot:
Hypnotic is a 2021 South African crime thriller film directed by Ronny Clive, not The Long Game. 

The movie follows the story of a young woman named Nandi (played by Zaza Uribes) who becomes embroiled in a complex web of deceit and corruption when she discovers that her boyfriend's family is involved in human trafficking.

Some of the main themes present in Hypnotic include:

1. The exploitation of vulnerable individuals: The film highlights the ways in which traffickers prey on people, often using manipulation and coercion to control them.
2. Corruption and power dynamics: The movie explores how those in positions of power often use their influence to exploit and harm others.
3. Trauma and resilience: Nandi's journey is marked by her struggles to cope with the trauma she experiences as a result of being involved with human traffickers.
4. Female empowerment: Through Nandi's character, the film promotes female agency and resilience in the face of adversity.

Overall, Hypnotic is a gripping thriller that sheds light on the dark world of human trafficking and the ways in which it affects individuals and communities.

overview: The story of two men on different sides of a prison riot -- the inmate leading the rebellion and the young guard trapped in the revolt, who poses as a prisoner in a desperate attempt to survive the ordeal.
tagline: To survive inside, he has to become one of them.
title: Cell 211
plot:
Cell 211 is a Spanish thriller film directed by Ramón Salazar, released in 2009. The movie is based on a true story and stars Karra Elejalde as José Manuel Bleda, a prisoner who masterminds an escape from the Madrid Central Prison.

The film begins with José Manuel Bleda (Karra Elejalde), a young man wrongly convicted of murder, serving his sentence at the Madrid Central Prison. Bleda is a clever and resourceful individual who has been planning his escape for years. He befriends other prisoners, including Luis García (Luis Tosar) and Juan Carlos (Manuel Navas), and together they form a plan to break free.

The plot thickens as Bleda begins to manipulate the prison's authorities, using his charm and intelligence to gain their trust. He creates a diversion by starting a riot in the prison yard, which allows him to escape with his accomplices. The prisoners use a makeshift tunnel, hidden behind a false wall, to make their way out of the prison.

As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that Bleda's plan is not just about escaping but also about exposing the corruption and incompetence of the prison authorities. He uses his newfound freedom to gather evidence of the prison's wrongdoing and plans to reveal the truth to the public.

However, as Bleda and his accomplices try to evade capture, they realize that their actions have consequences beyond their control. The police launch a massive manhunt for the escaped prisoners, and tensions rise as they struggle to stay one step ahead of their pursuers.

The film's climax features an intense cat-and-mouse game between Bleda and the police, with the prisoner using his wits and cunning to evade capture. In the end, Bleda is finally caught, but not before he has managed to expose the corruption within the prison system.

Cell 211 received critical acclaim for its gripping storyline, strong performances, and tense atmosphere. The film's success can be attributed to its well-crafted plot, which keeps viewers on the edge of their seats until the very end.

original_title: Cats & Dogs: The Revenge of Kitty Galore
overview: The ongoing war between the canine and feline species is put on hold when they join forces to thwart a rogue cat spy with her own sinister plans for conquest.
tagline: Just like real spies... only furrier.
title: Cats & Dogs: The Revenge of Kitty Galore
plot:
Cats & Dogs: The Revenge of Kitty Galore is a 2010 American live-action/animated comedy film directed by Chris Columbus and produced by Warner Bros. Entertainment.

The movie begins with the introduction of Kitty Galore (played by Michelle Monaghan), a wealthy socialite and inventor who has lost her cat, Snowball III, to a group of dogs led by Fifi LaFume (voiced by Shirley MacLaine). The dogs, who are secretly working for their owner, Warren Lightman (played by Chris Kattan), have been stealing valuable items from around the world.

Kitty Galore teams up with her former flame, Buddy Cooper (played by Chris Pine), a dog who is also an agent of the FELIS (Federation for the Enforcement of Laws and Inter Species) organization. Together, they hatch a plan to take down Warren Lightman and his canine accomplices.

As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that Kitty Galore's true intentions are not entirely pure. She has a personal vendetta against Warren Lightman, who she believes wronged her in the past. Meanwhile, Buddy Cooper is struggling with his own identity as a dog who was raised by cats and feels like an outsider among both species.

The plot thickens when Snowball III, Kitty Galore's cat, returns to her side, revealing that he has been working undercover for FELIS all along. Together, they concoct a plan to infiltrate Warren Lightman's headquarters and steal the valuable item he is hiding: a powerful device that can control the minds of animals.

The movie culminates in an action-packed showdown between Kitty Galore and her canine enemies. In the end, Kitty Galore emerges victorious, but not without realizing that her true feelings for Buddy Cooper are still strong. The film concludes with Kitty Galore and Buddy Cooper sharing a romantic moment, as Snowball III looks on.

Throughout the movie, there are plenty of humorous moments, including cameos from other celebrities like Jack McBrayer and Bobby Cannavale. The film's blend of live-action and animation adds to its visual appeal, making it an entertaining watch for both kids and adults.

Overall, Cats & Dogs: The Revenge of Kitty Galore is a lighthearted, family-friendly comedy that explores themes of identity, loyalty, and love. While it may not be the most complex or sophisticated film, it delivers plenty of laughs and action to keep audiences entertained.

overview: As the Iranian revolution reaches a boiling point, a CIA 'exfiltration' specialist concocts a risky plan to free six Americans who have found shelter at the home of the Canadian ambassador.
tagline: The movie was fake. The mission was real.
title: Argo
plot:
Argo is a 2012 American thriller film directed by Ben Affleck, written by Chris Terrio, and produced by Warner Bros. Pictures.

The film is based on the true story of the CIA's rescue of six American diplomats from Iran during the 1979 hostage crisis. The story begins in November 1979, when a group of Iranian students storm the American embassy in Tehran, taking several American diplomats hostage. The situation escalates, and the United States government decides to send a team of CIA operatives to rescue the hostages.

The CIA identifies six Americans who are still in the country: Ambassador Bruce Laingen, his wife, and four other diplomats. However, due to the sensitive nature of their work, they cannot be extracted directly from Iran. Instead, the CIA comes up with a plan to use a Canadian filmmaker named John Chambers to pose as a Canadian film crew.

The CIA creates a fake movie production company called "Canada Films" and sends Chambers to Tehran to pretend to be filming a science fiction movie. The plan is for Chambers to gain the trust of the Iranian authorities, who are eager to cooperate with the Canadians in exchange for concessions on the hostage crisis.

Chambers meets with the Iranian officials and convinces them that he needs access to the American embassy to film a scene. He gains permission to enter the embassy, where he meets with the six American diplomats who are still being held captive. Chambers pretends to be filming a movie, but in reality, he is gathering information about the hostages' location and working with the CIA to come up with a plan for their rescue.

As the situation becomes more dire, Chambers realizes that his cover has been blown, and the Iranians have discovered that he is not who he claims to be. He must use all of his wits and charm to convince the Iranians that he is still a legitimate filmmaker, while also working with the CIA to come up with a plan for the rescue.

The film's climax features a tense and suspenseful sequence in which Chambers and the CIA operatives work together to extract the six American diplomats from Iran. The operation is fraught with danger, but ultimately, it is successful, and the hostages are safely evacuated.

Argo was widely praised by critics and audiences alike, and it won several awards, including three Academy Awards for Best Picture, Best Adapted Screenplay, and Best Film Editing. The film's success can be attributed to its gripping storyline, well-developed characters, and outstanding performances from the cast, particularly Ben Affleck as John Chambers.

Overall, Argo is a thrilling and suspenseful film that tells an incredible true story of bravery and ingenuity in the face of danger.

belongs_to_collection.name: The Battle at Lake Changjin Collection

overview: Korean War, winter 1950. In the frozen and snowy area of Changjin Lake, a bloody battle is about to begin between the elite troops of the United States and China.
tagline: Do they fall out of the goddamn sky?
title: The Battle at Lake Changjin
plot:
The Battle at Lake Changjin is a 2021 Chinese war film directed by Chen Kaige and Dante Lam. The movie is set during the final days of World War II, specifically in October 1945, when the Soviet Red Army clashed with the People's Volunteer Army (PVA) led by General Song Shi-Lun.

The main themes of the movie revolve around the complexities of war, loyalty, honor, and the human cost of conflict. The film delves into the moral dilemmas faced by soldiers on both sides, as they grapple with the consequences of their actions and the true meaning of sacrifice. Through the characters' struggles, the movie explores the blurred lines between right and wrong in the heat of battle.

The Battle at Lake Changjin also touches upon the theme of national pride and identity, highlighting the tensions between China's desire for independence and its historical ties to Russia. The film's portrayal of the PVA soldiers as heroic figures who fight against foreign occupation resonates with Chinese audiences, while also acknowledging the complexities of their relationship with the Soviet Union.

Furthermore, the movie examines the psychological toll of war on individuals, particularly those who are forced to confront their own mortality and the loss of comrades. The characters' personal stories serve as a counterpoint to the larger conflict, humanizing the experience of war and emphasizing its devastating impact on soldiers and civilians alike.

Overall, The Battle at Lake Changjin is a thought-provoking film that challenges viewers to consider the complexities of war and its effects on individuals and society.

overview: As the gang return to Jumanji to rescue one of their own, they discover that nothing is as they expect. The players will have to brave parts unknown and unexplored in order to escape the world’s most dangerous game.
title: Jumanji: The Next Level
plot:
Jumanji: The Next Level is a 2019 American fantasy adventure film directed by Jake Kasdan and written by Kasdan, Chris McKenna, and Erik Sommers. It is the sequel to Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle (2017) and stars Dwayne Johnson, Jack Black, Kevin Hart, Karen Gillan, Nick Jonas, Bobby Cannavale, and Awkwafina.

The film begins with Dr. Smolder Bravestone (Dwayne Johnson), Professor Shelly Oberon (Karen Gillan), Ruby Roundhouse (Rosa Salazar), and Moose Finbar (Jack Black) returning from their previous adventure in the jungle. However, they soon discover that their friend, Van Pelt (Bobby Cannavale), has escaped from prison and is seeking revenge against them.

Meanwhile, a new player joins the group: Spencer Gilpin (Alex Wolff), the son of Dr. Smolder Bravestone's old friend, Martha Kaply. The group receives an invitation to play Jumanji again, but this time, they must navigate the game without the help of their avatars from the previous game.

As they begin playing, they realize that Van Pelt has also joined the game and is determined to defeat them. The group soon discovers that the game has become more challenging than before, with new obstacles and dangers. They must work together to overcome these challenges and defeat Van Pelt in order to escape the game.

Throughout the film, the players face various challenges, including navigating treacherous jungle terrain, avoiding deadly creatures, and solving puzzles. Along the way, they also learn more about each other's pasts and form stronger bonds with one another.

As the game progresses, the stakes become higher, and the group realizes that they must find a way to defeat Van Pelt before it's too late. In the end, they successfully defeat him and escape the game, but not without some unexpected twists and turns.
