Jesper is about to give up and abandon his duty as a postman when he meets local teacher Alva and Klaus, a mysterious carpenter who lives alone in a cabin full of handmade toys.
tagline: Welcome to the jingle
title: Klaus
plot:
Klaus is an animated Christmas comedy of 2019 co-written, co-produced and directed by Sergio Pablos in his directorial debut, made by his SPA Studios in Madrid and distributed by Netflix. Hand-drawn in a style that imagines how traditional animation might have evolved, it offers an origin story for Santa Claus, with Jason Schwartzman as the postman Jesper, J. K. Simmons as the toymaker Klaus, Rashida Jones as Alva, Will Sasso and Joan Cusack as the feuding clan heads Aksel Ellingboe and Tammy Krum, Neda Margrethe Labba as Márgu and Norm Macdonald as the ferryman Mogens.

In 19th-century Norway, Jesper, the spoiled son of the Royal Postmaster General, deliberately fails at the postal academy. His father sends him to the remote northern island of Smeerensburg with an ultimatum: post 6,000 letters within a year or be cut off from the family fortune. The town is consumed by an ancient feud between the Ellingboes and the Krums, and nobody writes letters. Outside town Jesper meets Klaus, a reclusive woodsman whose house is full of handmade toys. After Klaus makes him secretly deliver a toy to a Krum boy, word spreads, and children start writing to Klaus hoping for toys. Jesper persuades Klaus to give his toys away by night, and tells the children that Klaus only rewards good behaviour, sparking acts of kindness that slowly soften the town. The children ask Alva, a teacher who has become a fishmonger, to teach them to write, and she reopens her school.

Klaus refuses to make more toys until Jesper's effort to build a sled for Márgu, a Sámi girl, wins him over; Klaus reveals that he carved the toys for the children he and his late wife Lydia never had, and agrees to a Christmas plan, helped by Márgu's people. As Jesper falls for Alva, the clan elders unite to stop the pair, discover Jesper's original selfish motive and expose it when his father arrives on Christmas Eve. Shunned but remorseful, Jesper stays and risks himself to save the gifts from a mob, though Klaus and Alva have already swapped them for decoys. The clans reconcile through a marriage, Jesper marries Alva, and he and Klaus deliver gifts for eleven years until Klaus vanishes into the forest, returning every Christmas Eve.

Klaus opened in select cinemas on 8 November 2019 and on Netflix a week later, its first original animated feature. Critics hailed its animation and warmth, with 95% on Rotten Tomatoes, and Netflix reported 40 million viewers in four weeks.

overview: A soldier introduces himself to the Peterson family, claiming to be a friend of their son who died in action. After the young man is welcomed into their home, a series of accidental deaths seem to be connected to his presence.
tagline: Be careful who you let in
title: The Guest
plot:
The Guest is a 2014 American thriller film directed by Adam Wingard. The movie revolves around a mysterious and charismatic soldier named David Callahan who claims to be a veteran, but his true intentions are shrouded in mystery.

At its core, The Guest explores the theme of identity and deception. David's character is a masterful manipulator, using his charm and charisma to gain the trust of those around him, including the family he claims to be visiting. As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that David's past is not what he claims it to be, and his true intentions are far from altruistic.

The film also delves into the theme of trauma and its effects on individuals. David's character has clearly experienced some form of traumatic event in his past, which has left him with emotional scars. His interactions with the family he visits reveal a deep-seated need for connection and acceptance, which is ultimately unfulfilled.

Furthermore, The Guest touches on the idea of toxic masculinity and the dangers of unchecked aggression. David's character embodies a toxic form of masculinity, where violence and aggression are used as tools to assert power and control over others. This theme is particularly evident in his interactions with the family's son, Parker, who becomes increasingly entangled in David's web of deceit.

Throughout the film, Wingard expertly weaves together these themes, creating a tense and unsettling atmosphere that keeps the viewer on edge. The Guest is a thought-provoking thriller that explores the darker aspects of human nature, making it a compelling watch for fans of the genre.

overview: Siblings Mimi and Luke unwittingly resurrect an ancient alien overlord. Using a magical amulet, they force the monster to obey their childish whims, and accidentally attract a rogues’ gallery of intergalactic assassins to small-town suburbia.
tagline: Little girl. Big psycho.
title: Psycho Goreman
plot:
Psycho Goreman is a 2020 Canadian body horror film directed by Raven Banner. The movie follows the story of a young boy named Dax, who lives with his mother, Karen, in a small apartment.

Dax's life takes a drastic turn when he discovers an ancient VHS tape in the attic of their building. The tape is labeled "Psycho Goreman" and contains footage of a 1970s children's television show featuring a character named Psycho Goreman, a monstrous creature with a penchant for terrorizing children.

As Dax watches the tape, he becomes increasingly enthralled by Psycho Goreman's antics, and soon begins to experience strange and terrifying events in his own life. He starts to see visions of Psycho Goreman everywhere, and begins to suspect that the creature is real.

Karen, who has been struggling with her own personal demons, becomes increasingly concerned about Dax's behavior and tries to intervene. However, as the events escalate, it becomes clear that something sinister is at play.

As the story unfolds, it becomes apparent that Psycho Goreman is not just a product of Dax's imagination, but a real entity that has been awakened by the VHS tape. The creature begins to wreak havoc on the city, terrorizing children and causing chaos wherever it goes.

Dax and Karen must band together to stop Psycho Goreman and save their lives. Along the way, they uncover dark secrets about the history of the VHS tape and the true nature of Psycho Goreman's existence.

The movie builds towards a thrilling climax as Dax and Karen face off against the monstrous creature in an epic battle. In the end, only one of them emerges victorious, but not without scars - both physical and emotional.

Throughout the film, Raven Banner explores themes of childhood trauma, mental health, and the power of media to shape our perceptions of reality. The movie is a loving send-up of 1980s horror movies, with plenty of nods to classic films like Child's Play and It.

Overall, Psycho Goreman is a wildly entertaining and unsettling film that will appeal to fans of body horror and cult cinema. With its unique blend of humor, horror, and heart, it's a must-see for anyone looking for a fresh take on the genre.
